new_roles.title: Vice President of Quality
new_roles.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.

new_roles.title: Chief Quality Officer
new_roles.description:
Responsible for maintaining the facilities system-wide Quality program; to include data collection, aggregating and analyzing data, maintaining policies and procedures. Facilitates alignment between improvement initiatives and the organizations strategic plan; directs the day-to-day execution of the strategies and tactic necessary to successfully improve the outcomes and results of the organization. M
OBIS Corporate Center America will be aiding in the hiring progress for this job position. 

*(*
*To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

 

* Provide training and Guidance to QC and QA functions in their separate spheres of operations. Work with HOD’s / COD’s to establish long term goals for both departments.
* Ensure voice of the customer is heard by both groups and the rest of the organization.
* Interact with Senior Management at the OEM to understand their expectations and translate actionable activities within QC or QA as appropriate.
* Leads and is ultimately responsible for Quality (QA & QC) activities throughout the MOBIS Georgia plant.
* Ensure that projects are implemented in a timely manner and improvements are sustained by the organization.

 

**Quality Assurance & New Model Launch Management (MOBIS Product Development System / APQP)**

* Improvement of CS/RS related claims as well as quality cost.
* Manage monthly claim process, recall/campaign and service action.
* Manage external issues such as NHTSA , IQS/VDS, IATF, etc.
* Control internal communication with related teams about field issues

**Quality Control**

* KPI Management
* Profitability Improvement / Customer Incoming Quality (ppm) / Man Power (Salary & Hourly) / Policy Demerits (Customer Line Stop & Safety)

**Internal/External Quality Index Management**

* Internal/Customer Issue per day
* Supplier/Process Quality (ppm)
* Supplier Chargeback

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Yes

 

*(The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required and preferred for this position.)*

**Required Education & Experience:**

* Experience: 10 years
* Managerial Experience: 8+ years
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) required, MBA desired
* Degree Field: Engineering, Quality, or related field.
* Equivalent Experience/Education: 15 years of experience in a manufacturing/automotive field
* Communication Skills: Advanced
* Mathematical Skills: Intermediate
* 5+ years of automotive Quality Assurance experience
* 5+ years of automotive Quality Control experience
* OEM or Tier 1 supplier manufacturing experience preferred.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:**

* Strategic Planning
* Operations Management
* Strategic Project Management
* Leadership
* People Management

new_roles.title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean
new_roles.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.
 
 
Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.
 
 
The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level
* Proven track record leading Lean transformations that delivered measurable financial results, preferably in a multi-division manufacturing environment
* Professional experience in a global matrixed organization
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or MBA preferred

**Position Success Criteria**

* Expert-level command of Lean and Six Sigma; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification required
* Experience designing, governing, and maturing a business operating system and maturity model at scale
* Strong business and financial acumen: builds cost-out and productivity plans, quantifies impact, and ties CI results to the P&L
* Experience designing CI talent, certification, and capability programs across a large, multi-site organization
* Applies Lean to both manufacturing and office/transactional processes
* Executive presence; a trusted advisor who influences, challenges, and aligns senior executives
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of senior CI leaders
* Strategic thinker who turns vision into multi-year roadmaps and leads change at scale
* Excellent communication at every level, from the shop floor to the executive leadership team

The expected annual salary range for this role is $203000 - $297000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.
 
 
Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.
 
 
All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
 
 
We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.
 
 
Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.
 
 
You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.
 
 
To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.
 
 
We know that good benefit programs are important to employees and their families. Eaton provides various Health and Welfare benefits as well as Retirement benefits, and several programs that provide for paid and unpaid time away from work. Click here for more detail: Eaton Benefits Overview. Please note that specific programs and options available to an employee may depend on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions.

This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.
The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team.

Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level.

on behalf of a growth-stage food and beverage manufacturer that is expanding production across multiple plants to meet increasing retail and foodservice demand.

 environments

 practices

 regulated environments

 required

From $325,000 per year

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* Remote work

new_roles.title: Vice President of Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

A well-established, rapidly growing manufacturing organization with a strong national presence is seeking an accomplished executive to lead its manufacturing and production operations. The company is entering an exciting phase of expansion, investing in leadership, technology, automation, and operational infrastructure to support its ambitious long-term growth objectives.

**Position Overview**

The Vice President of Manufacturing will provide strategic and operational leadership across a complex, high-volume manufacturing environment, overseeing approximately 900 employees across multiple production functions.

Reporting directly to the EVP of Operations, this executive will be responsible for developing and executing a long-term manufacturing strategy, optimizing production performance, implementing automation, and building scalable processes to support continued growth.

This is a highly visible executive leadership opportunity with significant influence over the organization's operational future.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead large-scale manufacturing and production operations, overseeing approximately 900 employees.
* Develop and execute a 1–3 year manufacturing strategy focused on growth, scalability, efficiency, and automation.
* Drive continuous improvement across manufacturing processes, production operations, and facility performance.
* Establish consistent standards for safety, quality, productivity, labor efficiency, cost, and on-time delivery.
* Identify opportunities to implement advanced manufacturing technologies, automation, and equipment improvements.
* Optimize production flow, capacity planning, labor utilization, and manufacturing processes.
* Oversee manufacturing budgets, financial performance, cost controls, and operational profitability.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing leadership team, strengthening accountability and succession planning.
* Implement standardized operating procedures, performance metrics, and operational best practices.
* Partner with executive leadership to align manufacturing capabilities with business growth objectives.
* Proactively identify operational risks and ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.

**Ideal Candidate Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including significant senior-level operational responsibility.
* Strong background in wood products manufacturing required; cabinetry or related manufacturing experience highly preferred.
* Proven experience leading large-scale, high-volume manufacturing operations across multiple departments or facilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop Directors, Managers, and large production teams.
* Strong technical knowledge of manufacturing equipment, CNC machinery, automated production systems, production flow, and process optimization.
* Proven success improving operational efficiency, production output, quality, safety, and cost performance.
* Experience implementing lean manufacturing principles, continuous improvement initiatives, and scalable operating systems.
* Strong financial acumen, including budget management, operational cost controls, and P&L responsibility.
* Strategic thinker capable of developing long-term manufacturing plans while remaining actively engaged in day-to-day operations.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Why This Opportunity?**

* Executive-level opportunity with significant influence over a rapidly expanding organization.
* Lead a large-scale manufacturing operation with approximately 900 employees.
* Drive meaningful transformation through automation, technology, and operational improvements.
* Build and develop a strong leadership team while shaping the future of manufacturing operations.
* Join an ambitious organization investing in infrastructure, operational excellence, and long-term growth.

**Compensation:**
$300,000+ executive compensation package, commensurate with experience.

new_roles.title: VP - Test, Technology and Operations
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**onsemi**
is seeking a Vice President to lead the centralized Test, Technology, and Operations (TTO) Engineering organization across Allen (TX), Bangalore, Czech Republic, and Philippines. This role is responsible for driving the test, technology, and operations strategy and execution for design for test (DFT), test automation, automated test equipment (ATE) and reliability hardware, new product introduction (NPI), COGs, factory transfers, quality and EFARs, and sustaining activities.
 
 
As the VP, Test, Technology, and Operations, you will oversee a centralized engineering organization with a charter focused on enabling scalable, reliable, and cost-effective product execution from development through sustaining. This leader will drive test strategy, operational discipline, quality improvement, and cross-functional alignment across the full TTO Engineering scope.
 
 
The ideal candidate brings acute leadership experience in test engineering, new product development, product and process quality, factory transfer execution, and global organizational leadership. This role requires a proactive, strategic leader who can maintain continuity through organizational transition, strengthen technical capability, and build an execution-focused culture across a distributed global team.
 
 
Key Function:
 
 

* Lead the centralized TTO Engineering organization across Allen, Bangalore, Czech Republic, and Philippines, ensuring alignment to test, technology, operations, cost, quality, and execution priorities.
* Own the strategy and execution for DFT, test automation, ATE and reliability hardware, NPI readiness, COGs improvement, factory transfers, quality and EFARs, and sustaining support.
* Maintain a clear centralized charter, reporting structure, and operating model while driving technical competency, execution discipline, and continuous improvement across the organization.

**Responsibilities**
Responsibilities:
 
 

* Define and drive the overall TTO Engineering strategy across design for test, test automation, ATE and reliability hardware, NPI, COGs, factory transfers, quality and EFARs, and sustaining.
* Lead centralized test technology development and standardization to improve execution efficiency, test coverage, final test yield, product quality, and cost performance.
* Drive DFT and test automation strategy to enable scalable, manufacturable, and cost-effective new product introductions.
* Oversee ATE and reliability hardware strategy, capability planning, deployment readiness, and sustaining support across product lifecycles.
* Partner with product, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams to execute factory transfers, resolve quality issues, and accelerate EFAR closure.
* Drive COGs improvement initiatives through test cost reduction, yield enhancement, process optimization, and disciplined operational execution.
* Ensure sustaining support for released products, including test coverage, reliability needs, customer issue resolution, and continuous quality improvement.
* Build and develop a high-performing global engineering organization with strong technical competency, clear accountability, and effective cross-functional collaboration.

**Qualifications**
Qualification:
 
 

* Degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent engineering discipline.
* 20+ years of direct leadership experience in product and test engineering.

Preferred Qualification:
 
 

* Very strong executive-level leadership
* Experience building teams and developing talent.
* Able to work effectively across functional organizations at senior levels of management.
* Strong problem-solving methodology.
* Extremely proactive with a strategic mindset.
* Effective communication skills

**About Us**
**onsemi**
(Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.
 
 
**More details about our company benefits can be found here:**
https://www.onsemi.com/careers/career-benefits
 
 
**About The Team**
We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work.
 
 
**onsemi**
is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, or local laws.
 
 
If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Talent.acquisition@onsemi.com for assistance.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (FAA Repair Station)
new_roles.description:
Chromalloy is a global engineering & solutions company. We are a leading provider of aftermarket parts, repairs, and solutions that safely & reliably extend the life of aircraft engines and gas turbines. We develop, manufacture and repair critical turbine components for a range of engine platforms. Our solutions support the engines running the aerospace, energy and defense industries around the world.
 
 
**Video**
: What We Do
 
 
**Why work at Chromalloy?**
Chromalloy employees are proud, passionate problem-solvers who strive to live our values every day. A career with Chromalloy is an opportunity to learn from top industry experts, work with important technologies, and unlock a passion for innovation. Join our team of experts, innovators and problem-solvers delivering world-class solutions for our customers. As a global company, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees feel represented, heard, and able to bring their best selves to work every day. Be part of something bigger with Chromalloy!
 
 
Our
**Total Rewards Program**
is designed to support you today and in the future.
 
 

* Comprehensive and flexible benefit options starting on day one, including medical, dental, vision, EAP, wellness incentives, and 401(k) with employer matching.
* Development & progression opportunities for every employee – regular performance conversations, training and development curriculum, and engineering fellowship programs.
* Paid time off, including vacation, sick time, paid holidays, and parental leave—all eligible on your first day of employment!
* Competitive pay, including eligibility for quarterly and annual bonuses, depending on role and site.

*Eligibility for individual benefit plans may vary based on employment status.*
**Job Summary**
We're looking for a
**Sr. Manager, Quality Assurance**
to lead the site Quality function and support safe, compliant, high-quality aerospace manufacturing and repair operations. This role provides leadership, direction, and coaching to ensure business goals are achieved while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, customer service, operational excellence, and employee development.
 
 
The successful candidate will lead the full Quality organization — Quality Engineers, Quality Supervisors, Lab Technicians (Cal & Met Lab), NDT, Compliance, and Inspectors — while directing quality systems, driving regulatory compliance, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 
 
**Work That Matters**
At Chromalloy, your work directly supports
**aviation safety and reliability**
. Our teams repair and manufacture critical aerospace components used across the global aviation industry. As a people leader, you'll play a key role in developing talent, improving processes, and delivering results that help keep aircraft flying safely around the world.
 
 
**Location**
: San Diego, CA
 
 
**Travel**
: Occasional travel required
 
 
**Schedule**
: On-site
 
 
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Lead, coach, and develop a multi-level Quality organization including Quality Engineers, Supervisors, Compliance, NDT, Laboratory Operations, and Inspection teams.
* Establish quality objectives, policies, and performance expectations that drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Own and continually improve the site's Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with AS9100, FAA, EASA, CAAC, and customer requirements.
* Lead internal audits, corrective action programs, escape management investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve product quality, process capability, and operational performance.
* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and other operational excellence methodologies.
* Lead customer and regulatory interactions, audits, and quality reviews.
* Develop supplier quality strategies and oversee supplier qualification and performance.
* Analyze quality metrics and trends to identify risks, drive improvements, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Provide strategic leadership for new product introduction, process validation, inspection technologies, and continuous improvement initiatives

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* 10+ years of aerospace or industrial gas turbine engineering, manufacturing, repair, or quality leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading large teams across multiple organizational levels.
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and aerospace regulatory requirements, including FAA, EASA, and CAAC.
* Proven experience driving organizational performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective action systems, and quality management principles.
* Experience leading cross-functional projects within complex manufacturing or MRO environments.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Black Belt, or similar certification
* Proven leadership experience in multi-site aerospace manufacturing or MRO operations
* Bilingual English and Spanish proficiency
* Experience implementing advanced inspection technologies, automation, or digital quality systems
* Experience developing and monitoring complex project budgets, resource needs, and timelines

**Leadership Expectations and Values**

* Sets Direction: Aligns people and decisions to Chromalloy’s vision and delivers results through transparency and accountability.
* Business Leadership: Drives enterprise value through sound judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and customer focus.
* Leads with Courage: Communicates openly, addresses challenges directly, and fosters accountability.
* Acts Decisively: Makes informed decisions, empowers others, and drives continuous improvement.
* Builds Talent: Develops diverse, high-performing teams through trust, respect, and inclusion.
* Owns Results: Sets clear expectations, establishes standards, and delivers operational excellence.

This position may require work hours outside of the regularly scheduled hours to meet operational needs. This may include work during evenings, weekends, and/or holidays. Additional work hours are assigned based on business requirements. Non-exempt employees will be paid overtime in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
 
 
The salary range for this position reflects a broad spectrum of experience levels. Individual compensation within the range is determined by multiple factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, job related skills, internal equity, and market conditions. We evaluate each candidate individually to ensure fair and competitive pay decisions.
 
 
**Due to government regulation only US persons (U.S. citizen, U.S. naturalized citizen, U.S. permanent resident, holder of U.S. approved political asylee or refugee status) may be considered for this role.**
Chromalloy participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
 
 
Any offer of employment will also be conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen in accordance with company policy and applicable federal and state regulations.
 
 
Chromalloy is an equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled.
 
 
In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please contact: https://www.chromalloy.com/contact-us/

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
new_roles.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.
 
 
For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.
 
 
At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.
 
 
We are looking for a S
**r. Manager, Quality**
to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to
**Director of Quality**
and based in
**Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week**
.
 
 
**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.
* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.
* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.
* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.
* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.
* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.
* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.
* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.
* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.
* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.
* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.
* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.
* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.
* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.
* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)
* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.
* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.
* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.
* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.
* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.
* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.
* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.
* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.
* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.
* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .
* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.
* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up
* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.
* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)
* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)
* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.
* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.
* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.
* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.
* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.
* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.
* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).
* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.
* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.
* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.
* Possess a passion for excellence.
* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.
* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.
* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.
 
 
At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.
 
 
Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Regional Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA)
new_roles.description:
**Purpose**
Dole Packaged Foods is a purpose led organization that is a champion of accessible fruit nutrition and builds a brighter future for people through the goodness of fruit.
 
 
At Dole, our culture is uniquely driven by core Values. Our commitment to these Values transforms our work into a meaningful journey toward a brighter future together. Here, you'll be part of a respectful, inclusive culture that deeply values our colleagues, customers, and global communities. We strive for excellence, empowering each other to confidently overcome challenges, continuously learn, and achieve world-class results. Guided by unwavering integrity, our actions consistently reflect our commitment to always doing what's right, fostering lasting trust and strong relationships. Through a spirit of collaboration, we cultivate positivity, generosity, and genuine teamwork, enabling collective success toward our One Dole Purpose. Our innovative spirit leads directly to meaningful outcomes and business success.
 
 
The Senior Manager, Regional Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) provides leadership and direction for food safety and quality across the North America region. Serving as a key partner to regional business and Supply Chain leadership, this role oversees regional and site FSQA execution, drives performance and continuous improvement, and serves as a primary Quality representative for customers and key business partners.
 
 
Working collaboratively across Operations, Supply Chain and Global FSQR, the Senior Manager helps translate company priorities into effective execution while strengthening food safety and quality capability throughout the region. This is a highly visible leadership role for an experienced professional who enjoys developing people, solving complex problems and influencing how Quality supports the business.
 
 
This role provides flexibility to work in a hybrid environment of home and our Westlake Village, CA office. (Hybrid is defined as 3 times per week in the office).
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Accountabilities:**
**Regional FSQA Leadership & Execution**

* Lead food safety and quality execution across North America, providing oversight to regional and site FSQA teams and serving as the primary FSQA partner to regional business and Supply Chain leadership.
* Monitor significant food safety and quality risks, performance gaps and corrective actions, ensuring effective execution, follow-through and appropriate escalation.
* Lead, coach and develop FSQA personnel while strengthening food safety and quality culture, capability and accountability across the region.

**Program Deployment & Capability Building**

* Lead regional implementation and reinforcement of company food safety and quality programs, standards and requirements including training and capability building across applicable functions.
* Coordinate regional food safety and quality incidents, ensuring appropriate assessment, communication, escalation and corrective action in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
* Partner with Global FSQR subject-matter experts to address technical and capability needs and support development of regional or facility SOPs, protocols and other supporting documentation.

**Customer, Business & Supply Chain Partnership**

* Serve as the primary North America Quality Representative for customers including strategic customer relationships, audits, inquiries and quality-related issues.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Commercial, Procurement, R&D and other functions to integrate food safety and quality requirements into business activities, commercialization and change initiatives.
* Coordinate regional FSQA activities involving suppliers, third-party manufacturers, warehousing and transportation in partnership with the appropriate Global FSQR teams.

**Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive regional FSQA performance through KPIs, scorecards, trend analysis and management reporting, providing appropriate visibility to regional leadership and Global FSQR.
* Identify systemic risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities and drive effective corrective and preventive actions across the region.
* Manage regional FSQA resources and priorities to support business needs, strengthen execution and continuously improve food safety and quality performance.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**
**Experience, Knowledge, & Skills You Bring:**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in food safety, quality assurance or related food manufacturing disciplines, including demonstrated leadership responsibility.
* Strong knowledge of food safety and quality management systems, HACCP/Preventive Controls, GMPs, GFSI-recognized certification schemes and applicable U.S./Canada food regulations.
* Experience working across manufacturing, Supply Chain and cross-functional business environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and work effectively across organizational boundaries.
* Experience managing customer quality relationships and communicating effectively with senior business leaders.
* Strong understanding of incident management, risk assessment, corrective and preventive action, and continuous improvement principles.
* Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues and performance data into practical business actions.
* Demonstrated ability to coach and develop technical professionals and build effective cross-functional relationships.

**What You’ll Need to Succeed:**

* Passionate about a purpose driven career
* Committed to fostering inclusive environments that support employee development and well-being
* Sets clear expectations, encourages innovation, and drives continuous improvement
* Models and coaches towards transparency and integrity in decision-making
* Effectively facilitates cross-team communication and teamwork

**Education & Certification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Biology, Chemistry or Life Sciences is required.
* Advanced degree preferred but not required.
* HACCP and/or Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) training strongly preferred.
* Relevant GFSI, auditing, food safety or quality certifications are beneficial.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to sit and use the computer for extended periods of time; ability to answer phones and use a variety of office equipment; ability to lift 15 pounds and reach overhead.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Approximately 30-40%, including travel to company facilities, customers, and business partners as required.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.**
**For Jobs Based In California**
Hiring Pay Scale: $145,000 to $170,000
 
 
Dole Packaged Foods is committed to paying our Associates fairly and equitably. The pay rate offered will consider a wide range of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, accomplishments, and location. Pay scales are subject to review on a regular basis and will be updated as appropriate.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP)
new_roles.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.
 
 
At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team
**,**
fostering a strong sense of belonging.
 
 
Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture!
 
 
Site: www.ptcbio.com
 
 
**Job Description Summary**
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP) is responsible for managing GxP Quality Assurance (QA) functions with an emphasis on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance for development products. This involves engaging and collaborating with cross-functional internal and external teams to evaluate processes, procedures, and activities for adherence to relevant industry standards, regulatory guidelines, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
The incumbent will support and/or conduct internal and external GCP audits of investigator sites, vendors, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, and submission documents, etc.
 
 
She/He will assist in inspection readiness activities.
 
 
She/He may manage direct reports.
 
 
The incumbent works cross-functionally with internal departments and external resources on GxP QA related issues.
 
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance – GxP (GCP)supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**

* Partners with Clinical Development/Operations and actively participates in clinical study teams to ensure GCP compliance. Assists in identifying and communicating clinical trial-related risks and opportunities for process improvement. Reviews study-related documents and plans.
* Performs internal and external audits as assigned to ensure compliance with GXP regulations and guidelines.
* Communicates audit results to internal stakeholders and writes audit report.
* Assesses audit responses and ensures closure of corrective action preventative actions (CAPAs).
* Leads backroom activities during regulatory authority inspections and assists with GxP inspection readiness activities.
* Supports Quality Management System (QMS) including, but not be limited to, the following activities:
* QA review/approval of deviations, CAPAs and change controls.
* Drafts, reviews, and approves SOPs.
* May manage, coach, and mentor direct reports.
* Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance or related role in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related environment.
 
 

* Detailed knowledge and understanding of GCP regulations.
* Demonstrated experience leading and/or conducting QA audits.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing risk-based audit plans.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and foster positive, collaborative relationships with internal staff as well as with external, third-party vendors.
* Demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching, and mentoring direct reports.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency inspections.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.
* Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

**Special Knowledge Or Skills And/or Licenses Or Certificates Preferred.**

* Experience writing and reviewing SOPs.
* Clinical lab experience.
* Registered GxP Quality Assurance Certifications.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) inspections.
* Knowledge and experience in Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and/or Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) regulations.

*Travel requirements: Up to 30% (Domestic and International)*
*Expected Base Salary Range: $141,900 -$175,000. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.*
*In addition to base salary, PTC employees are also eligible for short- and long-term incentives. All eligible employees may also enroll in PTC’s medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings plans*
**EEO Statement**
**PTC Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.**

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance, Regulatory & Compliance
new_roles.description:
**POSITION DETAILS**
Job Title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance, Regulatory & Compliance
 
 
Location: Yonkers, NY (Hybrid or Remote w/ Travel)
 
 
Reports To: Sr. Director, Supply Chain
 
 
Compensation: $120,000 to $130,000
 
 
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical
**Senior Manager, Quality Assurance, Regulatory & Compliance**
to lead our global quality and compliance functions. As a rapidly growing hair care brand, we require a hands-on leader to ensure our products meet the highest standards of safety, efficacy, and legal compliance across all global markets.
 
 
In this role, you will own the end-to-end quality control lifecycle, from raw material qualification to finished goods distribution, while serving as our internal subject matter expert for global cosmetic regulations. You will play a critical role in managing our compliance with the Modernization of Cosmetics Regulation Act (MoCRA) in the US, as well as maintaining active registrations and compliance in the EU, UK, and other international markets.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
**Global Regulatory Compliance**

* MoCRA & FDA Leadership: Serve as the designated "Responsible Person" (or primary liaison) to ensure full compliance with MoCRA requirements, including facility registrations, product listings, safety substantiation, and fragrance allergen disclosures.
* International Market Registrations: Lead and maintain product registrations across global portals, including the EU Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP), UK Submit Cosmetic Product Notification (SCPN), and Health Canada.
* Claims Substantiation & Labeling: Serve as the definitive regulatory authority for product marketing and packaging. Collaborate with Marketing, Legal, and Product Development to ensure all packaging artwork, ingredient lists (INCI), and warnings comply strictly with FDA and international standards. Maintain ownership of the testing matrix and claims substantiation repository, establishing a mandatory QA/Regulatory approval gate for all technical data prior to market release.
* Adverse Event Management: Oversee the adverse event reporting system; manage serious adverse event reporting timelines, maintain recordkeeping, and ensure root-cause investigations are conducted.
* Regulatory Intelligence: Monitor shifting regulatory landscapes (e.g., Prop 65, volatile organic compounds (VOC) restrictions for aerosols, state-level bans) and proactively update internal formulations and policies to mitigate risk.

**End-to-End Quality Control & Assurance**

* CMO & Supplier Management: Audit, qualify, and manage third-party contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), raw material suppliers, and packaging vendors. Ensure alignment with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) and ISO 22716 standards.
* Product Testing & Release: Oversee stability, compatibility, and microbiological testing protocols for new and existing hair care formulations. Review and approve Certificates of Analysis (COAs), batch records, and retain samples
* Packaging Compatibility & Structural Testing: Lead Package Compatibility Testing (PCT), E&L studies, and structural assessments (e.g., torque, seal, barrier). Ensure all packaging meets ISTA transit standards and maintains integrity with complex hair care formulations like aerosols and surfactants.
* Issue Resolution: Lead root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and Out of Specification (OOS) investigations. Make critical disposition decisions regarding product approvals, quarantines, or rejections.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, scale, and maintain internal QMS documentation, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), finished product specifications, and quality agreements with external partners.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* New Product Development (NPD): Act as the regulatory and quality gatekeeper during the R&D and commercialization phases. Advise on ingredient restrictions and formulation safety.
* Team Development: Manage and mentor quality coordinators or specialists. Provide training to cross-functional teams (Operations, Customer Service) on regulatory requirements and quality standards.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biology, Regulatory Affairs, or a related scientific discipline. Master’s degree preferred.
* Experience: 7–10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs within the CPG industry, specifically in cosmetics, personal care, or hair care.
* Regulatory Expertise: Deep, demonstrated understanding of US FDA cosmetic regulations (MoCRA), EU CosReg, UK regulations, and global compliance frameworks.
* Quality Systems: Strong background in cGMP, ISO standards (e.g., ISO 22716), ISTA transit testing, and handling FDA inspections or third-party audits.
* Hair Care Knowledge: Familiarity with hair care specific formulation challenges, including emulsions, surfactants, aerosols (VOC compliance), and clinical testing for hair claims.
* Skills: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and balance risk-management with commercial business goals.

**Preferred Experience**

* eQMS Implementation: Proven experience selecting, implementing, or migrating electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS) such as MasterControl, Veeva, or TrackWise, as well as integrating quality modules within ERPs like NetSuite or SAP.
* Advanced Formulation Expertise: Direct experience managing compliance and quality control for Over-the-Counter (OTC) monographs (e.g., dandruff shampoos, minoxidil hair growth treatments), continuous mist aerosols, or professional-grade salon chemical treatments.
* Retailer & Clean Beauty Standards: Deep understanding of specialized retailer compliance frameworks, such as "Clean at Sephora," Target Clean, or Credo Beauty guidelines, and experience managing the formulation and documentation required to meet them.
* Professional Certifications: Active Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC) or American Society for Quality (ASQ) certifications, such as Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Manager of Quality (CMQ/OE).
* Sustainability & ESG: Experience guiding quality and regulatory practices for sustainability initiatives, such as achieving B-Corp certification, managing PCR material tracking, or navigating extended producer responsibility (EPR) packaging laws.

**SCOPE OF DECISION-MAKING**
**Autonomous Decisions (Direct Authority)**

* Product Disposition: Final authority to release, quarantine, or reject finished goods and raw materials based on test results, COAs, and quality standards.
* Compliance Sign-Off: Sole approval authority on ingredient lists (INCI), regulatory packaging warnings, and safety substantiation prior to printing or market launch.
* Supplier Qualification: Authority to approve, conditionally approve, or disqualify contract manufacturers (CMOs), packaging vendors, and raw material suppliers based on audit results and cGMP compliance.
* CAPA & Investigations: Direct control over resolving Out of Specification (OOS) investigations, determining root causes, and enforcing Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) with internal teams and external vendors.
* SOP Enforcement: Authority to implement, update, and enforce Quality Management System (QMS) policies and standard operating procedures across the organization.

**Collaborative & Escalated Decisions (Advisory Role)**

* Product Recalls & Withdrawals: Lead the initial risk assessment and data gathering for potential safety issues, but escalate final recall execution and communication strategies to Executive Leadership and Legal.
* New Market Entry: Advise the Executive team on the regulatory feasibility, costs, and timeline of entering new international markets (e.g., reformulations needed, registration hurdles).
* Marketing Claims: Partner with Legal and Marketing to negotiate and finalize high-risk product claims (e.g., "clinically proven," "hair growth"), balancing commercial goals with regulatory constraints.
* Major Capital Expenditures: Recommend investments in enterprise quality software (eQMS) or third-party laboratory partnerships for executive budget approval.

**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
 
 
**Environmental Conditions**
Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards
 
 
**Title: Senior Manager Quality Sterility Assurance**
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
**Division/Site Specific Information**
Role reports to the Ridgefield, NJ site and reports to the Drug Product Division within the Pharma Services Group.
 
 
**Discover Impactful Work:**
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.
 
 
A Day in the Life:
 
 

* In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers.
* You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches.
* Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
* As a member of the Quality Leadership Team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives.
* You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.

**Keys to Success:**
**Education/Experience**

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry required.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Proficiency with quality management software systems

**Benefits**
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.
 
 
**Compensation And Benefits**
The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $143,200.00–$214,900.00.
 
 
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:
 
 

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.title: Sr Manager Quality Systems
new_roles.description:
The Senior Manager, Quality Systems is responsible for leading and enhancing the organization's quality systems to ensure compliance with global regulatory requirements and standards. This role oversees key quality systems including deviation management, CAPA, change control, training, document control, and audit readiness. The position plays a strategic role in driving continuous improvement and fostering a culture of quality across the Global Development Organization (GDO) and across GDO supporting functional departments.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Lead and manage the development, implementation, and maintenance of core quality systems (QMS).
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment of quality systems with GDO operational needs; serves as QA Lead and system owner for Deviation, CAPA, Change Control, Training and Document Management processes.
* Author and approve SOPs, policies, and training materials related to quality systems.
* Ensure alignment of procedural documents across GDO and compliance with applicable GxP regulations and internal standards/requirements where applicable.
* This role participates in internal and external audits as assigned and supports regulatory inspections.
* Lead risk assessments and quality impact evaluations for system changes. Drive continuous improvement initiatives; Lean Six Sigma or similar methodology are a plus.
* Develop and monitor quality metrics and KPIs; report trends at Management Review and ad hoc when critical/major quality events arise to leadership.
* Collaborates with a team of professionals and external parties to ensure compliance and audits are completed; Travel requirement is 15%

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or related field; certification in biologics, pharmaceuticals, medical devices and/or Quality Management is a plus.
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Quality Assurance within a regulated industry.
* Experience with electronic QMS platforms; proven skills and proficiency of quality systems and working in a globally hybrid team atmosphere.
* Strong knowledge of FDA, EMA, ICH guidelines and GxP principles. Familiarity with data governance and digital quality systems.
* Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capability; excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive change; effective communications with technical and non-technical colleagues; experience establishing and maintaining effective relationships with leaders and peers.
* Demonstrated capability as organizational change agent; experience in leading and participating in global teams with shared responsibility for outcomes and decision-making.

The presently-anticipated base compensation pay range for this position is $137,000 to $167,500. Actual base compensation may vary based on a number of factors, including but not limited to geographical location and experience. In addition, this position is part of the Annual Performance Bonus Plan. Employees are eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs which include medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; and the employee assistance program. Employees also receive various paid time off benefits, including vacation time and sick time.
 
 
The compensation and benefits described above are subject to the terms and conditions of any governing plans, policies, practices, agreements, or other materials or documents as in effect from time to time, including but not limited to terms and conditions regarding eligibility. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company, or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

new_roles.title: Director, New Product Development Engineering
new_roles.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.
 
 
Bevi is hiring a Director of New Product Development Engineering to lead the team that designs our next generation of beverage machines and takes them into high-volume production. The work spans new platforms, smaller form-factor machines, hot water, flavor cartridges, and consumables, and brings together hardware, software, and beverage science.
 
 
Your top priority is scaling. You'll take Bevi's hardware into much higher-volume, lower-cost manufacturing, working closely with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners. You'll lead NPD Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Compliance Engineering, and own new products from concept through certification and production launch.
 
 
This role reports to the VP of Engineering, sits on the engineering leadership team, and works across Product, Software, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and more. Bevi is still growing fast, so you'll have real room to shape how we build hardware and the team that does it. Expect regular travel to manufacturing partners in Asia.
 
 
What You'll Own
 
 
New Product Development
 
 

* Lead new product programs from concept and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production.
* Own product architecture and make the tradeoff calls on cost, reliability, manufacturability, and schedule, while staying hands-on in design reviews and critical build issues.
* Set cost targets (BOM, tooling, landed cost) early and design to them, with DFM, DFA, and design-for-cost built in from the start.

High-Volume Manufacturing & Working with ODMs
 
 

* Lead Bevi's shift to high-volume, lower-cost manufacturing with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners.
* Work with partner engineering teams as true collaborators: align on specs, work through design feedback together, and decide where their expertise can speed up our programs.
* Drive NPI and transfer to production, including pilot builds, line validation, and yield ramp, with time on-site during critical builds.

Systems Engineering & Compliance
 
 

* Guide Systems Engineering on requirements, architecture, DFMEA, and design verification across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and beverage subsystems.
* Oversee product safety and regulatory certification (UL, NSF, FCC, CE/UKCA, and food-contact requirements) so it supports international growth and stays off the critical path.

Team Leadership & Process
 
 

* Lead and grow a team of NPD, Systems, and Compliance engineers, including managers, aligned to one product roadmap.
* Recruit and develop engineering talent to build an organization that scales with Bevi's product strategy.
* Run a clear product development process, with phase gates and design reviews, that works for both in-house and partner-led programs.
* Champion the use of AI across the team to speed up design, analysis, testing, and documentation.

What We're Looking For
 
 

* 12+ years in hardware product development, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams that include managers.
* Ability to be in the office 3+ days per week.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, including extended trips to overseas manufacturing partners.
* A track record of scaling electromechanical products into high-volume production (tens of thousands of units or more), ideally in consumer electronics, appliances, or connected devices.
* Hands-on experience partnering with ODMs and overseas contract manufacturers (Asia strongly preferred), from spec through design iterations, NPI, tooling, and yield ramp, including time on the ground with them.
* Strong design-for-cost and DFM/DFA skills, with a record of driving down BOM and landed cost at volume.
* Knowledge of high-volume manufacturing processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, and automated assembly.
* Experience with systems engineering practices and bringing products through safety and regulatory certification.
* A practical, hands-on approach to using AI tools in engineering work.
