new_roles.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
new_roles.description:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Engineering Director***

***Salary****: $90,000 - $120,000*

**Experience:** 8+ years in Manufacturing Engineering discipline in Aerospace environment.

**Job Duties:**

* Responsible for coordinating and executing activities around the following: Leading technical teams in the improvement of current processes, transitioning new statements of work, being the focal point of communication between quality, operations, NC Programming and Planning.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to internal processes and standards to ensure a consistent product to the manufacturing floor.
* Collaborate with NC Programming, operations and Manufacturing Engineering on tool and fixture design.
* Review first part runs with Quality, Operations and NC Programming to verify a conforming part and acceptable manufacturing process.
* Mentoring and training of new Manufacturing Engineers/Planners.
* Interface with customer base to resolve engineering issues.
* Investigate and resolve manufacturing issues related to low profitability or excessive scrap.
* Engagement at the estimating stage on strategic packages to review engineering design and productivity concerns.
* Shop support and guidance on first article builds to ensure engineering compliance and manufacturing process design effectiveness.
* Provides planning, direction, and coordination for all technical activities while monitors performance to estimates, budgets and organization goals.
* Participates in developing organization and department goals and objectives.
* Manage and execute assigned projects to meet all project criteria on time and on budget.
* Transition Technical Phase of new work statements on time and achieve manufacturing targets.
* Be instrumental in reducing overall manufacturing costs of strategic work statements by reducing cycle times, setup, scrap, secondary operations content, raw material content and other process driven cost components.
* Enhance core competencies in complex machining and programming.
* Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
* Inspire coworkers to attain goals and pursue excellence.
* Recommend and implement process changes in order to improve cost, delivery, quality.
* Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.
* Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Leadership and Communications.
* Report progress and projects weekly to Leadership Team.
* Mitigate team conflict and communication problems.

**Education/Experience**

* A four-year Engineering degree and 8 years relative experience in an Aerospace Engineering discipline is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience in a Manufacturing Engineering discipline is preferred
* Extensive knowledge and experience in machining, inspection, tooling design, assembly, and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Familiarity with MRP systems and fundamentals
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is 100% onsite (Wichita KS)
* Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
* Some hours outside of office schedule may be required.
* Regular attendance is mandatory and must follow all work safety programs
* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand, to walk and sit for extended periods of time; to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds; to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds; to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects; to perceive the attributes of objects by touch; to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office. Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items. Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability & Voluntary options
* Employee Assistance Plan

Figeac Aero North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality
new_roles.description:
At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

 

The GE Appliances philosophy, backed by three simple commitments defines the way we work, invent, create, do business, and serve our communities: *we come together*, *we always look for a better way*, and *we create possibilities*.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must be able to maintain such authorization without current or future employer or school sponsorship. GE Appliances will not sponsor employment-based visas for this position now or in the future.

Interested in joining us on our journey?

 
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality leads a team supporting the execution of short-term and long term projects focused on product and process quality improvement. The role supports front-line leadership and development of both salary and hourly team members in support of the factory Manufacturing Control Plans. The role is responsible for working cross-functionally to execute the overall goal for reducing the cost of poor quality associated with plant operations and product performance post-sale.

**Position**
------------

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality

**Location**
------------

USA, Louisville, KY

**How You'll Create Possibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Live, promote and support the Appliance Production System (APS) philosophy and drive continuous improvement in the quality and adjacent areas. Coach all team members to ensure cross-functional, focused collaboration is the way we work.
* Partner with the Quality Improvement Engineering, Business Operations and Manufacturing Engineering Leaders to promote a culture that establishes, sustains and improves product quality through engineering problem solving and discipline around supporting systems. Promote a method-based quick response to new issues.
* Responsible for developing and tracking team performance metrics tied to the overall factory (FPY, EOLA, Scrap) and effect to the product line financial plan (Damage, Scrap). Leads the team to complete projects and tasks supporting this effort. Owns and assigns tasks and establishes accountability at the appropriate level.
* Closely collaborates with the product line Engineering, Field Quality and Service organizations to understand and respond to part or system product level performance issues impacting owner use and satisfaction. Responds to this data in addition to internal data streams (leading indicators) for product quality and reliability (Engineering, EOLA and audit labs).
* Identify and execute projects to improve the cost of operations. Serve as a broad owner for Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA), Corrective Action Request (CAR) approach to problem solving.
* Owner of the execution of attributes of the Manufacturing Control Plan for broad areas. Responsible for the training, execution, auditing and improvement of the Manufacturing Quality Control Plan. Support efforts intended to improve workstation documentation process; create, update and maintain Manufacturing Control Instructions (MCI’s), visual aid and alerts (single point lessons) as needed.
* Strong technical aptitude and ability to coach others in complex engineering topics like dimensional control, material properties, failure analysis as well as emerging technologies such as AI
* Support analysis of data as part of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and implementation of responses as required by MCI/MCP. Escalate and measure response to data trends. Validate root cause response for effectiveness.
* Lead and support 1x1 problem solving for quality systems and related issues collaborate cross functionally to improve product quality through the identification and elimination of root cause of issues. Focus on overall repair efficiency.

**What You'll Bring to Our Team**
---------------------------------

* 8+ Years of successful experience in Manufacturing / Quality, focused on providing operational support to support operations and vertical manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated expertise in a combination of Metrology, CMM or 3D scanning of complicated assemblies
* Ability to work within large cross-functional teams and at multiple levels in the organization.
* Demonstrated excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated experience as a hands-on problem solver including complex systems (supply, build, testing and diagnosis)
* Demonstrated leadership during technically challenging and complicated cross functional projects/tasks

**Desired Characteristics**

* Engineering degree with strong content tied to understanding and impact to business financial performance
* Quality Leadership experience
* Prior experience in a union environment
* Strong organizational skills- focused on project and resource management

### **Working Conditions**

### 

* Working conditions are normal for a high-volume manufacturing environment.
* Working in this environment will occasionally require the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to: eye safety glasses, hearing protectors, work boots, and hardhats.
* These roles require frequent walking in a manufacturing plant environment.
* Travel (up to 10%) to suppliers and other manufacturing locations as needed.
* This position will be located in Louisville, KY.
* Hours & Weekends: Working off-shift and weekends may be required.

**Our Culture**
---------------

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities. 
 
This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices. 
 
By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality, Fauna
new_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. We are hiring a Senior Manager to lead the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization supporting our robots from development through production. 
In this role, you will improve product and manufacturing quality while building the testing capabilities needed to scale. Your organization will support new product introduction through volume production across our facilities, suppliers, and manufacturing partners. 
You will build the team and its engineering leadership, set the technical direction, and establish quality standards and validation processes. You will turn changing product and manufacturing needs into a roadmap that supports higher production volumes and additional sites. 
The ideal candidate is a technically strong engineering leader who has improved quality and reliability for products where hardware and software must work together. They can evaluate test strategies and guide critical supplier, production, and reliability investigations. They grow engineers and leaders, and make clear decisions on scope and priority while product designs and manufacturing processes are changing. 
 
Key job responsibilities 

* Architect the quality, test engineering, and reliability organization. Assess capability gaps, define the staffing and investment plan, and hire and develop the engineering leaders and teams needed to scale.
* Establish supplier and factory quality teams, with Fauna engineers embedded at manufacturing sites. Strengthen and scale the quality system to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Define and lead the reliability strategy, working with our engineers to improve robot performance and durability.
* Build and scale reliability labs and test infrastructure to support product development and production growth.
* Scale and develop the manufacturing test engineering team, shaping its structure, growing its leaders, and strengthening its capabilities to support new products and increasing production volumes.
* Deploy and qualify production test systems across our facilities and manufacturing partners. Partner with the software and systems team on automation and traceable results, and improve repeatability, cycle time, and failure diagnosis.
* Partner with engineering and operations to embed quality, reliability, and testability into product design and production readiness.
* Establish quality and reliability metrics and use production, test, and field data to guide priorities and drive sustained improvement.

 
About the team 
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
 
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
 
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
 
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
 
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
* 10+ years in quality, test engineering, or reliability for complex electromechanical products.
* 5+ years managing multidisciplinary engineering teams, with a track record of building organizations and developing engineers and leaders.
* Experience scaling supplier and manufacturing quality through NPI and production ramp, with strong knowledge of quality systems.
* Technical depth in reliability and manufacturing test engineering, with experience scaling test programs and infrastructure for integrated hardware-software products.
* Strong command of statistical analysis and structured problem-solving, with demonstrated success turning engineering data into product and process improvements.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with robotics or autonomous systems.
* Experience leading engineering managers or distributed teams across multiple manufacturing sites.
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and suppliers globally
* Experience with product safety certification or formal quality management standards.

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager (Yokosuka, Japan)
new_roles.description:
**NORESCO, an OPTERRA Company**, helps customers modernize aging building systems and upgrade energy and water infrastructure to meet evolving demands. We implement innovative energy efficiency, distributed generation, energy storage, and renewable energy solutions that optimize the operational efficiency and improve resilience of buildings, campuses, military installations, and communities.

We are seeking an on-site Project Manager to oversee all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities (including repair and replacement work) at NORESCO’s 40 MW electric and thermal production facility at Yokosuka Naval Base, Japan. The cogeneration plant (CGS) is a critical asset for the base and daily operations are conducted by Navy personnel in partnership with NORESCO and our subcontractors.

NORESCO constructed the plant, which generates 50Hz and 60Hz power as well as a combination of Soft and Pure Steam, in 2008 under a Federal Energy Savings Performance Contract (ESPC). The plant pays for itself out of energy savings which NORESCO has guaranteed for the past 18 years. In order to meet our savings and availability guarantees, we employ a robust preventive maintenance program which relies heavily on Long Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) for all major pieces of equipment.

This is a Senior level position reporting to NORESCO’s Operations Manager and is administered through a 3 to 5 year International Assignment Agreement (IAA). This agreement is negotiated with each of our employees working Outside of the Continental Unites States (OCONUS). The agreement includes consideration for overseas pay, benefits, healthcare, housing, food, travel, vacation, stateside visits, relocation, etc., and is customized to the unique requirements of each new hire.

You will be the primary liaison between our NAVY customers, Japanese operators and subcontractors, as well as NORESCO team to ensure contractual obligations are met. While many of the team members in Japan speak English or are Bi-Lingual, some are not. Translators are available to facilitate conversations or process written correspondence as necessary. Japan is an amazing culture with many unique customs and protocols, a willingness to learn and adapt to their approach is an important part of your success.

It is of utmost importance for you to possess good listening, communication, and computer skills in addition to being proactive, organized, and having a bias for action. The Yokosuka Project Manager is supported by (and in-turn supports) many other NORESCO departments; Development, Engineering, Commissioning, O&M, M&V, Accounting, Legal, etc. Cross-functional technical skills, adaptability, versatility, and a quest for continuous learning and integration of advances are key in this position.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Overall contractual responsibility for plant maintenance and repair activities through careful management of Long-Term Service Agreements (LTSAs) and work orders.
* Ensuring subcontractor work is performed in a safe and professional manner with materials that meet or exceed applicable Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Regulatory standards.
* Participate in scheduled operations meetings and coordinate upcoming maintenance activities within the defined expectations and constraints of the customer and subcontractor availability.
* Prepare and distribute standard monthly reports (that summarize operations, maintenance, and repair activities) to NORESCO management, key customer contacts, and other stakeholders.
* Review plant operations logs, alarms, and performance data on a regular basis to evaluate equipment condition, collaborate with NORESCO team to identify potential issues.
* Perform plant inspections and safety walkthroughs during regular operations, confirm changes in equipment line-up, and subcontractor compliance with typical maintenance activities.
* Support Profit and Loss (P&L) management; assist with generating and maintaining the annual budget; capital expenditure planning; monthly forecasts, accruals, and variance analysis with development of recovery plans as needed to deliver the target revenue and profit.
* Review service agreements/proposals with manager; generate purchase orders as required; provide initial review and approval of invoices for materials and services.
* Collaborate with LTSA contractors to plan work and identify resources required for shutdown tasks such as parts, tooling, equipment, materials, and work procedures. Review and confirm subcontractors’ detailed work plans meet the customer and project needs.
* Maintain NORESCO’s Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to generate reports for maintenance schedules, completion status reports, equipment histories, and forecasts.
* Coordinate with subcontractors, visitors and customers to ensure protocols are followed on matters related to site access, security clearance, safety measures, and work permits.
* Monitor warranty programs to ensure the planned and required coverage is maintained by complying with all warranty requirements. Ensure warranty work is claimed in a timely manner, and all warranty issues are resolved to minimize out of pocket expenses.
* Monitor and analyze facility performance and host data for equipment and systems condition assessments. Review finings with Operations Manger and adjust maintenance plans accordingly.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelors degree, Associates degree, or equivalent Technical Training (ex; Navy Nuclear)
* 5+ years of experience in one of the following fields; electric power generation, cogeneration, industrial utility, or district energy industry with strong working knowledge of equipment
* Ability to obtain a Federal Security Clearance for work at Government facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**:

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management discipline or equivalent experience
* High level communication, leadership, technical, and project management skills.
* Strong sense of ownership and focus on maintaining; a Safe work environment, Uninterrupted Plant operations, Quality control, Project schedule, Resolving issues in a timely manner, and consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.
* Graduate degree in engineering or business administration
* Strong interest in engaging operators, customers, and partners to grow relationships.
* Advanced knowledge of one or more facets of Engineering or Central Plants operations; design principles, technologies, equipment maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Energy optimization, utility rates, energy costs, applicable codes, design guides, and standards.
* Robust combination of business acumen, risk management, and strategic thinking skills.
* US military or DOD project management experience, Japanese language skills, and international work experience are a plus.

**Physical requirements include:**

* Ability to climb stairs and fixed ladders.
* Ability to access rooftops and elevated work areas while following safety protocols.
* Ability to work at heights and in confined or industrial environments as required.
* Ability to maintain balance and mobility while navigating mechanical, utility, and production areas.

**Compensation:**

* $130,000 – $150,000 per year, depending on experience + bonuses

**Benefits:**

* HSA Medical insurance, with a choice of 2 buy-up options

new_roles.title: Senior Manager - Operations External Manufact
new_roles.description:
**Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing**

**About the Company:**

At Horizon Organic, we’re growing a culture of passionate people driven to do good for the horizon we all share. We’re building the tomorrow we want to see. Every single day.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your skills are valued, and your contributions make a real difference. We offer diverse opportunities for career growth and development. Embark on a rewarding journey with us in shaping the future of organic dairy!

Two generations of families—and counting—have grown up on Horizon Organic® milk. From the start, as the leading organic milk producer in the U.S., Horizon has been committed to delivering innovative, nourishing dairy that growing families can rely on. In 2023, Horizon Organic became a brand of Platinum Equity. Today, Horizon works with more than 500 farmers across the U.S. to bring high-quality, certified organic milk to consumers. For more information on Horizon’s full portfolio of organic dairy products, visit Horizon.com.

**About the Job:**

We are currently looking to hire a **Senior Manager, Operations External Manufacturing** to join our Supply Chain Department.

Leads external manufacturing operations and network optimization activities across contract manufacturing partners. This role is responsible for ensuring external manufacturing partners deliver excellence in Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery while supporting business growth, supply continuity, and operational effectiveness. The position partners closely with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to drive execution and continuous improvement across the external manufacturing network.

The Senior Manager - Operations External Manufacturing is responsible for the operational leadership of external manufacturing partners, management of manufacturing qualifications, execution of network optimization initiatives, and oversight of manufacturing performance across assigned facilities. This role develops and implements operational strategies, establishes performance expectations, leads cross functional initiatives, and ensures external manufacturing partners deliver products safely, efficiently, and in alignment with business objectives.

*This is a hybrid position with an expectation of 3 days per week on-site in Broomfield, CO.*

**This role may be responsible for, but not limited to:**

* Lead operational management of external manufacturing partners across assigned manufacturing networks.
* Oversee manufacturing qualification activities and support successful onboarding of new external manufacturing partners.
* Manage execution of network optimization initiatives, including transitions between manufacturing partners and facility rationalization activities.
* Establish and communicate operational performance expectations across Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery metrics.
* Monitor manufacturing partner performance and ensure corrective actions are identified, implemented, and sustained.
* Champion cross-functional project teams supporting network optimization, manufacturing transitions, and strategic initiatives.
* Partner with Procurement, PMO, Quality, R&D, Finance, Brand, Planning, Logistics, Customer Experience, and Milk Procurement teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and execute strategies that improve manufacturing performance, service levels, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate manufacturing capabilities and identify opportunities to optimize network performance.
* Ensure manufacturing partners operate in compliance with company standards, quality requirements, and operational expectations.
* Support supply continuity planning and mitigation activities associated with manufacturing risks and constraints.
* Analyze operational performance trends and develop recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with external manufacturing partners.
* Lead initiatives that improve collaboration, communication, and execution across the external manufacturing network.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership teams

*The base compensation range for this position is $125,000 - $140,000 commensurate with experience*.

**About You:**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or related disciplines.
* Experience working within Consumer Packaged Goods, food, beverage, dairy, or manufacturing environments.
* Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects.
* Experience managing suppliers, co-manufacturer, or contract manufacturing relationships.
* Experience developing and implementing operational strategies.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and consumer packaged goods operations.
* Experience managing external manufacturing partners, suppliers, or co-manufacturers.
* Strong strategic planning and network optimization capabilities.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to evaluate complex operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Strong project management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Proven ability to develop and implement operational strategies and performance improvements.
* Strong leadership and organizational effectiveness skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience managing external manufacturing networks.
* Experience supporting network optimization and manufacturing transition initiatives.
* Experience leading large cross-functional business projects.
* Experience working with contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting supply chain, logistics, planning, and procurement functions.
* Strong understanding of operational performance metrics and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Project management certification or formal project management training preferred.
* Ability to travel up to 25% or more as required.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Pilot Manufacturing Operations
new_roles.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are looking for an operational leader for our prototyping and development facility, which brings product and manufacturing engineering together under one roof to accelerate development. This is a high-mix, fast-changing environment where the product is in active development, and you will thrive in ambiguity while building robust systems that scale as we grow. 
 
In this role, you will serve as the operational backbone of our pilot builds across three core areas: (1) owning and executing build campaigns for successive product builds, (2) running a rapid prototyping and test shop that supports our engineering teams, and (3) operating manufacturing prototype lines to accelerate manufacturing process development. You will be the design-for-manufacturing (DFM) voice, translating engineering intent into build reality and feeding insights back to influence design. 
 
You will work closely with product design, supply chain and manufacturing engineering to ensure seamless handoffs and rapid iteration. This role requires a leader who combines an engineering mindset with the ability to build and manage a technician workforce, and who excels at creating effective operational systems such as build planning, warehouse management and operational efficiency metrics, all grounded in data. You will use data to drive manufacturing recommendations, identify bottlenecks and continuously improve operational performance. 
 
Key job responsibilities 
Build Operations
 

* Own the end-to-end operation for multiple concurrent build campaigns across product iterations. Develop, maintain, and deliver on the build plan.
* Build and maintain effective operational systems for build planning, resource allocation, traceability, yield, industrial analytics, and progress tracking. Establish clear metrics and reporting mechanisms for the team’s visibility.
* Manage integration between product design, supply chain, testing and manufacturing to ensure material availability, design-for-assembly feedback, and smooth production flow in a high-mix environment.
* Ensure alignment with the vendors ecosystem supplying the required parts for the builds.
* Coordinate with the test engineering team to ensure product builds and testing plans are aligned.
* Partner with the factory software team to implement and pilot the various manufacturing software systems.

 
Rapid Prototyping Shop
 

* Staff, manage, and operate the rapid prototyping shop (CNC machining, 3D printing/additive manufacturing, and other fabrication capabilities, metrology lab, and testing capabilities) in service of the various engineering teams.
* Prioritize and manage job queues across multiple concurrent programs to maximize throughput and accelerate development timelines.
* Ensure equipment uptime, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of shop capabilities to meet evolving engineering needs.

 
Manufacturing Prototype Line Operations
 

* Operate the manufacturing prototype lines to support and accelerate manufacturing process development in partnership with manufacturing and process engineers.
* Provide the operational environment, workforce, and data to enable process engineers to develop, validate, and refine manufacturing processes.
* Serve as the voice of manufacturing in product and process design reviews — providing data-driven feedback on manufacturability, assembly sequence, and process feasibility to influence upstream design decisions.

 
Leadership & Operational Excellence
 

* Recruit, hire, develop, and manage a high-performing team of manufacturing leads, technicians, machinists, and operations associates. Foster a culture of safety, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Build effective operational systems for warehouse management, inventory control, material flow, and facility operations. Drive operational efficiency through data, metrics, and mechanisms.
* Use data to support manufacturing recommendations, identify bottlenecks, track operational performance, and drive continuous improvement across all three operational domains.
* Act as the primary operational interface to product engineering teams (your customer) — ensuring their development velocity is enabled by world-class operational support.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or an equivalent field
* 10+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, pilot production, or prototyping environments for complex electromechanical products.
* Demonstrated experience hiring, building, and leading operational teams including technicians, machinists, and production associates.
* Experience managing build campaigns or production runs across multiple concurrent product configurations (high-mix environments).
* Proven ability to build and implement operational systems (build planning, scheduling, inventory management, metrics/reporting).
* Track record of using data and metrics to drive operational decisions and manufacturing recommendations.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with demonstrated ability to serve as the operational interface to product design and engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing and maintaining safety programs (EHS) in a manufacturing or prototyping environment, with a demonstrated commitment to workforce safety.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 15+ years of experience in manufacturing or pilot operations with progressive leadership responsibilities in high-mix, fast-evolving product environments.
* Experience in robotics, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or other advanced hardware development environments where product is in active development.
* Expertise in CNC machining, additive manufacturing (metal and polymer), and assembly processes for precision electromechanical systems.
* Experience building operational systems in manufacturing environments.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma, or similar data-driven continuous improvement methodologies.
* Master's degree in Engineering or Operations Management.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data-driven operational insights, risks, and resource needs to senior leadership.
* A proven track record of delivering results in a high-growth, ambiguous environment while demonstrating strong ownership and bias for action (aligned with Amazon Leadership Principles).
* Experience with MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems), ERP, or other manufacturing software platforms used to manage production operations and traceability

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Quality
new_roles.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. new_roles.title: Sr Manager - Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
**About us:** At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Driven by a passion for excellence, we partner with leading Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences and Industrial companies to design, manufacture and service some of the world’s most transformative products, including advanced surgical systems, diagnostic instruments, healthcare imaging equipment, mission critical aerospace systems, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.

**When we invest in our people, we invest in building a better world.**

With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. It is our values that unite us and guide us in everything that we do, including how we operate, behave and interact to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.

Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.

As a team member, you will engage in impactful work through global collaboration and the use of emerging technologies, join an inclusive culture where every team member is valued and working toward a greater purpose, and be empowered to reach your full potential through various development programs designed to accelerate your growth.

Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. We also prioritize work-life balance and offer a variety of perks to enhance the team member experience. For more information, visit our US benefits website at usbenefits.plexus.com. Our commitment to pay range transparency fosters an equitable workplace, where everyone can feel valued. The annual compensation range for this position is stated below. The salary offered within this range will be based upon the geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level. Salary Range:

$132,500.00 - $198,700.00

**Purpose Statement:** To provide leadership and direction to the Manufacturing Engineering team(s) from a functional perspective. Manage the Manufacturing Engineering function in line with functional specific strategies, process and systems development, people development, employee relations, plant level metrics.

**Key Job Accountabilities:**

* Lead manufacturing-engineering excellence by collaborating with various functional leads to ensure engineering capability meets or exceeds manufacturing standards for quality product delivery.
* Support Program Management initiatives and activities to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Lead process/product/equipment engineering activities in compliance with Plexus Core Values to meet industry standards, regulatory and customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to site operations, establish a technology roadmap, and collaborate with corporate and regional technical teams to achieve lower costs and higher manufacturing returns.
* Responsible to exemplify and hold their team accountable to demonstrating the Plexus Core Values. Leader will focus on evaluating potential, driving succession planning, and ensuring their employees receive the development and coaching required to realize their full potential.

**Education/Experience Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.
* Proven leadership skills and management experience.

*This document does not represent a contract of employment and is not intended to capture every possible assignment the incumbent could be asked to perform.*

We are pleased to provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities or special requirements. If you need an application accommodation, please contact us by email at GHQ.TA@plexus.com. Please include your contact information and clearly describe how we can help you. This email is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Some offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a drug screen and/or background check.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager of Production
new_roles.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:* 
*Gwynedd Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations
new_roles.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access
* Free Electric Vehicle charging
* Breakfast and Lunch Café
* After hours Grab & Go snacks
* Basketball court
* Walking paths

**Benefits**

* Paid Time Off
* Paid holidays
* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* 401(k) plan with immediate vesting
* Employee referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Professional development

At SENS, our culture is rooted in a set of core values that reflect who we are and how we work. In a recent 2025 poll, our employees identified the values that best define us: *“Innovative”, “Respectful”, “Inviting”, “Flexible”, “Collaborative”, and “Growth Driven”.* Our team describes us as a dynamic, forward-thinking company where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

We pride ourselves on being an equal opportunity employer, fully dedicated to fostering inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We hope you're interested in making a difference with us. Even if you don't feel that you meet every qualification listed in this job description, we still encourage you to apply.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Production Planning & Logistics – Development Programs (R5252)
new_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description:**

Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.

**What you'll do:**

Development Program Materials Planning

* Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy.
* Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule.
* Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans.
* Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.
* Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.
* Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions.

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness

* Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.
* Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.
* Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership

* Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.
* Establish standard work and training programs.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.
* Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.
* Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.
* Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.
* APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.
* Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

**Why Shield AI:**

At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.

new_roles.title: SR. Manager Human Resources, Manufacturing (People & Culture)
new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary:**

At The Coca-Cola Company, our people and culture are essential to how we create value, grow our business, and make a difference every day. We are looking for a **Senior Manager, Human Resources-People & Culture (Manufacturing)** who will bring strong business partnership, sound judgment, and hands-on People & Culture leadership to two manufacturing locations supporting both union and non-union associates.

 

This role is the Primary **People & Culture Leader and** visible face of **Human Resources at the plant** , serving as a trusted partner to plant leadership and an accessible resource for associates. The Senior Manager will report directly to the Plant Manager, with a dotted-line relationship to the Director, People & Culture, helping ensure strong alignment between plant priorities and broader People & Culture strategies, standards, and practices.

 

Success requires someone who can move comfortably between the plant floor and leadership discussions. You will listen to associates, coach leaders, navigate complex employee and labor relations matters, use workforce insights to inform decisions, develop talent, and translate business priorities into practical people solutions. The ideal candidate brings manufacturing Human Resources experience, labor relations capability, strong business acumen, a commitment to inclusion, and the ability to build credibility and trusted relationships at every level of the organization.

 

**Key Responsibilities and Position-Related Functions**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Serve as the senior on-site People & Culture partner for two manufacturing locations, providing hands-on leadership and support across union and non-union associate populations.
* Partner directly with the Plant Manager and plant leadership teams to translate operational and business priorities into actionable workforce, talent, culture, and organizational initiatives.
* Serve as the primary, visible People & Culture resource for associates, creating an approachable and trusted presence across shifts and levels of the organization.
* Coach and advise plant leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, performance management, accountability, employee development, workforce decisions, and people-related business challenges.
* Lead and support employee relations matters with objectivity, consistency, confidentiality, sound judgment, and appropriate partnership with the Director, People & Culture and other subject-matter experts.
* Support labor relations within the unionized location, including interpretation and consistent application of the collective bargaining agreement, issue resolution, grievance processes, and development of productive labor-management relationships.
* Partner with leaders to promote a positive, inclusive, safe, and respectful workplace where associates can contribute, grow, and thrive.
* Lead workforce planning discussions, using workforce data and operational insights to identify talent needs, retention risks, organizational opportunities, and appropriate actions.
* Strengthen leader capability in performance management, associate engagement, development conversations, conflict resolution, and consistent application of People & Culture practices.
* Partner with leaders on talent reviews, succession planning, career development, critical-role planning, and development opportunities that build plant capability.
* Support recruiting and selection activities in partnership with Talent Acquisition and plant leaders, including workforce requirements, candidate assessment, pre-employment activities, and an effective transition from candidate to associate.
* Lead and continuously improve new-hire onboarding and integration, helping new associates understand performance expectations, workplace culture, policies, resources, and ways of working.
* Provide guidance to associates and leaders on pay, benefits, leave, workplace policies, Human Resources programs, systems, and processes, engaging appropriate partners when specialized expertise is required.
* Analyze turnover, attendance, staffing, engagement, workforce demographics, and other people data to identify trends and translate insights into practical recommendations for plant leadership.
* Apply digital tools, automation, and artificial intelligence responsibly to improve People & Culture insights, efficiency, associate experience, and decision-making while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data stewardship.
* Ensure People & Culture practices and documentation are consistent with company policies, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and employment and labor requirements.
* Maintain accurate and appropriate associate records, documentation, systems, and reporting, with a strong focus on data integrity and confidentiality.
* Partner closely with the Director, People & Culture, keeping them informed of material plant activities, emerging workforce risks, labor and employee relations matters, and issues requiring escalation or broader functional support.
* Lead or support People & Culture programs, change initiatives, communications, events, and projects that strengthen organizational effectiveness and the associate experience across both locations.
Build effective partnerships across the broader People & Culture network and plant functions to solve problems, implement change, and deliver sustainable business and people outcomes. 

 

**Education and Qualifications**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial or Labor Relations, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* 7+ years of progressive Human Resources experience, with meaningful experience supporting manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, or another complex operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience supporting both **union and non-union employee populations** , including practical knowledge of labor relations, collective bargaining agreements, grievance management, and consistent contract administration.
* Experience serving as a trusted Human Resources partner to senior operational leaders and translating business priorities into effective people solutions.
* Strong employee relations capability, including experience evaluating complex workplace situations, conducting or supporting investigations, resolving conflict, managing risk, and determining when escalation or specialist partnership is appropriate.
* Strong working knowledge of employment practices, labor relations principles, performance management, leave practices, and Human Resources policy interpretation.
* Experience supporting hourly and salaried populations and building credibility with associates and leaders across multiple organizational levels and work schedules.
* Demonstrated capability in workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, associate engagement, organizational effectiveness, and leader development.
* Strong data literacy with the ability to interpret workforce metrics, identify meaningful trends, develop insights, and use evidence to influence business decisions.
* Digital fluency across Human Resources information systems and productivity platforms; experience with UKG/Kronos or comparable workforce management technology is preferred.
* Practical understanding of responsible artificial intelligence use and an ability to identify opportunities to apply digital and AI-enabled solutions to People & Culture work while protecting confidential associate information.
* Strong communication, coaching, influencing, facilitation, conflict-resolution, and relationship-building skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and make timely decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to lead through change, navigate ambiguity, and build alignment among stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities.
* Demonstrated commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace in which associates are treated with dignity and respect and have opportunities to contribute and develop.
* Ability to build productive partnerships across two locations while maintaining a strong, visible presence with plant leadership and associates.
Human Resources professional certification, such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR, is valued but not required. 

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

**Skills:**

Analytics Insights, Human Resources Policies, Human Resources Training, Leadership, Strategic Human Resources Leadership, Waterfall Model

**Pay Range:**

United States: 130,000 - 147,000 USD


*Base pay offered may vary depending on geography, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position, is offered.*

**Location(s):**

United States of America

**City/Cities:**

Ontario

**Travel Required:**

00% - 25%

**Relocation Provided:**

No

**Job Posting End Date:**

November 27, 2026

**Our Purpose and Growth Culture:**

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. When we collect your personal information as part of a job application or offer of employment, we do so in accordance with industry standards and best practices and in compliance with applicable privacy laws.
