At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**Raytheon Company, Managed by Collins Aerospace**

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our team as a Senior Manager, Program Quality Leader. This onsite role, based in El Segundo, CA will support Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) Avionics within Mission Systems. In this role, you will lead efforts and develop teams to effectively implement Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all program phases. You will serve as the primary Quality interface for customers, suppliers, and programs.

**What You Will Do**:

* Develop and lead a team of Program Quality Leads (PQLs) and Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) to support program execution and deliverables.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to establish effective relationships and influence decision-making across multiple levels within a cross-functional environment at multiple sites.
* Ensure quality requirements are integrated into program estimates and proposals and oversee their consistent application.
* Lead and oversee the implementation of Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all phases of assigned programs.
* Serve as the primary QMA interface for customers, suppliers, and internal program teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.
* Drive strategic improvements to enhance quality processes, reduce defects, and improve overall program performance.
* Oversee the development and application of quality metrics to identify root causes and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory quality standards, including ISO 9001, AS9100, and AS9102.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including program management, operations, and engineering, to ensure process capability, product conformance, and on-time delivery.
* Manage customer interface activities, including interactions with Acquisitioned Customers and Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Support manufacturing processes by interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and minimum 10 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced degree and minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience reviewing customer proposals and part orders for compliance risk to quality requirements, and establishing cost estimates for quality support.
* Experience leading teams in program management, quality management, operations management, or an engineering capacity.
* Experience as the direct interface to external customers.
* Experience with manufacturing processes, including quality systems and industry technical standards (ISO 9001 or AS9100), as well as interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Direct experience working with Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Certification in Customer Oriented Results and Excellence (CORE) or similar.
* American Society for Quality (ASQ) certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience leading initiatives that result in reduced operating costs, improved quality, and enhanced customer satisfaction.
* Experience with SAP (or similar ERP systems) and with Power Apps (or similar tools).

**What We Offer Benefits**

This position may offer relocation.

Some of our competitive benefits packages include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* And more!

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customers succeed today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

The next chapter of our future as an aerospace company is here, and we are excited about what this means for our employees and customers! Get onboard the Collins Aerospace Operations team and play a part in managing our innovative products from inception to delivery. The Operations team continues to grow and aims to strengthen the connection of Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain and Environment, Health & Safety (EH&S) across Collins Aerospace. In this dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to network across our businesses and functions, all while improving the productivity, quality and efficiency of our operations worldwide.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP)
new_roles.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team**,** fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture! 
Site: www.ptcbio.com

**Job Description Summary:**
----------------------------

The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP) is responsible for managing GxP Quality Assurance (QA) functions with an emphasis on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance for development products. This involves engaging and collaborating with cross-functional internal and external teams to evaluate processes, procedures, and activities for adherence to relevant industry standards, regulatory guidelines, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
The incumbent will support and/or conduct internal and external GCP audits of investigator sites, vendors, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, and submission documents, etc.
 
 
She/He will assist in inspection readiness activities. 
 
She/He may manage direct reports. 
 
The incumbent works cross-functionally with internal departments and external resources on GxP QA related issues.
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance – GxP (GCP)supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

*Responsibilities:*

* Partners with Clinical Development/Operations and actively participates in clinical study teams to ensure GCP compliance. Assists in identifying and communicating clinical trial-related risks and opportunities for process improvement. Reviews study-related documents and plans.
* Performs internal and external audits as assigned to ensure compliance with GXP regulations and guidelines.
* Communicates audit results to internal stakeholders and writes audit report.
* Assesses audit responses and ensures closure of corrective action preventative actions (CAPAs).
* Leads backroom activities during regulatory authority inspections and assists with GxP inspection readiness activities.
* Supports Quality Management System (QMS) including, but not be limited to, the following activities:
* QA review/approval of deviations, CAPAs and change controls.
* Drafts, reviews, and approves SOPs.
* May manage, coach, and mentor direct reports.
Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management. 

 

*Qualifications:*

Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance or related role in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related environment.

* Detailed knowledge and understanding of GCP regulations.
* Demonstrated experience leading and/or conducting QA audits.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing risk-based audit plans.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and foster positive, collaborative relationships with internal staff as well as with external, third-party vendors.
* Demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching, and mentoring direct reports.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency inspections.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.
* Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

*Special knowledge or skills and/or licenses or certificates preferred.*

* Experience writing and reviewing SOPs.
* Clinical lab experience.

* Registered GxP Quality Assurance Certifications.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) inspections.
* Knowledge and experience in Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and/or Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) regulations.

*Travel requirements: Up to 30% (Domestic and International)*

*Expected Base Salary Range: $141,900 -$175,000. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.*

*In addition to base salary, PTC employees are also eligible for short- and long-term incentives. All eligible employees may also enroll in PTC’s medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings plans*

**EEO Statement:**

**PTC Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.**

new_roles.title: IT Quality Senior Manager, Test Automation - Vice President
new_roles.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The IT Quality Senior Manager accomplishes results through the management of professional team(s) and department(s). Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Contributes to standards around which others will operate. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the entire function. Requires basic commercial awareness. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Has responsibility for volume, quality, timeliness and delivery of end results of an area. May have responsibility for planning, budgeting and policy formulation within area of expertise. Involved in short-term planning resource planning. Full management responsibility of a team, which may include management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary and terminations and may include budget approval.
 
 
**Responsibilities:**

* Performs initiatives related to User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process and product rollout into production. Testing specialists who work with technology project managers, UAT professionals and users to design and implement appropriate scripts/plans for an application testing strategy/approach. Responsibilities may also include software quality assurance testing.
* Manages multiple IT Quality teams or an IT Quality functional area (depending on size of business).
* Resolves complex and highly variable issues.
* Analyzes trends at an organizational level to improve processes; follows and analyzes industry trends.
* Develops and designs standards and procedures; ensures that they are adhered to throughout the software development life cycle.
* Manages organizational process change.
* Develops and implements methods for cost, effort and milestones of IT Quality activities. Strives for continuous improvements and streamlining of processes.
* Ensures consistency and quality of processes across the organization. Exhibits in-depth understanding of concepts and procedures within own area and basic knowledge of these elements in other areas.
* Requires in-depth understanding of how own area integrates within IT Quality and has basic commercial awareness.
* Evaluates subordinates' performance and makes decisions on pay increases, promotions, terminations, etc.
* Uses evaluative judgment in complicated or novel situations; uses multiple sources of information.
* Impacts IT Quality through delivery of end results and contribution to planning, finances/budget and formulation of policies.
* Responsible for budgeting, project estimates, task management & balancing prioritization across multiple streams of development
* Responsible for people management, mentoring and career development process for Shanghai team including delivering performance review, training, recruiting.
* Collaborates with local and global stakeholders like QA team, production support team, environment management team, DBA team, etc. to ensure project stability and productivity.
* Responsible for handling day-to-day staff management issues, including resource management and allocation of work within the team/project.
* Performs other duties and functions as assigned.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
* Playwright & TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery (Required): Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* CI/CD Pipeline Integration & Quality Gating (Required): In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including setting up automated regression triggering and pipeline hard gating.
* Containerization & Scaled Infrastructure (Strongly Preferred): Strong background in leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to containerize test suites and horizontally scale distributed test execution across enterprise environments.
* GenAI & Agentic Testing Workflows (Strongly Preferred): Experience using AI Harnesses (e.g., GitHub Copilot or Claude) and creating custom AI agents or automated agentic workflows to optimize the software testing lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

 
 

* Extensive hands-on experience designing and building scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.

* In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including automated regression triggering and pipeline gating.

* 6 to 10 years of IT testing experience, with excellent knowledge of software testing techniques and tools.

* Working knowledge of established software development and testing lifecycle methodologies.

* Full people management experience, including performance evaluation, hiring, and career development.

* Strong communication and diplomacy skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders across functions.

* An automation-first mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to test development.

**Education:**

 
 
 

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred
 

-

---------------------

Technology

-

**Job Family:**
---------------

-

--------------

Full time

-

---------------------

Jersey City New Jersey United States

-

**Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:**
--------------------------------------------

$129,840.00 - $194,760.00 

In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. Citi offers competitive employee benefits, including: medical, dental & vision coverage; 401(k); life, accident, and disability insurance; and wellness programs. Citi also offers paid time off packages, including planned time off (vacation), unplanned time off (sick leave), and paid holidays. For additional information regarding Citi employee benefits, please visit citibenefits.com. Available offerings may vary by jurisdiction, job level, and date of hire.

------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

**Other Relevant Skills**
-------------------------

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

-----------------------------------

Nov 23, 2026

**Automated Processing and AI**
-------------------------------

 
 

We use automated processing, including artificial intelligence, for our legitimate business interests (or our reasonable and appropriate business purposes) to identify and align the candidate's skills and abilities with a specific job opening. Additionally, if you so choose, or consent, we can match your skills and abilities to other suitable roles at Citi.

Importantly, all our hiring processes and decisions, including determining your suitability for a role, are conducted, checked, and decided by individuals. Our automated processing and AI do not involve relying on automatic or autonomous decision-making. Please refer to any Jurisdictional Considerations, with specific provisions for your country (where relevant) for further details.

new_roles.description:
**Be one of the Bedo 100**
--------------------------

Albedo is making Very Low Earth Orbit (VLEO) mainstream, building the infrastructure to enable every satellite mission to enter this new orbital domain. We build buses, integrated satellites, and turnkey missions for customers to thrive in VLEO, below 300 km, where proximity compounds performance and drag self-cleans debris.

As part of the first 100 employees at Albedo, you will have a big impact on Albedo's trajectory to proliferating VLEO — whether you're advancing hardware to increase satellite longevity, scaling production for large constellations, building next-gen flight and ground software to push performance, or enabling missions that matter for national security and our day-to-day life here on Earth.

**How We Operate:** Albedo takes a first-principles approach — in space and in business. We move with speed, take calculated risks, and learn quickly. We use AI regularly to create leverage in every discipline across the company. We work in-person at our Broomfield, CO HQ to maximize team and company productivity. We work hard and with urgency to compound our first-mover advantage.

**Who We're Looking For:** Builders who want to own outcomes, not tasks. Systems thinkers who balance precision with iteration while thinking about the big picture. Individuals who are energized by creating a category rather than competing in an existing one. You'll join a team that has already proven what others said wasn't feasible and is now scaling and upgrading our VLEO buses & payloads to serve mission sets across sensing, communications, and responsive operations.

If you can feel the excitement running through your veins, apply to be one of the Bedo 100.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Own Albedo's production operations across Supply Chain, Assembly, Integration & Test (AI&T), and Facilities, ensuring flight hardware is delivered on schedule, within budget, and to quality requirements.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of engineers, technicians, test personnel, and supply chain professionals, including hiring, performance management, and workforce planning.
* Develop and execute integrated production plans, aligning material readiness, build schedules, staffing, and test capacity across vehicle and subsystem builds.
* Set supply chain strategy and priorities, ensuring sourcing, supplier development, procurement, and long-lead planning stay ahead of production demand.
* Oversee AI&T execution from assembly through integration, functional and environmental testing, and delivery. Drive improvements in processes, tooling, and test infrastructure.
* Lead facilities and production infrastructure planning, including buildout, commissioning, equipment, capacity expansion, and EHS.
* Establish and track operational metrics, including supplier delivery, material readiness, schedule adherence, labor efficiency, throughput, and first-pass yield.
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Finance to transition designs into production, resolve risks, and align resources and priorities.
* Identify and prioritize improvements to production processes, tooling, and systems, balancing cost, schedule, and scalability.
* Lead major operational initiatives, including production rate increases, facility stand-up, and ERP/MES implementations.
* Remove roadblocks, support hands-on problem-solving, and champion a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

### **Your Ideal Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8–12+ years of experience in aerospace or complex hardware manufacturing, spanning production, AI&T, and supply chain, with 5+ years leading technical teams.
* Proven ability to build and manage multidisciplinary teams, including hiring, workforce planning, performance management, and employee development.
* Strong understanding of spacecraft or similarly complex hardware assembly, integration, and test, including mechanical, electrical, functional, and environmental testing.
* Working knowledge of demand planning, MRP, strategic sourcing, supplier management, and long-lead procurement.
* Experience scaling manufacturing operations and facilities, including equipment, tooling, capacity planning, and EHS.
* Ability to balance cost, schedule, quality, and technical risk while identifying constraints and driving operational improvements.
* Experience managing operational KPIs, with familiarity in ERP/MRP, MES, QMS, configuration management, and aerospace workmanship standards.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with a hands-on, solutions-oriented approach suited to a fast-paced startup environment.

### **Salary Range:**

* $163,955 - $184,794 per year

#### **Compensation and Benefits for Full-Time Roles:**

* + Employee friendly equity compensation
 + 4% direct matching 401k
 + Health Insurance: 100% employee coverage & 75% dependent coverage
 + Parental leave and childcare coverage
 + Flexible vacation and sick time from day one
 + 12 company holidays
 + $100 monthly wellness benefit
 + Relocation package if not based in Denver

*The final compensation package is subject to change if the candidate's experience and company need drive a different job level than originally slated for the position.*

*Albedo does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Albedo employees. Albedo is not responsible for any fees or overhead related to unsolicited resumes.*

**AI Disclosure:** We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology to support and enhance our recruitment process. This includes recording, transcribing, analyzing, and evaluating your interview responses to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient assessment of job-related skills, knowledge, and abilities. While AI tools may assist in this process, our human recruiting and hiring teams make all hiring decisions. For questions about AI use in interviews, data handling, or to request accommodations, contact Hello\_HR@albedo.com

 

**Additional Requirements:** In compliance with federal law, all persons hired must verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. All persons hired will be required to be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled:** Albedo is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Relocation:** Relocation support for this position is available

Applicants must be a **U.S. Person** as defined under 22 CFR 120.62

#LI-Onsite

*Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Albedo, we'd rather hear from you. We care more about how you think than which boxes you check. We value people who do the math, make their assumptions explicit, and ask the annoying questions: what breaks, what's the failure mode, what has to be true for this to work? If that sounds like you, apply, even if you don't meet every line.*

new_roles.description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.

**Job Summary**
---------------





**General Purpose** **:**

Responsible for leading and developing a team of process engineers and technicians responsible for SMT manufacturing processes and continuous improvement. Provides technical and organizational leadership to establish and improve manufacturing process capabilities, increase capacity and throughput, reduce cost, improve quality and reliability, and support successful introduction of new products. Partners closely with Operations, Quality, Product Engineering, NPI, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functional teams to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, quality, delivery, cost, and capacity requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities** **:**

* Lead, coach, develop, and manage a team of process engineers and technicians supporting SMT manufacturing, including board printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and other back-end operations, excluding Box Assembly.

* Establish clear goals, priorities, performance expectations, and development plans for engineering team members. Provide regular coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.

* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve process capabilities to achieve required levels of quality, reliability, throughput, capacity, and cost.

* Develop and maintain process documentation, including work instructions, PFMEA, Control Plans, process specifications, and other applicable manufacturing documentation.

* Lead engineering efforts to identify and eliminate process variation, defects, scrap, rework, downtime, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency.

* Use data-driven problem-solving and appropriate engineering methodologies, including statistical analysis, SPC, DOE, root-cause analysis, and structured corrective action, to resolve complex manufacturing issues.

* Develop and maintain appropriate engineering and manufacturing performance metrics.

OEE, scrap, and yield to name a few

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, collaboration, problem solving, and ownership within the engineering organization.

* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, standards, and best practices and share lessons learned across the organization.

* Ensure engineering activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality-system, regulatory, customer, and company requirements.

* Build effective relationships with internal and external customers, suppliers, equipment manufacturers, and other technical partners as required.

* Communicate engineering priorities, project status, risks, resource requirements, and recommendations effectively to site and senior leadership.

* Implement appropriate HR strategies and actions to recruit, retain, develop, and motivate a qualified and high-performing engineering workforce.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE:**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience and training. A Master's or MBA degree is a plus but not required.

Typically requires **9 years** of engineering experience, including experience leading or supervising engineering personnel. Experience in high-volume electronics manufacturing and SMT processes is strongly preferred.

 

**KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / ABILITIES:**

* Demonstrated functional, technical, and people-management skills, with the ability to lead engineers and technicians in a manufacturing environment.

* Strong knowledge of SMT manufacturing processes, including solder paste printing, SPI, pick and place, reflow, AOI, X-ray, and related manufacturing processes.

* Demonstrated understanding of process capability, statistical process control, root-cause analysis, DOE, PFMEA, Control Plans, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence decisions across Engineering, Operations, Quality, NPI, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and other functions.

* Ability to establish priorities, allocate resources, manage competing projects, and make sound engineering and business decisions.

* Demonstrated ability to use manufacturing and engineering data to identify problems, establish facts, determine root causes, and drive measurable improvements.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing economics, including cost reduction, capacity, throughput, capital investment, and return on investment.

* Demonstrated ability to develop, coach, and retain engineering talent and build a high-performing team.

* Strong interpersonal, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

* Ability to communicate complex technical information effectively to engineers, technicians, operations personnel, customers, and senior management.

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex technical, engineering, financial, and business documents.

* Ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and complaints and resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate communication.

* Ability to make effective and persuasive presentations regarding technical recommendations, business cases, project status, and complex engineering issues.

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts including probability, statistical inference, process capability, and statistical analysis and apply them to practical manufacturing situations.

* Ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and develop practical solutions.

* Demonstrated proficiency with common engineering and business software, including word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, data analysis, and other applicable manufacturing/engineering systems.

* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, company policies, and HR practices.

 

JT05

AA01

LB34

 
 

**What you'll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Full range of medical, dental, and vision plans
* Life Insurance
* Short-term and Long-term Disability
* Matching 401(k) Contributions
* Vacation and Paid Sick Time
* Tuition Reimbursement

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager Accounting Operations
new_roles.description:
Nova Biomedical: One Global Brand. One Vision. Together under one name.

Advanced Instruments and Nova Biomedical are now united under one brand, Nova Biomedical, marking a major milestone in our journey to deliver greater value to our customers. By combining our strengths, we're accelerating innovation, supporting critical workflows, and delivering world-class service across the biopharmaceutical and clinical markets.

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager Accounting Operations leads the organization’s payables and receivables functions, ensuring accurate and timely transaction processing, effective cash management, strong internal controls, and excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. This role manages daily operations, develops team capability, drives process improvements, and partners across Finance, Procurement, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to resolve issues and support business objectives.

**Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Leadership and team management:** Lead, coach, and develop Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable staff; establish priorities, clarify responsibilities, monitor performance, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented culture.
* **Accounts Payable:** Oversee invoice processing, approval workflows, vendor maintenance, payment runs, employee expense reimbursements, and issue resolution while ensuring payments are accurate, timely, properly authorized, and compliant with company policies.
* **Accounts Receivable:** Oversee customer invoicing, cash application, account reconciliation, collections, credit administration, dispute resolution, and aging review to support timely cash conversion and minimize past-due balances.
* **Travel Management:** Lead global adoption and upkeep of SAP Concur, manage global travel policy, partner with global travel management vendor, liaise with Treasury on credit card solutions and integrations to Concur and ERP, and reconcile related balance sheet balances and accruals.
* **Close and reconciliation:** Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and year-end close activities, including subledger reconciliations, accrual support, aging analysis, and resolution of reconciling items.
* **Controls and compliance:** Maintain strong internal controls, segregation of duties, and complete documentation; support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and company policies.
* **Cash flow and reporting:** Monitor payables and receivables trends, prepare cash requirement and collection forecasts, and provide accurate metrics and analysis to Finance leadership.
* **Process improvement:** Identify and implement opportunities to standardize, automate, and streamline processes; strengthen data quality, cycle time, scalability, and the stakeholder experience.
* **Systems and master data:** Support effective use of ERP, banking, expense, and workflow systems; maintain accurate vendor and customer master data and participate in system implementations or enhancements.
* **Business partnership:** Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, Treasury, Tax, and other partners to address root causes, resolve escalated issues, and improve end-to-end processes.
* **Risk management:** Implement controls that reduce fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorized transactions, bad debt, and credit exposure; escalate significant risks promptly.
* Develop, document, and maintain policies, procedures, service standards, and business continuity plans for both functions.
* Perform other responsibilities and special projects as assigned.

**Experience Requirements:**

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, accounting operations, or a related field, including at least three years of people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated knowledge of invoice-to-pay and order-to-cash processes, general ledger interfaces, reconciliations, month-end close, internal controls, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort using reporting and workflow tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions and with customers and vendors.
* High degree of accuracy, integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* CPA, CMA, CAPP, CICP, or other relevant professional certification preferred.
* Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency, manufacturing, life sciences, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Experience with shared services, system implementation, process automation, or continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Concur preferred.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:**

* Comfort with working at a computer for extended periods.

* Capacity to lift and carry up to [25–50] pounds as required

* Able to communicate effectively via phone, video, and written communication.

* Occasional need to move about the office to access meetings or resources.

**Why Work for Nova Biomedical**

* Flexible Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
* Competitive 401k company match
* Bonus Program, Generous PTO and paid holidays
* Generous Tuition reimbursement
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Professional development, engagement and events
* Company marketplace for lunch and snacks in our Norwood, MA, Billerica, MA and Westbrook, ME offices
* Company subsidized cafeteria in our Waltham, MA office

**Work Location:** Hybrid in **Waltham, MA**

**Targeted Salary Range:** **$180,000-$220,000/yr**

Nova Biomedical believes in transparency and integrity throughout all we do, including compensation. The provided salary range for this role represents the expected base salary or hourly rate for this opening. Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and may vary based on individual factors such as location, skills, and education.
 
 
About the company

At Nova Biomedical, we’re not just building instruments, we’re powering breakthroughs that improve lives. Our smart, science-driven solutions are trusted in over 100 countries to speed drug development and enhance patient care.

Our integration brings together more than 70 years of scientific excellence with Nova’s cutting-edge innovation, forming a powerhouse of precision, purpose, and possibility. With FDA-registered, ISO-certified manufacturing, more than 125 FDA approvals, and industry-trusted diagnostics, we’re setting new standards in quality and reliability. Nova Biomedical is proud to be a global leader in osmolality testing and biotechnology and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) instrumentation, dedicated to advancing patient care and scientific discovery with a legacy that continues to shape the future of life sciences.

With headquarters in Norwood and Waltham, Massachusetts, and a global team of nearly 2,000 employees, we’re building a collaborative, empowered culture grounded in shared values: Customer Centricity, Ingenuity, Ownership & Accountability, Collaboration, and Integrity.

Working at Nova Biomedical means joining a mission-driven organization where your contributions matter. Whether you're in engineering, science, manufacturing, or support, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, invests in your growth, and is committed to making a real-world impact on global health.

Explore what’s next with us at novabiomedical.com

new_roles.title: Director, Program Operations
new_roles.description:
In this role, the Director of Program Operations leads a team of Operations Program Managers (OPM) and Material Program Managers (MPM) responsible for the operational elements of program execution within Mercury's PCC Manufacturing Center of Excellence. This role serves as a conduit between the line of business and operational teams, ensuring seamless coordination across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and growth functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing operational program plans for critical programs, overall ownership of operational program performance, and internal communication of customer requirements affecting operational execution.

The Director of Program Operations will support proposals by providing accurate basis of cost estimates, focusing on supply chain material costs in addition to manufacturing labor costs. This work will be performed in conjunction with factory operations, supply chain, and engineering functions. Candidates must have excellent written and oral communications skills to influence across multiple functions and communicate effectively with external partners.

This role is on site at one of the following Mercury facilities: **Phoenix AZ**

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of OPMs and MPMs accountable for operational aspects of program life cycle from proposal, development, production, sustainment, & delivery.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the line of business and operations, communicating customer requirements that affect manufacturing and supply chain execution.
* Responsible for meeting the financial objectives of the business unit, including the management of Estimate at Completion (EACs) specific to operations labor and material content.
* Oversee supply chain and manufacturing milestones to ensure compliance with contract baseline.
* Monitor program risks and opportunities, including obsolescence management, reporting, and improvement actions.
* Support and present operations metrics and data through program reviews (both internal and external) to Mercury and customer leadership.
* Champion efforts to meet readiness requirements throughout an NPI stage-gate process.
* Change leader, helping to drive Mercury's strategy, structure, and values.
* Strategic thinking coupled with ROI / business case development.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree.
* Typically requires 10+ years prior relevant experience in functional areas of Supply Chain, Operations (including Production Control), Program Management, or technical Project Management.
* Strong financial acumen with experience providing input into and reviewing EACs, along with development of business cases.
* Experience in review and understanding of Statements of Work (SOW) and project requirements (technical and commercial).
* Strong analytical skills, problem‑solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
* Experience developing and mentoring high‑performing teams.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A self-starter, capable of achieving organizational and program objectives, and able to interface with all levels of internal management and external stakeholders.
* Ability to succeed in fast paced, developmental environment.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to assign the appropriate priorities to the many tasks that need to be performed.
* Knowledge of US Government acquisition laws and regulations (FAR).
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP business systems.
* Knowledge of Mercury-type products with surface mount technology.
* Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), leadership abilities, and the ability to work in an IPT environment.

new_roles.title: Senior Operations Director
new_roles.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Operations Director to oversee business operations, strengthen financial performance, and improve organizational efficiency. This position is suited for a senior leader who understands how operational decisions affect profitability, resource allocation, and long-term business growth.

The Senior Operations Director will work closely with executive leadership, Finance, and department managers to establish operational priorities, improve internal processes, and ensure that business activities support financial and strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate brings extensive management experience, strong financial judgment, and a practical approach to solving complex operational challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Lead daily business operations and develop operational strategies that support organizational growth and financial performance.

Oversee departmental budgets, operating expenses, financial forecasts, and resource allocation in collaboration with Finance.

Monitor operational performance, profitability, productivity, and key financial indicators to identify opportunities for improvement.

Develop and implement processes that improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary costs, and strengthen organizational accountability.

Work with executive leadership to establish annual operating plans, business priorities, and performance objectives.

Evaluate financial reports, cash flow projections, operating margins, and profit and loss performance to support business decisions.

Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Finance, Human Resources, Business Development, and other operational departments.

Identify operational risks, improve internal controls, and support compliance with applicable business requirements.

Oversee vendor relationships, contract performance, procurement activities, and operational expenditures.

Introduce technology and automation solutions that improve reporting accuracy, workflow efficiency, and business performance.

Establish performance standards and management reporting procedures across operational teams.

Lead, mentor, and develop department managers while maintaining clear accountability for operational results.

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive experience in business operations, corporate management, financial operations, or related leadership positions.

At least 8 years of management experience overseeing operational teams, departmental budgets, or cross-functional business initiatives.

Strong understanding of financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and profit and loss analysis.

Demonstrated experience improving operational efficiency, managing business resources, and supporting organizational growth.

Experience developing operational strategies, managing performance indicators, and implementing process improvements.

Strong knowledge of financial reporting, cash flow management, business analytics, and operational risk assessment.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, enterprise management systems, and business intelligence tools.

Excellent organizational leadership, strategic planning, problem-solving, and executive communication skills.

A bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, or a related discipline is required. An MBA or relevant advanced degree is preferred.

Ideal Candidate

You are an accomplished operations leader who understands the connection between financial discipline, operational efficiency, and business performance.

You have extensive experience managing complex operations, developing capable management teams, and improving business processes.

You are comfortable working with senior executives, evaluating financial information, and making decisions that affect organizational performance.

You bring sound financial judgment, strong leadership skills, and the ability to balance immediate operational needs with long-term business priorities.

You are focused on building efficient operations, maintaining financial accountability, and delivering measurable business results.

Pay: $206,200.00 - $256,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Relocation assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

new_roles.title: Revenue - Director of Special Projects and Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

A best-in-class city that attracts best-in-class talent, Philadelphia is an incredible place to build a career. From our thriving arts scene and rich history to our culture of passion and grit, there are countless reasons to love living and working here. With a workforce of over 30,000 people, and more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia offers boundless opportunities to make an impact.

As an employer, the City of Philadelphia values inclusion, integrity, innovation, empowerment, and hard work above all else. We offer a vibrant work environment, comprehensive health care and benefits, and the experience you need to grow and excel. If you’re interested in working with a passionate team of people who care about the future of Philadelphia, start here.

***What we offer***

* **Impact** - The work you do here matters to millions.
* **Growth** - Philadelphia is growing, why not grow with it?
* **Diversity & Inclusion** - Find a career in a place where everyone belongs.
* **Benefits** - We care about your well-being.

***Agency Description***

The mission of the Department of Revenue is to collect tax and non-tax revenue due to the City and tax revenue due to the School District of Philadelphia while providing service to customers that is fair and efficient and ensuring that the City provides services that the residents can see, touch, and feel. The Department’s revenue collections enable the Administration to invest in the Mayor’s strategic priorities, including housing, education, and making Philadelphia the safest, cleanest, and greenest big city in the nation with economic opportunity for everyone.

***Work-Life***

Working hours are generally 37.5 hours per week. Our team is full-time on office days.

 **Job Description**

The Continuous Improvement Director leads the Continuous Improvement pillar within the Revenue Strategic Transformation division. This role identifies, prioritizes, and delivers process improvement initiatives that increase operational efficiency, reduce waste, and improve the experience of both employees and the residents and businesses the department serves.

The CI Director brings a disciplined improvement practice to a large public organization: mapping how work actually flows, finding where it breaks down, and redesigning it in partnership with the units that own it. Success depends on facilitation, analytical rigor, and the ability to see how decisions in one part of the department create consequences in another.

The CI Director owns the improvement methodology, process mapping and redesign discipline, customer satisfaction measurement, documentation standards, and the training that builds continuous improvement capability across the department. The role leads a small team and is expected to develop that team, not simply directing its work.

The CI Director works in close partnership with the Executive Director, who provides strategic direction, and coordinates with the division's other pillars: Operations, Project Management, Change Management, and Innovation and Advanced Analytics.

***Essential Functions***

Continuous Improvement of Methodology and Execution

* Design and maintain the department's continuous improvement framework, applying Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root cause analysis, and process redesign methods as appropriate to each initiative.
* Lead current-state process mapping across business units, documenting workflows, identifying waste, rework, and handoff failures, and designing future-state processes in partnership with the relevant unit.
* Lead improvement initiatives from intake through implementation, ensuring changes are measurable, sustainable, and owned by the business unit responsible for execution.
* Design and maintain controls and monitoring mechanisms so improvements are sustained and do not revert to prior practice.
* Apply design thinking to identify where a local improvement would create downstream burden elsewhere, and design accordingly.

2. Intake and Prioritization

* Capture improvement opportunities from business unit requests, performance data, customer feedback, staff suggestions, and strategic priorities.
* Apply a structured prioritization framework covering feasibility screening, scoring, and portfolio balancing to select initiatives that deliver the highest value relative to effort and risk.
* Operate the shared intake and routing protocol with the Project Management Office and the Innovation and Advanced Analytics unit, so that improvement requests, project requests, and pilot concepts follow one clear path.
* Maintain a portfolio tracker providing visibility into active, pipeline, and completed initiatives with documented outcomes.

3. Customer Satisfaction Measurement

* Own design, distribution, and analysis of customer satisfaction surveys, including the external survey of residents and businesses and the internal business unit survey.
* Produce and distribute monthly reports with trend analysis and actionable insight.
* Route improvement opportunities identified through customer feedback into the intake process.
* Coordinate with Communications on distribution and messaging, and with Innovation and Advanced Analytics on data integration and reporting.

4. Standards, Procedures, and Process Documentation

* Establish departmental standards for processing documentation so procedures, workflows, and operational guides are created and maintained consistently across units.
* Provide templates, frameworks, and guidance to business units documenting their own processes, with Continuous Improvement serving as the quality standard-setter.
* Maintain a central repository of documented processes accessible to leadership and business units.

5. Training, Culture, and Team Development

* Develop and deliver a continuous improvement education plan tailored to three audiences: executive leadership for strategic awareness, managers and supervisors for application skills, and frontline staff for mindset and participation.
* Integrate a continuous improvement introduction into departmental onboarding in partnership with Human Resources.
* Identify and develop improvement champions within business units who sustain the practice beyond individual initiatives.
* Directly develop the Continuous Improvement Specialist and Project Coordinator, building their capability in process mapping, intake discipline, and initiative support.

6. Reporting and Impact Measurement

* Track and report measurable outcomes for each initiative: time saved, errors reduced, cost avoided, satisfaction improved, or other relevant metrics.
* Produce quarterly impact reports for the Executive Director documenting portfolio progress, results achieved, and lessons learned.
* Use outcome data to support the case for continued investment in staffing, tools, and initiative scope.

***Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities***

* Proven leadership in strategic planning, organizational development, and change management.
* Expertise in Lean Six Sigma, process mapping, and performance benchmarking.
* Strong ability to lead cross-functional teams and foster collaboration.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Advanced analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

 **Qualifications**

***Required***

* Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in continuous improvement, process improvement, or operational excellence.
* Lean Six Sigma certification at Green Belt or higher, or equivalent recognized process improvement certification.
* Demonstrated command of improvement methodologies and the judgment to select the right approach for a given problem.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional improvement initiatives from intake through measurable results.
* The ability to see how processes connect across an organization and how a change in one area affects others.
* Strong facilitation, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience supervising, mentoring, or developing staff.

***Preferred***

* Master's degree in a related field.
* Experience in government, public sector, or nonprofit organizations.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent advanced certification.
* Change management certification such as Prosci.
* Project management certification such as PMP.
* Experience designing and analyzing customer satisfaction surveys and Net Promoter Score programs.
* Experience building an improvement function where none previously existed.

 **Additional Information**

**TO APPLY:** **Interested candidates must submit a resume.**

Salary Range: $90,500 - $115,000

**Discover the Perks of Being a City of Philadelphia Employee:**

* **Transportation**: City employees get unlimited **FREE** public transportation all year long through SEPTA’s Key Advantage program. Employees can ride on SEPTA buses, subways, trolleys, and regional rail for their daily commute and more.
* Parental Benefits: The City offers its employees 8 weeks of paid parental leave.
* We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
* Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan
* Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
* Generous retirement savings options are available
* **Pay off your student loans faster** - As a qualifying employer, City of Philadelphia employees are eligible to participate in the Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. Join the ranks of hundreds of employees who have already benefited from this program and achieved student loan forgiveness.
* **Unlock Tuition Discounts and Scholarships** - The City of Philadelphia has forged partnerships with over a dozen esteemed colleges and universities in the area, ensuring that our employees have access to a wide range of tuition discounts and scholarships. Experience savings of 10% to 40% on your educational expenses, extending not only to City employees but in some cases, spouse and dependents too!

Join the City of Philadelphia team today and seize these incredible benefits designed to enhance your financial well-being and personal growth!

* ***The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire***

Effective May 22, 2023, vaccinations are **no longer required** for new employees that work in non-medical, non-emergency or patient facing positions with the City of Philadelphia. As a result, only employees in positions providing services that are patient-facing medical care (ex: Nurses, doctors, emergency medical personnel), must be fully vaccinated.

The City of Philadelphia is an Equal Opportunity employer and does not permit discrimination based on race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, source of income, familial status, genetic information or domestic or sexual violence victim status. If you believe you were discriminated against, call the Philadelphia Commission on Human Relations at 215-686-4670 or send an email to faqpchr@phila.gov.

For more information, go to: Human Relations Website: http://www.phila.gov/humanrelations/Pages/default.aspx

new_roles.description:
Director, Quality Assurance - Homebased - Blue Bell and Rochester 
 

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

 
 

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

 
 

As a Director, Quality Assurance at ICON, you will ensure the quality and compliance of clinical trials, interpret regulatory requirements, and contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.

 

**What You Will Do:**

Your focus will be on driving quality assurance and compliance performance, ensuring quality, and building capability across your area (specifically Imaging and Cardiac Services).
 
 
Key responsibilities include:

 

* Serving as the QA business partner to Medical Imaging and Cardiac Services leadership and teams, providing strategic guidance on quality, regulatory compliance, and emerging risk.
* Leading the development and implementation of quality assurance strategies and processes to support clinical trial activities including establishing quality priorities with leadership and integrating quality considerations into business and operational planning.
* Conducting comprehensive quality assessments and audits to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and guidelines.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and address quality issues and implement corrective actions as needed; analyzing quality trends to identify systemic risk and preventive improvement opportunities
* Providing expert guidance and support to staff regarding quality assurance policies, procedures, and best practices.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of quality management systems and documentation. Promote a proactive culture of quality and continuous improvement.
* Establish quality priorities with IMC leadership and integrate quality considerations into business and operational planning.
* Provide strategic oversight of the risk-based IMC audit program, including internal and vendor audits.
* Represent Quality & Compliance in strategic sponsor relationships, governance, and significant quality escalations. Support the development, interpretation, and governance of quality agreements.
 

**Your Profile:**

You will bring significant quality assurance and compliance experience, with a track record of building high-performing teams and delivering results.
 
 
Required qualifications and experience:

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in quality assurance within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, Medical Imaging or CRO industry, with significant experience in a leadership role.
* Extensive knowledge of regulatory requirements and guidelines governing clinical trials (e.g., ICH-GCP, FDA regulations). Knowledge of AI governance and regulations is advantageous.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex quality issues.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Strong leadership skills including cross functional management
* Willingness to travel as required (approximately 25%)
 

 

#LI-FB2

#LI-Homebased

 
 

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

 
 

**Rewards & Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

 
 

Benefits may include:

* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable

new_roles.description:
**Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R-264366 **Date posted** 17/11/2026

 

**WHY JOIN US?**

At AstraZeneca, we are dedicated to being a Great Place to Work, where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. With an ambitious goal of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, there is no better place to make a difference in medicine, for patients, and in society.

Join us on this exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare. Our inclusive culture champions diversity and collaboration, and we are always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. As part of our team, you'll contribute to groundbreaking advancements that will shape a healthier future for people everywhere. Be a catalyst for change at AstraZeneca, where your work will have a real impact on improving people's lives.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by **engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week**. Our head office is purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.**This is a hybrid role located in Gaithersburg, Maryland. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of Gaithersburg or be willing to relocate for this opportunity.****About the Role**

The Director, Quality Systems is a senior leader within Development Quality Biologics (DQB), accountable for strategy, governance, performance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) supporting Biologics Development.

The role provides leadership and oversight for critical Quality Systems processes, including Deviation and CAPA Management, Change Control, Quality Risk Management, Inspection Management, Documentation Management, Quality Management Review, and GxP Training and Learning. The Director also leads Business Process Management (BPM) within DQB, ensuring business and quality processes are effectively owned, defined, governed, measured, and continuously improved.

The Director leads a team of up to 12 employees and partners broadly across DQB, Biopharmaceutical Development (BPD), Development Quality, Global Quality, and other functions to deliver a compliant, efficient, risk-based, and future-ready QMS.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead the DQB Quality Management System, providing strategy, governance, and oversight to ensure Quality Systems are compliant, effective, risk-based, phase-appropriate, and fit for purpose.

* Provide leadership for core Quality Systems processes, including deviations and CAPAs, change control, quality risk management, inspection management and readiness, documentation management, Quality Management Review, GxP training, and associated metrics and trending. Champion excellence in fundamental Quality processes like root cause analysis and effective CAPA development, risk mitigation, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement.

* Lead Business Process Management within DQB, establishing clear process ownership, governance, performance measures, and improvement mechanisms. Drive simplification, standardization, and elimination of non-value-added activities while maintaining appropriate compliance and control.

* Drive QMS performance and continuous improvement through meaningful metrics, trending, management review, risk identification, and data-driven insights. Translate QMS performance into clear priorities and actions for DQB and BPD leadership.

* Ensure sustainable inspection readiness, including effective preparation, execution, response, and follow-up for regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring learnings are incorporated into Quality System improvements.

* Lead and develop a team of up to 12 employees, building capability in Quality Systems, process ownership, risk-based decision-making, data and digital fluency, continuous improvement, and critical thinking.

**Shaping the QMS of the Future**

The Director will play a key role in evolving the DQB QMS to support the future needs of the Biologics’ development portfolio and AZ's 2030 Vision. The role will champion a phase-appropriate, risk-based and digitally enabled QMS that is fit for purpose, reduces unnecessary complexity, enables innovation, and maintains strong regulatory compliance and patient-focused quality.

The Director role will lead the responsible adoption of AI, advanced analytics, automation, digital workflows, and other emerging technologies to simplify processes, reduce manual work, improve knowledge access, identify quality signals earlier, and strengthen data-driven decision-making. The role will help advance the QMS from primarily retrospective management of quality events toward a more proactive and predictive model, while ensuring appropriate human accountability, transparency, data integrity, traceability, and GxP controls.

**Measures of Success**

**Success in the role will be demonstrated through:**

* A compliant, effective, phase-appropriate, and fit-for-purpose QMS that enables delivery of the AZ portfolio.

* Strong QMS health, including effective management of deviations, CAPAs, changes, risks, training, documentation, and inspection readiness.

* Mature Business Process Management with clear accountability and measurable improvements in process effectiveness, efficiency, and simplicity.

* A Quality Management Review with processes and metrics that provide actionable insights, identify emerging risks, and enable timely leadership decisions.

* Increased and appropriately governed use of data, digital solutions, automation, and AI to improve QMS performance and reduce administrative burden.

* A capable, engaged team prepared to lead and support the QMS of the future.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline such as Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience within Quality in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry, including significant people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading a sizeable (10+) Quality team/function and delivering measurable improvements.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including deviations/CAPA, change control, Quality Risk Management, documentation, training, and inspection readiness.
* Strong understanding of GxP requirements, regulatory expectations, and SOP-driven environments, with experience driving compliance and sustainable Quality practices.
* Experience using Quality metrics, trending, risk indicators, and management review to identify priorities and drive continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and significant process or organizational change, including management of resources, stakeholders, vendors, and budgets.
* Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to partner across Quality, Development, and senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within biologics, Development Quality, or pharmaceutical development.
* Experience managing managers or leading leaders within a Quality organization.
* Experience with Business Process Management, Operational Excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement.
* Experience leading QMS transformation, harmonization, or process simplification.
* Experience with digital Quality systems, automation, advanced analytics, or AI-enabled Quality solutions in a regulated environment.
* Experience with non-GMP biopharmaceutical work and its phase-appropriate requirements for compliance.

**SO, WHAT’S NEXT?**

To be considered for this exciting opportunity, please complete the full application on our website at your earliest convenience – it is the only way that our Recruiter and Hiring Manager can know that you feel well qualified for this opportunity. If you know someone who would be a great fit, please share this posting with them.

**Where can I find out more?**

* Explore what we’re building: www.evinova.com
* Stay connected and see our impact in action: https://www.linkedin.com/company/evinova/

**Apply today to bring smarter, faster clinical trials to life!**

Evinova is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion and providing a workplace that is free from discrimination. Evinova is committed to accommodating persons with disabilities. Such accommodation is available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment, assessment and selection process and may be requested by emailing AZCHumanResources@astrazeneca.com.

#LI-Hybrid

*In addition, our positions offer a short-term incentive bonus opportunity; eligibility to participate in our equity-based long-term incentive program. Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.*

*Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base pay (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.*

**Closing Date**

In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics.
