new_roles.description:
**About Tufts Medicine**

Tufts Medicine brings together the best of academic and community medicine to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, the principal teaching hospital of Tufts University and the Tufts University School of Medicine, Lowell General Hospital, MelroseWakefield Hospital, Lawrence Memorial Hospital of Medford, Care at Home, and an integrated network of 2,300 physicians, we treat the most complex conditions, keep our communities healthy and bring research breakthroughs to life.

**Job Overview**

This position reports to the Vice President of the Community Practice Operations (South and West) & Network Integration and serves as a key leader within Ambulatory at Tufts Medicine. The role provides operational and strategic oversight across the South region and in alignment with Ambulatory within the broader Tufts network.

In addition, this leader will oversee the Tufts Medicine Multi-Specialty location in Quincy, as well as Middleton, including not only operations, but also growth within these practices. Operating within a collaborative leadership model and with a focus on service excellence in the ambulatory environment, this position is accountable for:

* Ensuring high-quality patient access and experience
* Driving financial performance and profitability
* Optimizing all revenue cycle processes
* Advancing strategic initiatives across the region and potentially across Ambulatory as a whole, when designated

This role plays a critical part in shaping the Tufts Medicine ambulatory strategy, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the delivery and expansion of exceptional care within the community.

Location: Hybrid and at sites within the designated region (e.g., Quincy & Middleton)

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience such as Associate’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field and two (2) years of relevant business experience or High School Diploma or GED and four (4) years of relevant business experience.

2. Seven (7) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Master’s degree in business, healthcare, or a related field.

2. Ten (10) years of healthcare management or practice management experience working directly with physicians and practice members.

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Directs the practice operations managers in the day-to-day operations of their employed outpatient physician practices to ensure each practice is meeting optimal operational efficiency, fiscal stability and patient/employee satisfaction.

2. Collaborates with the practice operations managers in the implementation of best practice models in all areas of practices operations. Develops guidelines for prioritizing work activities, evaluating effectiveness and modifying activities as necessary.

3. Evaluates practice efficiency including all personnel (physicians, clinical and administrative support staff) utilizing accepted quality measures, productivity standards, skill mix comparisons, and patient satisfaction survey data. Implements new operational models and structures to reduce cost, improve efficiency and quality, and enhance services to patients.

4. Participates in the development of and oversees budgets for the practices. Reviews monthly P&L reports in detail, determines opportunities for improvements, and creates and implements action plans with practice operations managers as necessary.

5. Conducts monthly operations team meetings to review new policies and procedures, processes, quality measures, etc., and monthly one-on-one meetings with each practice manager at each practice location to provide individual support and leadership.

6. Initiates and maintains all policy and procedure manuals. Develops and implements standardized processes for practices to ensure consistency throughout the physician network. Works with practice operations managers to ensure practices meet required compliance and clinical competency thresholds.

7. Works collaboratively with the physician recruitment team on the provider enrollment onboarding activities related to new practice acquisitions or new employed providers. Works closely with the provider recruitment team, practice operations manager and provider(s) throughout the onboarding life cycle to ensure timeliness and deliverables are met for a seamless transition and successful implementation.

8. In collaboration with the Vice President of Physician Services, implements the transition plan for newly acquired physician practices. Acts as liaison to physicians, support staff, operations team, hospital departments, and hospital administration. Responsible for the human resources, payroll, finance, and purchasing components of the acquisitions.

9. Works collaboratively with representatives from the physician organizations to ensure that our practices and providers are achieving a high level of performance under managed risk contracts as we transition to a value-based model. Commitment to transformation and innovation in care delivery through the Practice of the Future work will also be a measure of success.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Work environment: professional office environment with typical office requirements such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

2. Frequently required to speak, hear, communicate and exchange information.

3. Able to see and read computers displays, read fine print, and/or normal type size print and distinguish letters, numbers and symbols.

4. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

5. Ability to work in confined or open environments.

6. Ability to work independently or in a team environment.

7. Ability to travel to various locations both within the state and outside the state.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Demonstrates leadership style that emphasizes openness, visibility and connectivity.

2. Ability to convey the organization’s enthusiasm, confidence, goals, and mission and inspire those things in others.

3. Ability to connect with people in a meaningful way at all levels within the organization in keeping with the culture of the senior leadership team.

4. Demonstrates forward thinking and creativity with high ethical standards and an appropriate professional image while fostering collaboration and building consensus to achieve collective objectives.

5. Ability to make tough choices that serve the best interests of the organization. Proven creative problem-solving skills with the willingness to take the initiative in leading change as well as the ability to effectively manage change.

6. Ability to build consensus with strong negotiation, persuasion and communication skills to propose enhancements to operational processes to improve efficiency and/or effectiveness.

7. Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills necessary to engage effectively at all levels for effecting timely progress.

8. Ability to be an innovative problem solver with excellent critical thinking skills.

9. Demonstrates exemplary leadership and stakeholder management expertise.

10. Ability to hold self and others accountable to meet deadlines and achieve business goals.

**Job Profile Summary**

This role focuses on providing administrative and business support to the organization in order to achieve operational goals. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Clinical Administration duties: Long-term strategic planning, determines strategic issues and opportunities that could affect practice success, prioritizes and tracks investments across practices, allocates resources and makes decisions regarding practice growth, and develops need to accomplish the practice's vision. A management role that supervises employees focusing on tactical, operational activities within a specified area, with the majority of time spent overseeing area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal achievement is typically accomplished through performance of direct and/or indirect reports. A role that directs a department or small unit that includes multiple teams led by managers and/or team Leaders. Responsibilities typically include: ownership of short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy and the operational direction of the Department, problems faced are often complex and require extensive investigation and analysis, and requires ability to influence others to accept practices and approaches, and ability to communicate and influence executive leadership.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
The Director, Operational Excellence will focus on delivery excellence, process optimization, resource management, and stakeholder management. The Director will be an operational leader who develops frameworks and effective ways of working on which our organization can build in the coming years. This includes ownership of organizational resource tracking, resource planning, hiring process support, and staff augmentation vendor management, so the organization has the right talent in the right roles at the right time in line with funds planning. The Director and team will ensure that the organization develops and fully integrates a continuous improvement culture, with the ultimate goal of ensuring team efficiency, and financial effectiveness.

 

* Leads priorities focused on service delivery and capability alignment, resource management, budget/financial management, vendor and technology management, communications, and training
* Partners with the Leadership Team in short- and long-term planning activities that align with the organization’s strategy, vision, operational plan, and goals
* Establishes and maintains organization-wide resource tracking, providing visibility into headcount, allocation, capacity, utilization, and cost across colleagues and contingent workers
* Leads resource planning in partnership with the Leadership Team and Finance, forecasting demand, identifying capability and capacity gaps, and recommending the right mix of full-time and augmented staff
* Supports hiring processes in partnership with Talent Acquisition and PX, including position requests and approvals, job description development, requisition tracking, interview coordination, and onboarding readiness
* Manages processes related to staff augmentation vendors, including vendor selection, rate and contract negotiation, performance management, and spend oversight
* Drives innovative thinking and planning, leveraging new technologies as needed, to address the needs of the organization and its individual capabilities
* Challenges the status quo and drives continuous improvement by establishing a solid foundation and implementing standard ways of working, systems, processes, and frameworks.
* Works closely with cross-functional peers and team members to consolidate efforts for org processes improvements, but also applies independent decision making to ensure best possible approach is being implemented.
* Promotes a continuous improvement mindset and process improvement initiatives through communication, training, and best practices, ensuring accountability through governance.
* Has critical impact on significant reduction of administrative and redundant tasks across Engineering & Technology organization through applying most efficient and suitable AI tools and bringing in innovative ways of working.
* Builds, develops, and grows relationships with internal and external stakeholders and vendors at every level
* Serves as strategic program/project manager for key organizational projects. Has direct accountability for budget assigned to these projects and management of related vendors, supports oversight processes for organizational budget.
* Coaches, mentors, and supports the professional growth of direct reports. Responsible for efficient resource and funds allocation within the team.

**Basic Qualifications**

Bachelors degree and 8+ years relevant work experience

Strong written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal, collaboration, and facilitation skills

Proven analytical and critical thinking skills, and strong background in process improvement

Practical experience with operational, process improvement, gaining efficiencies and project management methodologies and ability to lead project teams

Ability to multi-task and handle multiple priorities while managing aggressive deadlines

Strong ability for independent decision making while working closely with cross-functional peers

Demonstrated ability to manage/lead complex projects, including resource and budget management for assigned projects

**Preferred Qualifications**

Masters degree in related field

Pharmaceutical or Healthcare industry experience

Practical experience with organization setup processes that include job descriptions creation, managing hiring processes with human resources, sourcing contracted resources.

Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (LSSBB)

Knowledge of or expertise in Digital product development and/or Design Thinking

Experience driving change in a global, matrixed organization

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

National and International travel may be necessary

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Last Date to Apply for Job: 11/30/2026

 
The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 20.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. 
This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.

Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility.

**Sunshine Act**

Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative.

**EEO & Employment Eligibility**

Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States.

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. Requests for any other reason will not be returned.

new_roles.title: Director of Supplier Quality - Operations & Compliance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Director, Supplier Quality – Operations & Compliance reports to the AVP, Supplier Quality and is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing the Supplier Quality Assurance program across Agilent businesses and sites. This role is focused on improving product quality, process quality, supplier performance, and delivery throughout the supply base.

The Director will have direct responsibility for supplier quality processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), tools, dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and the Approved Supplier List (ASL).

A key priority for this role is developing and implementing a Supplier Quality Operations strategy that centralizes and standardizes processes while ensuring consistent compliance of all processes used in the Supplier Quality organization, including Agilent sites, SQ business leads, SQ category leads, and suppliers.

The successful candidate will be a proactive, self-directed leader who can build strong partnerships across Agilent and the external supply base while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

* Own, improve, and standardize supplier quality processes, including supplier Audits, Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), Supplier Change Management, Supplier Review Boards (SRBs), and Approved Supplier List (ASL) processes.
* Partner closely with Procurement, business and site leadership, Category teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure effective and consistent execution of supplier quality processes.
* Develop, improve, and continuously monitor a standardized KPI and metrics program, including executive-level dashboards that provide meaningful, actionable visibility into supplier performance and overall supply chain health.
* Present and support Supplier Quality metrics and performance discussions during Quality Management Review (QMR) and Supplier Review Board (SRB) meetings.
* Manage the quality aspects of the Approved Supplier List in partnership with Procurement.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across the Supplier Quality function, establish project ownership, monitor progress, and ensure measurable results at project completion.
* Develop and manage the Supplier Quality outsourcing strategy, including evaluating outsourcing opportunities for audits, root cause analysis (RCA), and other Supplier Quality activities.
* Strengthen the culture of quality and compliance by identifying and implementing continuous improvement opportunities across Supplier Quality processes.
* Partner with Procurement to establish a consistent **"One-Voice Agilent"** approach when communicating with the supply base.
* Evaluate and implement a supplier portal in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Engage key supplier management teams through structured business reviews to monitor performance metrics, identify trends, address risks, and implement programs that deliver measurable performance improvements.
* Lead, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing and diverse team of Supplier Quality professionals.
* Own and manage the budget for the Supplier Quality Operations function.
* Strengthen supplier and organizational quality culture through coaching, technical engagement, and collaborative problem-solving.

**Qualifications**
------------------

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related discipline preferred.

**Experience**
--------------

 

* 5+ years of direct or related experience in Supplier Quality.
* 3+ years of experience leading and managing teams.
* Experience owning or managing a Quality Management System (QMS), particularly Supplier Quality processes associated with **ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485**.
* Significant experience with sourcing, supplier management, and quality execution within highly regulated or demanding industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace and defense, or similarly complex markets.
* Demonstrated experience working effectively within a matrixed organization.

**Essential Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

 

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across organizational levels, functions, cultures, and external organizations.
* Proactive, self-directed leadership style with the ability to identify challenges, develop solutions, and drive implementation.
* Strong commitment to quality, compliance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective systems and establish trust with suppliers, internal customers, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Proven ability to motivate, coach, and develop team members while fostering collaboration and teamwork.
* Ability to navigate and de-escalate challenging or high-pressure situations calmly and effectively.
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate supplier and quality data into actionable insights for senior leadership.
* Ability to travel occasionally.

**Additional Details**

This job has a full time weekly schedule. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 19, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $160,240.00 - $300,450.00/yr USD in the US, or $134,218.00 - $209,715.00/yr CAD in Canada, plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. new_roles.title: Regional Operations Director - Chicago
new_roles.description:
### **Your Impact as a Regional Operations Director**

As a Regional Operations Director, you are a key leader responsible for the success and health of a diverse portfolio of veterinary hospitals. You will serve as the crucial link between local hospital teams and the broader Mission Pet Health network, empowering your teams to achieve excellence in both business performance and patient care.

* **Geographic Location:** This position supports our Chicago, Illinois market. Ideal candidates will reside within the greater Chicago metropolitan area or surrounding communities, with the ability to travel regularly throughout the assigned hospital portfolio. Candidates must be comfortable with regional travel and maintaining a strong on-site presence to support hospital leadership teams.
* **Champion a Thriving Culture:** You'll partner with your Regional Medical Director to foster a positive, engaged, and high-performing culture across all hospitals in your region.
* **Develop Future Leaders:** You'll guide the growth of Hospital Managers and their teams, ensuring a strong pipeline of talent through effective coaching, training, and career development.
* **Drive Business Performance:** You'll have full ownership of the financial health of your region, managing P&Ls to drive revenue growth and optimize operational efficiency.
* **Build Winning Teams:** You'll lead the strategy for non-DVM recruiting and staffing, ensuring your hospitals have the talent they need to succeed.
* **Elevate the Client Experience:** You'll set the standard for exceptional client service, ensuring operational processes support a seamless and positive experience for every pet owner.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* A proven track record of successful multi-site P&L management, with a keen ability to drive financial results.
* Demonstrated success in recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams, especially in a leadership capacity.
* Exceptional leadership skills with a talent for building a positive, accountable, and solutions-focused culture.
* Excellent communication and conflict management skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences.
* Significant experience leading in a multi-site veterinary, healthcare, or customer-centric retail environment.

### **How You're Supported**

*As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.* 
 
*Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.*

##### **Competitive Compensation**

A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.

##### **Health & Wellbeing**

We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.

##### **Financial Security**

Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.

##### **Commitment to Growth**

We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.

##### **The Power of a Network**

Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.

##### **Valuable Perks**

Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

### **About Mission Pet Health**

Mission Pet Health was founded by veterinarians on the belief that local practices thrive with clinical autonomy, collaboration, and medical excellence. The organization provides world-class support to its 850+ hospital teams on a hyper-local basis so they can focus on what matters most: the medicine, their patients, and their team culture. Learn more at **missionpethealth.com**.

Driving the award-winning culture are the WAG values – **Work Together, Amaze, and Grow**. Mission Pet Health is veterinarian-led, people-focused, and on a mission to be the best place to work in veterinary medicine. We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 "Most Loved Workplace," ranked #2 in America's Top 100 and #1 in veterinary care.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation. Please contact benefits@mvetpartners.com with your request and contact information.

**EEO Statement:** Mission Pet Health is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_roles.title: Executive Director, Process Lead, Corporate Functions Operations, Enterprise Business Services
new_roles.description:
**The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.** is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers, and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands, including The Ordinary and NIOD, and BALMAIN Beauty.

**Description**
---------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corporate Process Ownership & Governance**

* Lead governance for assigned corporate process domains
* Define standards, accountabilities, controls, decision rights, and escalation paths
* Partner with Global Process Owners and functional leaders to establish priorities and transformation roadmaps
* Align policies, controls, service requirements, and technology enablement across functions
* Facilitate governance forums and resolve cross-functional issues involving EBS teams and third-party providers

**End-to-End Process Design & Optimization**

* Simplify, standardize, and integrate cross-functional processes across organizational boundaries
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, process mining, and related methodologies to identify improvement opportunities
* Design processes that enhance efficiency, controls, service quality, resilience, and user experience
* Define global standards while evaluating and approving necessary local variations

**Risk, Controls, and Compliance**

* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Privacy, Security, Audit, and Records Management leaders to incorporate requirements into process design
* Ensure process changes maintain effective controls and compliance standards
* Address process and control gaps through improvements in workflow, governance, tech, data, and accountability
* Support remediation of audit and operational findings

**Service Delivery & Experience**

* Improve employee and stakeholder experience through streamlined workflows, clear service models, and effective knowledge management
* Define service expectations and responsibilities across retained functions, EBS teams, and external providers
* Leverage stakeholder feedback and operational data to identify and address service gaps
* Promote self-service capabilities and user-friendly process design

**Performance & Value Realization**

* Develop and maintain a prioritized process improvement roadmap
* Define and track outcomes related to cost, productivity, service quality, control effectiveness, and risk reduction
* Establish performance measures, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms
* Support business case development and benefit realization tracking

**Digital Enablement**

* Partner with Tech and Data teams to incorporate automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work and improve data quality and transparency
* Ensure digital solutions align with business and stakeholder needs
* Promote integrated platforms and processes across corporate functions

**Transformation & Op Model Support**

* Provide process leadership for migrations, consolidations, outsourcing initiatives, and operating model changes
* Define future-state processes and support implementation, adoption, and stabilization
* Assess process, control, data, and organizational risks associated with transformation initiatives
* Ensure transitioned processes have appropriate ownership, controls, measures, and governance

**Stakeholder & Capability Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across corporate functions and EBS
* Present recommendations, trade-offs, and investment priorities in business terms
* Influence outcomes across a global matrixed organization
* Coach process leaders on governance and continuous improvement practices

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications and Competencies**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business or a relevant area of study
* 12+ years of experience in corporate functions, enterprise operations, GBS/shared services, process excellence, or large-scale transformation
* Strong understanding of corporate-function operating models, service delivery, internal controls, governance, and cross-functional dependencies
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Demonstrated success standardizing and improving complex processes across functions, geographies, delivery centers, and third-party providers
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, value-stream mapping, process mining, or comparable process-improvement methodologies. Relevant certification is preferred
* Strong financial and operational judgment, analytical problem-solving, executive communication, and change leadership
* Experience with shared services, outsourcing, multi-vendor delivery, service management, and global process governance is preferred
* Ability to incorporate risk, control, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements into practical and effective process designs

**Pay Range:**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$158,650.00** to **$272,700.00**. Exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. Salary range may vary based on geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program as well as participation in the share incentive plan. In addition,

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with the possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results. In addition, The Estée Lauder Companies offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance), wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time, and many others. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is Company's policy not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. The Company will endeavor to provide a reasonable accommodation consistent with the law to otherwise qualified employees and prospective employees with a disability and to employees and prospective employees with needs related to their religious observance or practices. Should you wish to apply for this position or any other position with the Company and you believe you require assistance to complete an application or participate in an interview, please contact USApplicantAccommodations@Estee.com.

**Michigan Applicants:** Persons with disabilities needing accommodations for employment must notify the company in writing of the need for an accommodation within 182 days after the date the person with a disability knew or reasonably should have known that an accommodation was needed.

**Philadelphia Applicants:** Philadelphia's Fair Chance Hiring Law

**Rhode Island Applicants:** The company is subject to chapters 29-38 of title 28 of the general laws of Rhode Island and is therefore covered by the state's workers' compensation law.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Restaurant Depot is the nation’s leading members-only, wholesale cash-and-carry supplier serving independent restaurants, caterers, delis, convenience stores, & other foodservice businesses across 165+ locations in 35 states. Our stores offer bulk quantities of fresh meat, seafood, produce, dairy, frozen foods, grocery items, beverages, paper goods, cleaning supplies, restaurant equipment, & more. Open seven days a week, we are committed to delivering quality products, competitive pricing, & exceptional service to our members. As we continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Director of Operations to provide strategic leadership, drive operational performance, & support the continued success of our store network.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations provides strategic leadership & operational oversight for a multi-region portfolio of stores. This role is responsible for driving business performance through operational excellence, financial accountability, talent development, customer experience, regulatory compliance, & growth initiatives. The Director partners closely with executive leadership to develop & execute company strategies while leading Regional Managers & field leadership teams in achieving organizational goals.

This position plays a key role in establishing operational standards, improving profitability, developing future leaders, & ensuring consistent execution across all locations. Responsibilities include oversight of P&L performance, labor management, sales growth, food safety, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, workforce planning, & organizational development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Business Performance**

* Develop & execute operational strategies that support company growth, sales performance, & profitability objectives.
* Lead Regional Managers & field leadership teams through clear performance expectations, accountability measures, & ongoing performance reviews.
* Analyze sales, labor, margin, shrink, inventory, & operational metrics to identify opportunities & implement corrective actions.
* Drive sustainable sales growth, market share expansion, & EBITDA improvement across assigned regions.
* Partner with executive leadership on long-term business planning, budgets, capital investments, & new store development opportunities.
* Ensure operational priorities align with company objectives & strategic initiatives.

**Financial Management & Operational Excellence**

* Maintain accountability for P&L performance across assigned regions & divisions.
* Develop annual operating plans, labor strategies, budgets, & financial forecasts.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including sales growth, gross margin, labor productivity, inventory turns, EBITDA, shrink, & waste.
* Establish & maintain consistent operational standards across all locations.
* Ensure effective execution of company programs, policies, procedures, & initiatives.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts focused on productivity, efficiency, process optimization, & customer experience.
* Drive accountability for operational audits, food safety standards, inventory accuracy, & facility maintenance.
* Implement best practices to improve profitability & overall operating efficiency.

**Customer Experience & Brand Standards**

* Champion a customer-first culture throughout the organization.
* Ensure stores consistently deliver exceptional customer service & maintain company brand standards.
* Review customer feedback & satisfaction trends, developing action plans to address opportunities for improvement.
* Lead initiatives that strengthen customer loyalty, retention, & overall brand reputation.

**Talent Development & Workforce Management**

* Build a strong leadership pipeline through succession planning, talent development, & career progression opportunities.
* Coach & develop Regional Managers, District Managers, Store Managers, & emerging leaders.
* Establish leadership development programs & promote internal growth opportunities.
* Lead performance management processes & reinforce organizational accountability.
* Develop workforce & labor strategies that maximize productivity while supporting operational needs.
* Ensure staffing models, recruitment, & retention initiatives align with current & future business requirements.
* Oversee labor budgets, staffing levels, & productivity targets across assigned regions.
* Foster a culture of engagement, collaboration, accountability, & continuous improvement.

**Compliance, Risk Management & Food Safety**

* Ensure compliance with company policies & applicable federal, state, & local regulations.
* Maintain accountability for food safety, HACCP, OSHA, labor law compliance, & health department standards.
* Partner with Human Resources & Legal teams on employee relations matters, investigations, & risk mitigation.
* Lead operational audits & corrective action programs to address compliance & performance gaps.
* Ensure all locations meet company standards for workplace safety, security, & regulatory compliance.

**Change Management & Strategic Initiatives**

* Lead companywide operational initiatives, process improvements, & transformational projects.
* Support acquisitions, store integrations, remodels, & new store openings.
* Drive adoption of new technologies, operating procedures, & business processes.
* Collaborate with executive leadership on strategic growth initiatives & organizational priorities.

**Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Serve as a key operational liaison between field leadership & executive management.
* Provide executive reporting on operational performance, business trends, risks, & opportunities.
* Facilitate regular business reviews with Regional Managers & key stakeholders.
* Communicate company vision, priorities, & performance expectations throughout the organization.
* Partner with cross-functional departments to improve operational alignment & execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Retail Management, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
* 10–15 years of progressive multi-unit operations leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading Regional Managers, District Managers, or equivalent senior field leadership teams.
* Demonstrated success managing large-scale, high-volume, multi-location operations.
* Proven track record of driving sales growth, profitability improvement, & operational excellence.
* Strong background in P&L management, labor management, financial analysis, budgeting, & strategic planning.
* Experience leading organizational change, business transformation, & large-scale operational initiatives.
* Extensive knowledge of regulatory compliance, food safety, labor laws, & risk management.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, coaching, & team development skills.
* Advanced analytical, decision-making, & problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to travel extensively throughout assigned regions.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance Coverage
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match
* Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy
* Six (6) Paid Company Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement Program, subject to eligibility & plan guidelines
* Additional Voluntary Supplemental Benefits, which may include life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance programs, & other optional benefits
* Competitive & Comprehensive Benefits Package Designed to Support You & Your Family

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.
* Oversees that training programs are in place for employees to update their knowledge on relevant industry practices.
* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all food and beverage menus.
* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.
* Responsible for management interviewing, hiring, and training process decisions.
* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

**Skills/Experience**

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

*We are an equal opportunity employer.*

new_roles.title: (USA) Senior Director, Operations - Program Management - Data Ventures
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

We are looking for a Senior Director, Operations - Program Management, to lead the operating model that connects priorities from strategy through execution and business impact. This role leads our Program Management organization, helping Data Ventures prioritize the right work, make better investment and sequencing decisions, manage dependencies, prepare the business for change, and ensure initiatives deliver intended outcomes.
 
 
This is not a traditional PMO role centered on schedules, status reporting, meeting facilitation. The successful leader will be a systems thinker who can see across the portfolio, bring structure to ambiguity, surface tradeoffs early, and help senior leaders turn strategy into action.
 
 
About the team:
 
The Walmart Data Ventures team leverages first-party data to develop B2B solutions that empower merchants and suppliers with actionable insights. Within this group, the Commercial Operations team drives scalable revenue growth by enhancing operational excellence, fostering collaboration, and refining processes. The team works cross-functionally to implement strategies that boost efficiency and business outcomes. With strong expertise in business and financial management, members deliver measurable impact and continuously optimize commercial operations to align with Walmart’s evolving objectives in a dynamic environment.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**What you'll do:**
 
**Connect strategy to execution**

* Translate enterprise and business priorities into sequenced plans with clear outcomes, ownership, dependencies, and decision points.

**Own end-to-end lifecycle orchestration**

* Lead the team in strengthening lifecycle management across strategic intake, development, business readiness, commercialization, launch, stabilization, and ongoing performance.

**Strengthen portfolio governance and decision-making**

* Establish portfolio reviews and executive operating cadences that focus leadership attention on decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes rather than activity reporting.

**Build a scalable program management capability**

* Simplify portfolio and program processes and eliminate low-value coordination, reporting, and manual work.

 
**What you'll bring:**
 

* Significant experience leading complex portfolio, program management, business operations, product operations, transformation, or related functions in a large-scale organization.

* Demonstrated ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and develop senior leaders.

* Deep experience translating strategy into executable plans and operating mechanisms.

* Strong portfolio management capabilities, including prioritization, governance, dependency management, investment/capacity planning, risk management, and performance measurement.

* Strong systems thinking with the ability to understand how decisions in one part of an organization affect the broader portfolio and customer experience.

* Ability to simplify complex information into clear choices and recommendations.

* Strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to move between strategic thinking and detailed problem solving.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.
 
Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.
 
For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.
 
The annual salary range for this position is $130,000.00 - $260,000.00 Additional compensation includes annual or quarterly performance bonuses. Additional compensation for certain positions may also include :

new_roles.title: Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Annual Salary: $130,000 - $160,000**

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

 

Interested in learning more about Ashley Furniture’s Community Engagement programs, Environmental Stewardship, or our Core Values, click the links below:

**Corporate Social Responsibility** (https://www.ashleyfurniture.com/about-us/corporate-social-responsibility/report/)

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

new_roles.title: Director Engineering Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong knowledge of engineering product-development processes, configuration management, product-data control, and engineering release practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong analytical, communication, and continuous-improvement skills

**U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.**

*The salary range for this position is $161,180/year- $250,000/year. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

 

*Taking care of our people is a top priority at Leonardo DRS. We are proud to offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a company contribution to a health savings account, telemedicine, life and disability insurance, legal insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan. We champion wellness programs that focus on physical, emotional, and financial well-being. We develop our talent by offering programs and activities to support career-growth, professional development, and skill enhancement. And we understand there is more to life than work, and the importance of offering flexible work schedules with our 9/80 program, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.* 

* *Some employees are eligible for limited benefits only*

 

*Leonardo DRS, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*
