new_roles.title: Senior Director, Global Laboratory Operations (REMOTE)
new_roles.description:
For 75 years, Charles River employees have worked together to assist in the discovery, development and safe manufacture of new drug therapies. When you join our family, you will have a significant impact on the health and well-being of people across the globe. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. In return, we’ll help you build a career that you can feel passionate about.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Serve as the senior scientific advisor and strategic lead for laboratory operations within Global Laboratory Sciences. Partner with scientific and operational leaders within Lab Sciences to ensure operational excellence, scientific quality, regulatory compliance and customer satisfaction across the global laboratory network. Develop and action an operational strategy that supports growth of the business with a focus on innovation and building global capacity and capabilities to meet the evolving needs of the industry. Provide leadership across multiple laboratory disciplines and sites, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. Serve as a recognized expert for Global Lab Sciences to internal and external partners. Lead and manage Global Lab Sciences projects as assigned.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Direct global laboratory operations across multiple disciplines in Global Lab Sciences, including Analytical Chemistry, Bioanalysis, Biomarkers, Immunology and Molecular Biology
* Ensure efficient utilization of laboratory resources, equipment, facilities, and personnel
* Work with the Global Head of Labs to develop and implement a global operational strategy aligned with business objectives
* Provide oversight of Global Scientific Leads, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. Leverage Global Teams to drive global consistency in laboratory procedures, quality systems and client deliverables
* Serve as primary reviewer for harmonized (HRM) standard operating procedures (SOPs) and document templates
* Direct key strategic and scientific decision-making for Global Laboratory Operations. Address and resolve scientific and operational challenges to ensure consistent and high-quality customer experience
* Partner closely with Site Leadership and Quality Assurance to ensure successful outcomes during regulatory inspections, client audits, internal audits and accreditation reviews
* Support sites in implementing key operational metrics to monitor performance, throughput and capacity
* Help to drive expansion, modernization, automation, and capacity planning initiatives
* Serve as Global Lab Sciences lead in DSA operational initiatives, as assigned
* Support the development and integration of new technologies to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across the Global Lab Sciences organization
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current industry practices and represent Lab Sciences in scientific forums, conferences and industry organizations. Participate in client governance committees, as assigned
* Identify opportunities for growth and develop business plans for new areas of opportunity
* Serve as a member of the Global Lab Sciences senior leadership team and contribute to quarterly Business Review and DSA strategy presentations
* Mentor staff and assist in development of succession plans and talent pipelines
* Perform all other related duties as assigned.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

* ***Education:*** Advanced degree (Master’s Degree and/or Ph.D.) in scientific or business-related discipline.
* ***Experience:*** 10 years related management experience in a contract research organization (CRO), biotechnology, or pharmaceutical environment, including one or more of the scientific areas covered within Laboratory Sciences.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted as a satisfactory substitute.
* ***Certification/Licensure:*** None
* ***Other:*** Management and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated abilities in analytical, quantitative and critical thinking with fundamental understanding of Lab Sciences capabilities and capacity. Proven ability to work effectively in a dynamic, deadline driven environment. Ability to handle multiple projects and make executive level decisions. Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational skills, and attention to detail. Proficient project management and presentation skills. Must have ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

**Compensation Data**
---------------------

The hiring range for this position in the United States is $200,000/yr – $235,000/yr USD. Please note that salaries vary within the range based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, education, certifications, location and any collective agreements, if applicable. Remote candidates located outside the United States should be aware that the relevant pay range varies based on country and location.

**About Safety Assessment** 
Charles River is committed to helping our partners expedite their preclinical drug development with exceptional safety assessment services, state-of-the-art facilities and expert regulatory guidance. From individual specialty toxicology and IND enabling studies to tailored packages and total laboratory support, our deeply experienced team can design and execute programs that anticipate challenges and avoid roadblocks for a smooth, efficient journey to market. Each year approximately 300 investigational new drug (IND) programs are conducted in our Safety Assessment facilities.

**About Charles River** 
Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.

At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.

We’re committed to providing benefits that elevate your quality of life. Based on your position these may include: bonus/incentives based on performance, 401K, paid time off, stock purchase program, Health and wellness coverage, employee and family wellbeing support programs, and work life balance flexibility.

new_roles.title: Operational Excellence Director
new_roles.description:
At E Tech Group, joining our team means joining a group of passionate and forward-thinking experts. We're one of the largest engineering and system integration firms in the United States providing value for our clients through IT automation and control solutions for more than 30 years to the Life Sciences, Mission Critical, Metals & Mining, Warehousing & Distribution, and CPG/Food & Beverage industries. Our national and global scale allows us to help our clients develop and implement standardized solutions at any of their facilities regardless of physical location or the local resources available at that site.

We're adding to our team! We are seeking an **Operational Excellence****Director** to lead the optimization of workflows and play a key role in the continuous improvement across all projects and operations. This role ensures alignment with industry best practices, including CSIA Best Practices, while driving consistent, high-quality delivery in automation and integration projects.

**You will:**

* Ensure workflows meet E Tech Group and Business Unit quality policies, procedures, CSIA Best Practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct internal audits to evaluate adherence to standards, practical efficiency of associated tools, assess root-cause failure modes, and support corrective and preventive actions.
* Business Unit representative for E Tech's Continuous Improvement Committee, providing practical suggestions and solutions, communicating with Business Unit leadership.
* Analyze project execution workflows to identify and remove bottlenecks, directly improving project lead times and margin predictability.
* Identify and champion the use of digital tools and AI to automate repetitive administrative tasks, reducing 'process friction' for engineering teams.
* Represent the Business Unit for Customer and third party audits, including audit preparation, participation, response coordination, and follow up.
* Foster quality, consistency, and ongoing improvement across cross-functional teams.
* Support Corporate Continuous Improvement initiatives including development and review of policies and procedures.
* Lead Business Unit continuous improvement activities.
* Provide necessary supplemental training and guidance to the Business Unit on quality standards, procedures, and expectations.
* Provide support to improve the quality and effectiveness of the Learning Management System (LMS)
* Encourage collaboration, shared learning, and knowledge transfer across teams throughout the Company
* Collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, and the Project Management Organization to support project risk assessments, and quality planning.
* Attend project reviews, as needed, and provide guidance to project teams for compliance with Project Management Life Cycle (PMLC) and System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and other procedures during project execution.
* Interface with clients and third parties on quality related topics, including audits, vendor qualification, and compliance inquiries.
* Be an ambassador who embodies our Core Values, prioritizing the success of E Tech Group, our clients, and the professional development of our associates.

 

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical or Systems), or related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Over seven years of experience in process improvement and engineering performance within technical, project-driven settings. Proven track record in supporting process optimization, waste reduction, quality assurance, compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives in engineering or project environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence technical teams and stakeholders
* Experience working in automation, life sciences or other regulated industries, prefer knowledge of ISO 9001, GxP, GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and Computer System Assurance (CSA).
* Experience supporting automation and control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA, HMI).
* A DNA comprised of collaboration and teamwork.

 

**Benefits & Perks:**

* 401k + match + prompt enrollment. E Tech Group employees are 100% vested upon entry.
* Prompt enrollment into Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.
* Generous paid time off that includes paid vacation, paid holidays, paid family leave and sick time off.
* Learning and growth are key parts of the E Tech culture. We provide you with training and continuing education from day one, so you can advance your career. As an E Tech associate, you can unlock your greatest potential through challenges and opportunities.

Salary Range: $150,000-$170,000

*E Tech Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, genetic information, gender identity, sexual orientation, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by law. E Tech Group will provide reasonable* *accommodations* *to qualified individuals with disabilities and for religious beliefs. E Tech Group is an Affirmative Action Employer of individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.*

new_roles.title: Director of Operations, Service Delivery
new_roles.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, spanning three brands: LawnStarter, Lawn Love, and Home Gnome. We've cleared $750M in bookings and turned a profit three years running. Founded in Austin in 2013, we're a team of about 180 that scales past 500 employees during peak season. The marketplace itself is easy to describe and hard to run well: a customer requests a service, we price the job and match it to an eligible Pro, the Pro claims and completes the work, and we process payment and take a commission.

We're entering the most ambitious stretch in the company's history as we build new verticals, new software products, and the groundwork to become a multi-billion-dollar company.

One of our company values is AI or Extinction: every task, AI-first. No exceptions, no excuses. Top 1% or we're already a fossil. This role is hired against that bar.

**The Role**

This is a biz ops generalist role, built for someone who wants to work across many parts of the business instead of owning one narrow lane. You'll start as an individual contributor with no direct reports, in a new seat reporting directly to the COO. Your first owned area will be building Service Delivery into a working operational function. This will entail adding structure, visibility and process to the way we ensure as many customer jobs as possible are completed successfully and on time by LawnStarter Pros, in lawn care and other services we offer now and over time.

New projects will show up unscoped over time. That's by design. As LawnStarter enters new verticals and grows toward a multi-billion-dollar future, big problems will keep surfacing with no obvious owner, and you'll be one of the people the COO trusts to run them down.

**What makes this role different:**

* You work on some of the biggest company-wide projects, cutting across teams and functional areas.
* You'll be a top builder in Brain, LawnStarter's internal AI toolkit built on Claude Code that already powers everything we do across the company: metric queries, document drafting, bug triage, and more. We expect you to approach your work in an AI-first fashion, leveraging Brain to build new systems and processes that will push the limits of how fast AI can accelerate business results. Every project you run is built AI-first: the analysis, the tooling, the process automation, the monitoring. You build it yourself instead of waiting on an analyst or engineer.
* You own outcomes end to end, from recommendation through execution. Strategy without follow-through doesn't count here.

**What You'll Own**

* **Service Delivery, from the ground up.** Despite LawnStarter's considerable scale and reach, Service Delivery doesn't exist yet as a dedicated function. You'll help define the standards we should meet for job completion rates and speed, measure whether we hit them, and design processes, incentives and real-time interventions that get tested with Pros and customers in the field to lift performance. Scope covers every vertical and every delivery model, from today's 1099 Pros to potential W-2 crews under future evaluation.
* **Raising customer & Pro retention rates.** When we deliver service with excellence, Pros and customers alike stay with us longer. Working tightly with peers across Product, Data and Support, you'll identify new opportunities for us to boost retention and LTV and play a key role in driving resulting initiatives cross-functionally.
* **Whatever comes next.** New projects will land on your plate as the company grows into new verticals and builds new software products. You'll take them from "we should look into this" to building and then running systems with structure, KPIs and owners.

**Problems to Solve**

**Build a Service Delivery function that doesn't exist yet.** Right now, no one formally owns whether LawnStarter delivers the service it promises. You'll define the standard for what a Pro should deliver, then build the agents and pipelines that measure adherence to it and run the tests that change behaviors and outcomes in the field.

**Move metrics.** Leverage systems thinking and AI expertise to drive business results that sit across various functional teams. That means untangling handoffs where several teams touch a problem or goal and no one team owns the outcome.

**Take unscoped problems from ideas to fully-running and automated systems.** Some of the most important work here hasn't been named yet. At some point, someone will raise a fuzzy, unframed problem and say it needs attention. Your job is to take that starting point and build whatever tooling or process it needs, at record speed, and hand back something that runs, with a clear owner and quantitative targets attached.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* Service Delivery is a working function with a defined (and elevated) service standard, a way to measure adherence to it, clear SOPs, and an intervention and incentive playbook that's been tested and proven to lift results.
* At least one project nobody had scoped a year earlier has gone from "we should look into this" to a heavily-automated, running system with a named owner and tracked KPIs.
* Tools you built with AI are in daily use by people other than you, and the way you work has raised the bar for how the company uses AI.
* The COO can hand you a gray-area problem with no playbook and trust that what comes back is data, a recommendation, and a plan to execute it.

 
**Requirements**

**Who You Are**

**An elite AI builder.** You think in terms of agentic systems. Building agents, evals, context engineering, and thinking in guardrails are core to who you are. You keep up with the frontier and put new capabilities to work within days, not quarters. You'd be in the top few percent of AI users at any company you've worked at. Someone who treats AI as an occasional assistant, or needs an engineer to build tooling for them, isn't the right fit here.

**A zero-to-one operator.** You've taken ambiguous, cross-team operating problems from zero to running systems as an individual contributor, with no team to hand the work to. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your experience stops at executing a scope someone else already defined.

**Marketplace-tested.** You've operated inside a marketplace or another multi-sided business and felt firsthand what it takes to balance the needs of different stakeholders on the supply and demand sides. A background built entirely on single-sided businesses, with one stakeholder type to satisfy, won't translate here.

**A finisher.** Executing what you recommend matters as much to you as the recommendation itself. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you treat strategy as your job and execution as someone else's.

new_roles.title: Global Director, Supplier Quality
new_roles.description:
**Job Title:** Global Director, Supplier Quality

**Job Location:** Southfield, MI

**What we offer:**

VeoneerSafety Systemsis the world leader in Automotive Electronic Safety Systems. Veoneer’s scalable, best-in-class restraint control systems are mitigating the effects of a car crash. To date, we have delivered more than 1 billion devices to car manufacturers globally.
 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems has an international and collaborative team of 2,700 employees in 11 countries. We empower our people and are dedicated to their professional development and growth*.* 
 
Veoneer Safety Systems – Protect Everyone in Every Crash.

**What you'll do:**

The Global Director of Supplier Quality leads the global SQ organization, setting strategy, standards, and accountability for supplier readiness, performance, and continuous improvement.

The role combines global Supplier Quality leadership (80%) with North America Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leadership (20%).

**Key Responsibilities for Supplier Quality** (80% of role)

**Strategic Leadership & Global Deployment**

* Set global SQ strategy aligned with corporate, customer, sourcing, and manufacturing objectives.
* Define and execution of Supplier Quality Policies, Standards, Processes, Methods and Systems.
* Owner of Veoneer Supplier Manual (VSM), Supplier Quality Project (SQP) – APQP & PPAP, Supplier Non-Conformance Material (NCM) Management.
* Align cross-functional priorities, resources, and accountability; establish SQE oversight of workload, open issues, owners, overdue actions, and escalations.
* Monitor supplier quality targets, initiatives and indicators to ensure compliance to Veoneer Supplier Quality related policies, standards and reporting.

**Supplier Development & Standards Compliance**

* Oversee new supplier assessment, qualification, and development with Purchasing and Engineering; improve assessment models and ensure teams close risks and capability gaps before sourcing and production approval.
* Set common supplier requirements, risk-based audit and development expectations, and change controls; ensure existing suppliers improve capability and sustain company and customer compliance.
* Representing quality in Supplier Sourcing Board.

**Supplier Performance & Major Quality Issues**

* Lead major supplier escalations with supplier executives and cross-functional teams, ensuring containment, exposure assessment, production and customer protection, and verified permanent corrective actions.
* Drive common KPIs and improvement targets for supplier PPM, repeat defects, corrective-action aging, disruptions.
* Require leadership reviews and improvement plans for systemic issues, sharing lessons learned across suppliers.
* Supplier Scorecard (VS051 rating) and drive continuous improvement for supplier quality performance.

**Supplier APQP / PPAP & Safe Launch**

* Ensure on time and effective supplier APQP, PPAP, and Safe Launch for new programs, suppliers, and changes, including risk reviews, capability verification, and readiness-gap closure before production release.

**Quality Tools, Talent Development & Training**

* Set expectations for consistent SQE application of core quality tools, process audits, and structured problem solving to strengthen prevention and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Assess global SQ team capabilities and set development priorities with regional managers to strengthen technical expertise, expand skills, and build future leaders through training, mentoring, and succession planning.
* Supplier Quality talent review and succession plan.

**Regional Leadership: Engineering Quality & Operational Quality** (20% of role)

* Represent Quality Leadership team in regional activities across RDE, Manufacturing and Supplier Quality teams.
* Align regional priorities, governance, performance reviews, and escalations with global Engineering Quality and Operational Quality leaders and standards.
* Guide development and launch readiness, quality system execution, major issue resolution, and lessons learned while retaining local execution accountability.

**What you'll bring:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering.

**Experience:** Minimum 15 years in supplier quality, including supplier qualification, development, major issue resolution, and talent development. Electronics experience required; automotive SQ experience strongly preferred. Experience leading a multinational organization is preferred.

**Skills:**

* Global SQ leadership and effective matrix-team management.
* Cross-functional influence, supplier executive engagement, and timely decision-making.
* Strong supplier APQP, PPAP, change management, and Safe Launch knowledge.
* Advanced PFMEA, control plan, MSA, SPC, capability, audit, and 8D expertise; proven data-driven problem resolution and daily management.
* Strong commodity expertise for IC, PCB and/or mechanical parts is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
* Experience in other Quality domains is preferred

**Location:** Physical location Markham, Ontario, Canada or Southfield, Michigan; global scope across North America, Europe, India, and Asia.

**Travel:** International travel will be required 8-10 times per year.

**Reporting / Collaboration:**

* Reports to SVP Manufacturing & Quality.
* Solid-line responsibility for tech-center SQEs; dotted-line functional leadership of plant SQEs, with plant leadership retaining local operational accountability.
* Partners with Purchasing, Operations, Engineering, Industrialization, Program Management, and supplier leadership.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

 

Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**What You Will Do**:

We are in search of a **17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief** who will be managing, reviewing, and approving Engineering Change Industrialization. The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be key team member within our 17/24K EC Industrial Team of the 17/24K Production Chief Office.

 

Reporting to the Deputy Production Chief, 17/24K EC Industrialization Associate Director, the role will be focusing on program management, industrialization of engineering changes, business process development, and detailed analysis to support program needs.

The 17/24K Industrial Manager, Production Chief will be instrumental in the achievement of Program milestones through alignment of Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain organizational plans and initiatives to Program and Customer priorities and commitments.

 

* Deliver executive presentations and program reporting on deliveries, risks, and industrial initiatives.
* Support communications, cross-functional alignment, industrial risk identification, and risk mitigation efforts for 17/24K programs.
* Participate in GTF PIPTs on behalf of the 17/24K programs.
* Collaborate with Mod Center, GSC, and cross-functional leaders on planning and execution of critical industrial actions to rate readiness for our programs.
* Leading continuous improvement activities to improve key processes; coordinate, organize, and lead critical industrial initiatives for engineering changes to minimize disruption to OEM and MRO operations
* Support MIPT and IPMT meetings for key engineering changes; present and align industrial content for critical customers
* Track and realign block changes for 24k program
* Champion MRL progression and productivity tasks
* Serve as the primary liaison for the Production Chiefs, ensuring effective communication and smooth execution across the PCIR process
* Partner closely with CAT 1 supplier to maintain alignment and drive successful incorporation planning
* Role involves travel up to 10%

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment OR a Master's degree and minimum 5 years experience in an engineering, manufacturing operations, continuous improvement or related environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Experience working in a fluctuating environment with constantly shifting priorities
* Demonstrated ability to critically assess industrial production schedules, qualification requirements and develop risk mitigations to drive successful program execution.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience using SAP
* Knowledge of the PCIR process
Working knowledge of continuous improvement principles (e.g. lean manufacturing, CORE, QCPC) 

 

**Learn More & Apply Now:**

Please ensure the role type defined below is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role. This position is classified as:

**Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

identity_held_roles.title: VP, Regional Manufacturing
identity_held_roles.description:
**Overview**
Primo Brands is a leading branded beverage company in North America with a focus on healthy hydration. We are proud to offer an extensive and iconic portfolio of highly recognizable, sustainably sourced, and conveniently packaged branded beverages distributed across more than 150,000 retail outlets.
 
 
**Compensation:**
$185,048 - $248,596. This position is eligible for an annual bonus.
 
 
**Location:**
Dallas, TX
 
 
**Health Benefits**
Benefits of working for Primo Brands:
 
 
Medical, prescription, dental, vision, flexible spending account (FSA), dependent care flexible spending account (FSA), health savings account (HSA)
 
 
**Retirement/Investing**
401K with a 5% match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
 
 
**Insurance**
Employee Life Insurance, short and long-term disability, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, spouse/domestic partner/child life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment
 
 
**Other Great Benefits**
Employee discounts, save on auto, home, and pet insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation and sick time, 9 paid holidays and 3 paid floating holidays, paid leave for when you have a baby, adopt a child, or become a foster parent, legal services, identity theft protection, employee assistance program (EAP), adoption reimbursement benefit, FEDlogic, commuter benefits.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
The Regional Vice President (RVP), Manufacturing is responsible for leading the end-to-end manufacturing operations across a multi-site regional network within Primo Brands. This executive leader drives safety, quality, production, cost, service, people, and continuous improvement performance across factories while ensuring alignment with enterprise Supply Chain strategies and business objectives.
 
 
The RVP, Manufacturing partners closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Procurement, Planning, HR, and Finance leaders to deliver operational excellence, optimize manufacturing capacity, develop organizational capability, and support long-term business growth. The role is accountable for creating a high-performance culture that prioritizes safety, quality, associate engagement, customer service, and productivity improvements.
 
 
The Regional Vice President, Manufacturing reports to the Senior Vice President, Manufacturing Operations.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
**Safety & Compliance Leadership**

* Lead a culture where safety is the first priority and operational decisions reflect a zero-harm mindset.
* Ensure compliance with all federal, state, provincial, environmental, food safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Drive accountability for safety performance, incident reduction, risk mitigation, and compliance excellence.
* Serve as a visible champion for workplace safety and associate well-being.

**Manufacturing Operations**

* Lead manufacturing performance across multiple factories, ensuring consistent execution against operational objectives.
* Deliver production plans that support customer demand, service expectations, and inventory requirements.
* Drive schedule attainment, throughput, asset utilization, and manufacturing reliability.
* Optimize regional manufacturing capacity and network performance.
* Ensure disciplined execution of daily management systems and operational governance routines.

**Food Safety & Quality**

* Champion food safety and quality excellence across all facilities.
* Ensure manufacturing sites maintain compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and company standards.
* Provide leadership oversight of quality management systems, audits, inspections, recalls, and corrective action processes.
* Promote a culture of first-time-right execution and continuous quality improvement.

**Financial & Productivity Performance**

* Own regional manufacturing budgets, labor productivity, conversion costs, and operating performance.
* Deliver annual productivity, cost savings, and efficiency targets.
* Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve OEE, optimize labor deployment, and improve asset performance.
* Partner with Finance to ensure operational results support annual business plans and long-range objectives.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and lead high-performing teams through effective leadership, coaching, succession planning, and talent development.
* Develop strong Plant Directors, Factory Managers, Technical Managers, Operations Managers, and functional leaders.
* Drive leadership capability, workforce planning, succession readiness, and organizational effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and associate engagement.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead implementation of manufacturing excellence initiatives across the region.
* Drive improvements in OEE, asset reliability, labor productivity, quality, and service performance.
* Leverage Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, and continuous improvement methodologies to drive sustainable results.
* Establish performance metrics and governance processes that accelerate operational excellence.

**Strategic Leadership**

* Contribute to the development and execution of Supply Chain and Manufacturing strategies.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate network optimization opportunities, capacity investments, automation initiatives, and capital projects.
* Lead manufacturing integration, transformation, and change management initiatives.
* Support enterprise growth through scalable operational solutions and disciplined execution.

**Scope of Responsibility**

* Multiple manufacturing facilities within assigned region.
* Direct leadership of Plant Directors, Factory Managers, Regional Engineering, Manufacturing Excellence, and operational support functions.
* Accountability for regional safety, quality, production, service, cost, talent, and financial performance.
* Significant influence on capital planning, organizational design, and operational strategy.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business, or related field required.
* Master's Degree (MBA or related discipline) preferred.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* 10+ years leading multi-site manufacturing operations.
* Experience managing large-scale manufacturing networks in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or related industries.
* Proven success leading large teams through operational transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing significant P&L, productivity, and capital investment responsibilities.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Executive leadership and influence.
* Manufacturing operations expertise.
* Safety and quality systems leadership.
* Financial and operational acumen.
* Strategic thinking and execution.
* Change leadership and organizational transformation.
* Talent development and succession management.
* Data-driven decision making.
* Cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Success Measures**

* Safety Performance
* Quality Compliance & Customer Metrics
* OEE and Asset Reliability
* Production Attainment
* Cost per Case Equivalent
* Labor Productivity
* Service Levels / OTIF
* Associate Engagement
* Leadership Bench Strength
* Productivity Savings Delivery
* Capital Project Execution
* Manufacturing Excellence Maturity

**If you're ready to embark on an exciting journey with Primo Brands, apply now!**
**Salary Range Disclaimer**
The salary range provided for this position is an approximation based on market research, internal compensation data and the candidate’s qualifications and experience. Final salary offers are determined through a comprehensive evaluation of candidate qualifications and may vary depending on factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location of the position. Other components of the compensation package, including benefits and bonuses, will also be considered. We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we encourage open dialogue about compensation during the interview process.
 
 
Primo Brands’ established portfolio includes billion-dollar brands Poland Spring® and Pure Life®, premium brands like Saratoga® and Mountain Valley®, regional leaders such as Arrowhead®, Deer Park®, Ice Mountain® Ozarka®, and Zephyrhills®, purified brands, Primo Water® and Sparkletts®, and flavored and enhanced brands like Splash® and AC+ION®. Our extensive direct-to-consumer offerings and industry-leading line-up of innovative water dispensers create consumer connectivity through recurring water purchases across Water Direct, Water Exchange, and Water Refill. At Primo Brands, our more than 11,000 associates are at the heart of what we do and deliver on our mission to provide healthy hydration to consumers wherever, however and whenever they want it. We believe in fostering a respectful culture, which values our associates who are deeply invested in quality hydration, our communities, and the sustainability of our packaging and water sources for generations to come.
 
 
Primo Brands is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.
 
 
Candidates must possess strong English language skills to effectively communicate with customers and provide exceptional service. Proficiency in English is essential for understanding customer needs, resolving inquiries, and collaborating with team members.

identity_held_roles.description:
Our client is a leading precision metal component manufacturer serving the automotive and industrial sectors. Operating multiple advanced manufacturing facilities across the United States, they specialize in high-volume production using advanced metal forming and stamping technologies. They supply critical components to tier-one automotive suppliers and industrial OEMs.

**The Role**

We are recruiting a Vice President of Manufacturing to lead manufacturing operations for a multi-facility U.S. operation. Reporting directly to the President, this role has responsibility for all manufacturing and quality departments at the primary facility and oversight of operations at additional locations. This is a high-impact position with significant visibility throughout the organization and the opportunity to shape operational strategy during a period of growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all manufacturing and quality departments, ensuring optimal performance across production facilities
* Manage comprehensive capital and operational budgets with focus on balancing growth investments with financial discipline
* Establish manufacturing goals, performance metrics, and quality expectations
* Oversee staff recruitment and ensure proper staffing levels across all functional areas
* Maintain direct customer relationships regarding production capabilities, delivery schedules, and quality standards
* Implement and monitor continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs and enhance efficiency
* Drive adoption of industry quality management systems (IATF, ISO TS 16949, ISO 14001)
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and safety regulations across all operations
* Lead cross-functional initiatives and participate in strategic planning with the executive team
* Monitor production performance data and identify improvement opportunities

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field

* 15 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 10 years in management or supervisory roles
* Demonstrated experience leading manufacturing operations in automotive or precision metal processing industries
* Strong background with metal stamping, forming, or similar high-volume production processes
* Proficiency with lean manufacturing methodologies and continuous improvement frameworks (5S, Kaizen, etc.)
* Experience managing quality systems and regulatory compliance (IATF, TS 16949 preferred)
* Proven ability to lead and develop teams
* Strong communication skills and collaborative leadership approach
* Experience managing P&L and capital budgets
* Travel: Approximately 10% per month (primarily to other company facilities)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or advanced degree in Business or Engineering
* Experience managing multi-facility operations
* Background with tool design or manufacturing process optimization
* Exposure to global manufacturing environments
* Experience navigating supply chain challenges in automotive manufacturing

**Benefits**

* Base Salary: $200,000 - $235,000

* Performance Bonus
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage
* 401(k) retirement plan

identity_held_roles.title: Head of Aircraft Quality (R6146)
identity_held_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
 
 
**About Shield AI**
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.
 
 
**Job Description**
We’re looking for a hands-on quality leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production.
 
 
You will build the aircraft quality organization and establish the quality capability for our new Seattle-area production facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll own product and process quality across prototype, pre-series and production builds, ensuring that lessons from development become effective controls as the program scales.
 
 
This role owns the Quality Management System, quality engineering, inspection, nonconformance management and audit readiness for the X-BAT manufacturing operation. You’ll partner with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production and Supply Chain to prevent defects, resolve recurring problems and deliver aircraft that meet technical, customer and applicable regulatory requirements.
 
 
We need a technically credible leader who can build practical, scalable systems, make sound decisions under schedule pressure and challenge senior stakeholders constructively while keeping execution moving.
 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Build quality into prototype and launch

+ Lead quality planning and execution for X-BAT prototype and development builds, establishing appropriate inspection, test evidence and build records as designs evolve.
+ Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering to identify product and process risks, define critical controls and build quality requirements into tooling, work instructions and test plans.
+ Establish configuration and traceability controls with Engineering and Production, ensuring each aircraft’s build status, deviations and nonconformances are understood and documented.
+ Capture lessons from build, integration and test issues, and drive their incorporation into design changes, manufacturing processes and future builds.
+ Define quality readiness criteria for pre-series builds and production launch, validating inspection methods, process controls, workforce competence and closure of significant risks.

**Establish the Seattle quality operation**

* Recruit, develop and lead the quality team, building the technical capability and frontline support needed as aircraft production grows.
* Establish and maintain a lean, effective QMS for X-Forge 3, aligned with Shield AI’s wider quality framework, AS9100, ISO 9001 and applicable customer requirements.
* Lead certification readiness and internal, customer and external audits, driving timely closure and sustained effectiveness of corrective actions.
* Set up receiving, in-process and final inspection capability, including measurement equipment, calibration, training and quality records, in partnership with relevant functions.

**Deliver quality at rate**

* Own production quality performance, using first-pass yield, defects, rework and escapes to focus action where it improves aircraft quality and production flow.
* Lead containment, root cause analysis and corrective action for manufacturing quality issues, with clear functional ownership and verification that fixes prevent recurrence.
* Own the nonconformance and MRB process, ensuring disposition decisions follow approved technical authority and that affected hardware remains controlled.
* Partner with Supply Chain and supplier quality teams to resolve incoming quality issues and improve supplier performance before defects disrupt aircraft builds.
* Work with Engineering and Production to define acceptance evidence and ensure aircraft meet approved requirements before release.
* Use digital quality tools and manufacturing data to strengthen traceability, expose trends and reduce manual administration as production scales.
* Give leadership a clear view of quality performance, product risks and readiness; escalate or stop affected work when requirements or product integrity cannot be assured.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in quality, product assurance or reliability within aerospace, defense technology or high-reliability manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success leading quality through prototype or new product introduction and into sustained production.
* Proven ability to build and scale quality teams and systems while supporting fast-paced development and manufacturing operations.
* Deep expertise in containment, root cause analysis, MRB, corrective and preventive action, and continuous improvement.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001, with practical implementation and audit leadership experience.
* Experience with complex assembly, inspection, configuration control, traceability and product acceptance.
* Ability to influence and challenge senior leaders constructively across Engineering, Production and Supply Chain.
* A hands-on leadership style and sound technical judgment, balancing timely execution with clear quality standards and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through production launch and rate ramp.
* Experience establishing quality capability at a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites.
* Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration, production test and reliability improvement.
* Experience deploying digital quality systems, statistical process controls and data-driven defect prevention.
* Advanced degree in engineering, quality or a related technical discipline.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Atlas Molded Products**
- a Division of
**Atlas Roofing Corporation**
- specializes in the development and manufacture of innovative, high-quality, HFC- and HCGC- free Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) insulation for construction, packaging, and original equipment management (OEM) products. Atlas EPS insulation is suitable for interior and exterior construction applications, various packaging uses and as part of manufactured systems, such as recreational vehicles, garage and pedestrian doors and sunroom panels.
 
 
**Atlas Roofing Corporation,**
a privately owned company established in 1982, is an international and multi-divisional manufacturer of roofing, sheathing, facer, and insulation product solutions.
 
 
**Atlas Molded Products is seeking a Plant Manager for the Murray, Utah Facility.**
**Plant Manager Primary Responsibilities**

* Responsible for all safety, product quality, company culture/values, operational performance, environmental health and safety compliance and all local, state, and federal standards.
* Coordinate all aspects of plant operations through plant leadership to ensure the site meets or exceeds the key performance indicators for safety, quality, and service while minimizing cost, inventory, and waste.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries in line with corporate guidance.
* Serve as plant champion for safety and quality programs and initiatives. Ensure a safe work environment through strict adherence to Atlas’ safety policies and procedures with focus on developing a zero-injury culture.
* Achieve manufacturing profit objectives to meet quality and delivery requirements (Customer Service) at the lowest overall cost.
* Support Engineering with product improvements, new product development, and testing.
* Manage capital equipment selection, acquisition, and implementation, manufacturing budget and long-range planning, preparation, and facility maintenance and enhancements.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the workplace.
* Responsible for selection of development of direct reports and creating an atmosphere of career development within the facility.
* Establish and maintain clear and measurable expectations for each employee to build ownership within the team.
* Complete all administrative requirements (monthly reports, manufacturing reports and analysis, etc.)

**Plant Manager Experience**

* Ten years of progressive experience in manufacturing management experience required.
* 5+ years direct supervisory experience, including staff development and planning responsibility.
* 5+ years’ experience engaging employees and developing a strong safety culture.
* Experience with business financial statements, budgetary processes, and cost control.
* Proven track record of developing, leading, and maintaining a continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience in capital investment planning and program management.
* Experience with Environmental, Health and Safety regulatory compliance.

**Plant Manager Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* An ability to balance and achieve positive results in the areas of safety, quality, productivity, cost, and employee relations.
* A demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others.
* Analytic skills to effectively evaluate business proposals and analyze process data.
* Ability to multi-task effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient with MS Office and experienced with manufacturing ERP systems.
* Must have a flexible schedule and be able to work extended hours if needed per business needs.

**Plant Manager Education, Licenses & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) in related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Plant Manager Additional Information**

* Must be able to tolerate industrial/manufacturing environment to include variations in temperature from extreme cold to extreme heat; wet and/or humid conditions; dust/fumes/chemical exposure; and noise intensity. Personal protective equipment required.

**Total Compensation**

* Atlas Molded Products offers a competitive compensation and vacation/holiday package as well as a comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D/LTD insurance, 401k and Medical & Dependent Care Spending Accounts.

**Atlas Roofing Corporation**
is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer
 
 
***No calls or agencies please.***

identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Summary**
The Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering is a hands-on leadership role and the process authority for how Butcher Power Products’ switchboard and switchgear products are built. The person in this role must be the subject-matter expert who can also do the work — capable of designing and improving manufacturing processes and line layouts, building routings and process documentation, and personally leading process and PFMEA reviews — so they can teach and develop the manufacturing engineering team and set the standard for process quality. This role owns how products are built rather than what is designed; however, deep familiarity with the product and the production floor is essential. The Director must understand the design intent released by Product Engineering and the realities of the floor in order to engineer processes that are efficient, repeatable, and capable. This role works hand in hand with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process, partners with Quality on process controls, and supports Production and Planning rather than owning them.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Process Engineering: Personally design, document, and improve the manufacturing processes, routings, work instructions, and line layouts that build the product. This is a working role: the successful candidate stays actively engaged in process design and technical problem-solving alongside the team rather than delegating all hands-on work.
* Process Authority & Technical Review: Lead, critique, and approve the team’s process designs, routings, PFMEAs, and control plans; set and enforce the standard for process quality, capability, and engineering rigor through formal process reviews.
* Mentorship & Teaching: Coach, train, and develop manufacturing engineers and technicians in process design, tooling, DFM/DFA, Lean and Six Sigma, time studies, and structured problem-solving, raising the technical capability of the whole team.
* Leadership & Management: Lead and manage the manufacturing engineering team, including hiring, development, workload balancing, priorities, and performance.
* Process Strategy & Standardization: Own manufacturing process strategy and standardization across product lines, and define the tooling and capital equipment roadmap.
* Product Engineering Partnership (DFM): Work closely and continuously with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process — provide manufacturability and assembly feedback at design reviews before release, jointly resolve producibility issues, and ensure released designs transition cleanly into production.
* Process Controls & Quality Partnership: Own the manufacturing side of PFMEAs and control plans in partnership with Quality Engineering; ensure processes are capable, controlled, and continuously monitored.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen across the function to improve throughput, cycle time, yield, and cost.
* Capital, Tooling & Automation: Plan and justify capital equipment, tooling, and automation investments, and provide financial management of the manufacturing engineering capital and tooling budgets.
* New Product Introduction (NPI): Lead the process side of NPI — develop and validate the processes, tooling, and routings that bring newly released designs into production.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Project Management, and Product Engineering on capacity, scheduling, and material flow, supporting these functions rather than owning them.
* Safety & Compliance: Ensure manufacturing processes across the function comply with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including UL 891, NEC, and ANSI.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 8+ years of progressive process engineering (or directly related) experience, including significant time spent personally developing and improving manufacturing processes.
* Hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks for process documentation, line layouts, and reviews; the ability to design tooling and fixtures in CAD is a plus.
* Strong proficiency developing routings, work instructions, process documentation, and process controls.
* Proven ability to lead formal process and PFMEA reviews and to mentor and train engineers and technicians.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a manufacturing engineering team.
* Strong working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, SPC, and process capability (Cpk).
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of the products being built and of how design intent translates into manufacturing process — sufficient product familiarity to engineer the right processes.
* Working knowledge of UL 891 and related standards (NEC, ANSI) as they affect manufacturing processes.
* Experience planning and justifying capital equipment and tooling investments, including financial management of budgets.
* Hands-on fabrication and machining experience is a plus.
* Automation experience is a plus.
* Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 8D or A3 is a plus.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
* Excellent leadership, project management, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on manufacturing process design and improvement (CAD)
* Process authority and engineering quality standards
* Technical mentoring, teaching, and team development
* Close partnership with Product Engineering (DFM)
* Process strategy, standardization, and tooling roadmap
* Design-for-manufacturability partnership
* Process controls, PFMEA, and capability
* Continuous improvement and Lean/Six Sigma
* Capital planning, automation, and financial management
* New product introduction (process side)
* Cross-functional collaboration and communication

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Manufacturing Process Engineer
identity_held_roles.description:
**Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering**

**Location:**
Rancho Cordova, CA (Onsite)

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent

**Compensation:**
Up to $225,000 annually

**Start Date:**
ASAP

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
**Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering**
to lead and develop a manufacturing engineering team within an established electrical equipment manufacturing operation in Rancho Cordova, California.

This is a
**working engineering leadership position**
requiring a strong combination of technical manufacturing expertise, process engineering experience, and team leadership.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience manufacturing
**low- and medium-voltage switchgear, switchboards, electrical power distribution equipment, or related electrical products**
.

This individual will take ownership of manufacturing processes, production efficiency, engineering standards, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring and developing a team of manufacturing engineers and technicians.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of manufacturing engineers and technicians.
* Personally develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes, production routings, work instructions, and facility layouts.
* Lead Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) reviews, control plans, and process capability improvements.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Collaborate with Product Engineering on Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFM/DFA).
* Lead manufacturing process development and implementation for new product introductions (NPI).
* Identify and implement improvements to manufacturing throughput, quality, efficiency, and cost.
* Develop tooling, equipment, and automation strategies to support production requirements.
* Evaluate and justify capital equipment investments and manufacturing improvements.
* Establish and maintain manufacturing engineering standards, procedures, and best practices.
* Partner with Quality, Production, Planning, and Engineering teams to resolve technical challenges.
* Ensure manufacturing processes comply with applicable UL 891, NEC, ANSI, and safety requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* **Hands-on manufacturing process engineering experience**
 , including process development, production layouts, routings, and work instructions.
* **Experience manufacturing switchgear, switchboards, LV/MV electrical distribution equipment, industrial electrical enclosures, or closely related products.**
* Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing manufacturing engineering teams.
* Strong working knowledge of PFMEA, SPC, control plans, process capability (Cpk), Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and DFM/DFA.
* **Hands-on experience using SolidWorks.**
* Experience developing manufacturing tooling, production processes, and equipment layouts.
* Experience with capital equipment planning, budgeting, and justification.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Ability to balance strategic engineering leadership with direct technical involvement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10+ years of manufacturing or process engineering experience, including significant hands-on process development.
* 5+ years of manufacturing engineering leadership experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Background in fabrication, machining, or industrial electrical equipment assembly.
* Experience implementing manufacturing automation and production equipment improvements.
* Knowledge of 8D and A3 problem-solving methodologies.
* Experience supporting new product introductions and production scaling.
* Familiarity with UL 891, NEC, ANSI, and applicable electrical equipment manufacturing standards.

**Work Environment & Location**

* **Fully onsite position in Rancho Cordova, California.**
* Hands-on involvement with manufacturing operations, engineering teams, and production personnel.
* Regular collaboration with production, quality, and engineering departments.
* **Relocation assistance is not available.**
 Candidates must be able to work onsite in Rancho Cordova.

**Compensation**

**Annual Salary: Up to $225,000**
, depending on experience and qualifications.

This is a permanent, full-time leadership opportunity with an anticipated start date as soon as possible.

identity_held_roles.title: Senior Manager, Quality – Development Programs (R5315)
identity_held_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
 
 
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager of Quality is responsible for establishing and leading all quality activities for a complex aerospace development program from prototype through production readiness. This role serves as the primary quality leader embedded within the program team and partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Flight Test, and Program Management to ensure products are designed, developed, tested, and transitioned to production with quality, reliability, and mission success as foundational objectives.
 
 
The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.
 
 
This position requires balancing speed of development with disciplined engineering rigor to support aggressive program schedules while ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.
 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Development Quality Leadership
* Serve as the quality leader for XBAT development.
* Establish quality strategy, objectives, and metrics aligned with program milestones.
* Integrate quality requirements into the product development lifecycle.
* Ensure quality considerations are incorporated during system architecture, design reviews, verification, validation, and qualification activities.
* Partner with Engineering leadership to identify and mitigate technical and programmatic risks.
* Drive a culture of proactive quality and continuous improvement throughout the program.

**Design & Configuration Quality**

* Ensure quality requirements are appropriately captured in product definitions, specifications, and design documentation.
* Participate in design reviews, change control boards, and configuration management activities.
* Ensure full configuration and traceability for all material installed into prototype aircraft.
* Evaluate engineering changes for quality and production readiness impacts.
* Support requirements verification and validation planning.
* Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-quality, and design-for-reliability initiatives.

**Risk Management & Reliability**

* Lead quality participation in program risk management activities.
* Establish and maintain FRACAS processes for development and flight test phases of the program.
* Facilitate root cause and corrective action investigations for design, manufacturing, supplier, and field failures.
* Support reliability growth planning and execution.
* Monitor defect trends, failure modes, and reliability metrics to identify systemic risks.

**Verification, Validation & Test Quality**

* Develop quality oversight strategies for laboratory, ground, and flight test activities.
* Ensure test results, anomalies, and nonconformances are appropriately documented and dispositioned.
* Support qualification and certification efforts.
* Establish processes for managing test escapes, failures, and corrective actions.

**Nonconformance & Corrective Action Management**

* Lead Material Review Board activities for development hardware.
* Establish scalable processes for nonconformance management.
* Drive root cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Track effectiveness of corrective actions through closure.

**Production Readiness & Industrialization**

* Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to transition products from prototype to production.
* Define quality requirements for production readiness reviews.
* Support development of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and control strategies.
* Ensure lessons learned from development are incorporated into production processes.
* Lead quality planning activities supporting low-rate initial production and rate increases.

**Quality Management System**

* Develop and implement quality processes supporting aerospace development programs.
* Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and internal procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement of development quality processes.
* Support internal and external audits as required.
* Establish scalable systems that support future production growth.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.
* Recruit and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.
* Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.
* Promote a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.
* Develop organizational capabilities to support future company growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, space, or other highly regulated industries.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical quality organizations.
* Experience supporting complex product development programs from concept through production transition.
* Strong knowledge of quality systems, engineering development processes, and aerospace manufacturing.
* Experience leading root cause investigations and corrective action programs.
* Experience with risk management, reliability engineering, and failure analysis.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting UAV, aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology programs.
* Experience leading quality organizations during rapid company growth.
* Background in systems engineering, reliability engineering, or development engineering.
* Experience with flight test programs and qualification testing.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.
* Familiarity with government defense programs and customer quality requirements.

**Temporary Employee Offer Package**
Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)
