Work Model: This role can be performed remotely from an approved location, with flexibility based on business needs and applicable requirements.
 
 
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 
 
Regal Rexnord Business System (“RBS”) plays a pivotal role in driving organizational change and process improvement to achieve our business objectives. The
**Linear Motion Division**
(“LMD”) within the AMC segment is seeking a
**Director of RBS**
. Reporting to the President of the Division, this position will drive the implementation, maturity, and cultural adoption of RBS and continuous process improvement across the division.
 
 
This leadership position is focused on the deployment of RBS across the Division to drive both short and long-term goals and will partner closely with LMD’s leadership team, as well as the AMC RBS team. The right candidate will drive operational excellence, develop CI capability, and ensure alignment to strategic priorities through Policy Deployment. This leader influences across manufacturing sites, functional teams, and the broader AMC organization to deliver year-over-year performance improvement. As a key member of the AMC RBS Team, this role will impact results and culture by establishing standards, institutionalizing management systems and ensuring effective problem-solving skills (& tool capability) across the organization.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
**Continuous Improvement Leadership and Standard Work**

* Champion the Lean philosophy and its deployment across all functions and manufacturing sites.
* Support the organization in achieving SQDCG and financial objectives through effective application of the RBS tools and methodologies to achieve continuous improvement.
* Develop and drive the divisional CI Roadmap and ensure alignment to site-level plans.
* Lead, guide, and help create solutions for highly complex and multi-faceted problems requiring ingenuity, creativity, innovation, and strong analytical skills. Problems are unique and require a thorough understanding of operating unit policies and practices. Apply knowledge of different techniques and practices to achieve desired results
* Connect operational improvements (e.g., machine productivity, labor productivity, lead time/turnaround time, quality, backlog, capacity, OEE, etc.) to financial outcomes (Revenue/TVOS, Cost, Cash, Margin).
* Participate in the hiring, development and coaching of site continuous improvement leaders.
* Utilize a team-oriented structured problem-solving approach to analyze current conditions, diagnose problems, and identify improvement opportunities.

**Capability and Talent Development**

* Support Division and Site RBS leaders in maturing the Regal Rexnord Business System through the development of skills, capabilities, and engagement driving impact to the next level.
* Coach, mentor, and train Regal Rexnord associates on CI tools and Lean leadership.
* Develop RBS capability through formal training and “stop-and-teach” coaching at Gemba.
* Lead and coach multiple projects and Kaizen events simultaneously through both a hands-on and influential approach.
* Engage and influence teams at all levels to drive momentum toward the future state.
* Identify, coach, and develop talent; build a strong bench of RBS tool champions across the division to leverage RBS Continuous Improvement tools and methodologies to support their professional advancement and improve the business's operational performance.

**Policy Deployment**

* Lead the creation of annual X-Matrix and oversee the deployment plan via RBS charters, bowlers, and action plans.
* Manage charters, bowlers, action plans and monthly PD cadence.
* Support Division Annual Improvement Priorities through effective application of RBS tools and methodologies to support Policy Deployment initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field; Advanced degree preferred (MS Engineering, MBA)
* 8-10 years relevant work experience across Continuous Improvement, Business Systems, or Operations (global and/or multi-site experience preferred)
* Familiarity with Policy Deployment, its facilitation and implementation.
* Technical background in continuous improvement methodology and framework
* Proven successful applications of multiple CI tools: 80/20, Lean Leadership, including Daily Management, KPI Leadership, Standard Work, Gemba Walks, Value Stream Mapping, 6S, Transactional Process Improvements, Kanban/replenishment systems, FMEA, Advanced Problem Solving, RCCMs
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate Kaizen-type events to produce measurable improvements (financial, service, quality, etc.)
* Skilled and experienced in decomposing a strategic vision into actionable strategies and tactics.
* Critical thinking skills to properly identify problem area & potential solutions
* Demonstrate the Regal Rexnord Values; Integrity, Responsibility, Diversity, Engagement & Inclusion, Customer Success, Innovation with Purpose, Continuous Improvement, Performance, Passion to Win, and Sense of Urgency
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Must be able to travel at least 50-75% of the time domestically and internationally as required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project and program management expertise (PMP, Prince II)
* Lean Six Sigma certification (e.g, Green Belt or Black Belt)
* Experience with High Mix / Low Volume and Low Mix / High Volume manufacturing

Physical Demand and Work Environment
 
 
**Physical Demands**
– while performing the duties in this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands; reach with hands and arms; and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and sit.
 
 
**Work Environment**
– the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
 
 
Restrictions imposed by federal export control laws may limit this job opportunity to candidates who are a "U.S. Person,' which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted asylum in the United States, and refugees in the United States.
 
 
Expected salary: $160,000 - $190,000 annually. The salary range provided is intended to display the value of the company's base pay compensation for all statewide locations across the United States. Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, candidate's skill set, level of experience, education, and internal peer compensation comparisons.
 
 
**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
* Paid Leaves
* Tuition Assistance

**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
 
 
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
 
 
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
Regal Rexnord is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, ancestry, national origin, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status (unless required by the applicable law or government contract), disability or protected veteran status or any other status or characteristic protected by law. Regal Rexnord is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to building a team that represents diverse and inclusive backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. If you’d like to view a copy of the company’s affirmative action plan for protected veterans/individuals with disabilities or policy statement, please email Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
Equal Employment Opportunity Posters
 
 
**Notification to Agencies**
: Please note that Regal Rexnord Corporation and its affiliates and subsidiaries ("Regal Rexnord") do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Description**
**Alvarez & Marsal Private Equity Performance Improvement**
**Director: Operations & Manufacturing**
**(OPEN TO ALL U.S. LOCATIONS)**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 13,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
 
 
**The Team**
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice, with offices throughout the US, focuses on serving the middle market and large cap private equity firms who have engaged A&M to help improve operating results at their portfolio companies.
 
 
Our professionals are aligned with a PEPI service line to promote the development of deep functional skills & experiences and to maximize our ability to tailor solutions to solve our clients' business issues.
 
 
We bring a structured and disciplined approach to create and capture value. We provide private equity clients with a broad continuum of knowledge and tools for cost improvements, transformations, mergers, acquisitions, and carve-outs.
 
 
A&M’s Operations professionals assist our clients in analyzing
**manufacturing operations**
, supply chain and distribution channels, procurement, SG&A operations, and sales force effectiveness for potential value creation opportunities and help drive them during our client’s ownership. From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of operations, identify key risks to investment and quantify potential EBITDA improvement plans for the buyer and seller.
 
 
The PEPI Operations group is a growing business targeting high growth in the next two to four years. We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and leadership skills. The leadership team is focused on providing development opportunities, training, and exposure to international business assignments.
 
 
**How You Will Contribute**
We are seeking individuals that can lead and deliver large, complex client engagements, working closely with PE leadership to identify, design, and implement creative business solutions for their portfolio companies. Directors frequently lead the following types of engagements:
 
 

* Gain a comprehensive understanding of a target’s manufacturing and distribution operations-- organization design, production capacity, efficiency, quality, planning, warehousing and team capability
* Evaluate the maintainability and operability of production facilities
* Review current and historical data to understand efficiency & capacity, including equipment conditions, maintenance logs, spare parts and detailed production numbers
* Provide shop floor insights by talking with employees and customers and reviewing all available data
* Identify potential cost improvement opportunities through lean improvements, outsourcing or consolidation of facilities
* Develop transformation plans to drive proposed changes and identify key risks and mitigation strategies
* Implement and oversee the quality of deliverables and effectively manage the team and day-to-day relationships to ensure exceptional performance.

**Qualifications**

* 10-15 plus years of combined professional industry and consulting experience, with a minimum of 4 years specializing in manufacturing and/or distribution functions
* Previous advisory experience from a top-tier strategy firm, leading specialist, niche advisory firm, or Big-4 consultancy REQUIRED
* Travel-- This role requires significant client-site presence, with travel up to 80% of the time — generally Monday through Thursday or Friday, including overnight stays. Candidates should be comfortable with a consulting travel lifestyle.
* Experience working for or with private equity sponsors and portfolio companies. Deep functional expertise in one of more of the following areas:
* Supply Chain Operations
* Manufacturing Operations, SI&OP
* Footprint optimization, plant consolidation and product line transfer
* Manufacturing strategy, CapEx planning, Manufacturing 4.0/IIoT
* Lean, Six Sigma, TOC and Value Engineering
* Demonstrated track record working with C-suite executives as well as private equity deal and operating partners
* Excellent fact-gathering and analytical skills, including business process mapping and quantitative analysis
* Specific experience designing and leading the execution of internally-focused and externally-focused change/communications strategy.
* Excellent fact-gathering and analytical skills, including business process mapping and quantitative analysis
* Previous strategy and change management experience.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
 
 
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
 
 
The salary range is $150,000--$225,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.
 
 
Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.
 
 
Full-time Positions and Part-time Positions Over 30 hours
 
 
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined from time to time as well as a 401(k)-retirement plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive a discretionary contribution to their 401(k) from Alvarez & Marsal. **About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 13,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
 
 
**The Team**
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice, with offices throughout the US, focuses on serving the middle market and large cap private equity firms who have engaged A&M to help improve operating results at their portfolio companies.
 
 
Our professionals are aligned with a PEPI service line to promote the development of deep functional skills & experiences and to maximize our ability to tailor solutions to solve our clients' business issues.
 
 
We bring a structured and disciplined approach to create and capture value. We provide private equity clients with a broad continuum of knowledge and tools for cost improvements, transformations, mergers, acquisitions, and carve-outs.
 
 
A&M’s Operations professionals assist our clients in analyzing
**manufacturing operations**
, supply chain and distribution channels, procurement, SG&A operations, and sales force effectiveness for potential value creation opportunities and help drive them during our client’s ownership. From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of operations, identify key risks to investment and quantify potential EBITDA improvement plans for the buyer and seller.
 
 
The PEPI Operations group is a growing business targeting high growth in the next two to four years. We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and leadership skills. The leadership team is focused on providing development opportunities, training, and exposure to international business assignments.
 
 
**How You Will Contribute**
We are seeking individuals that can lead and deliver large, complex client engagements, working closely with PE leadership to identify, design, and implement creative business solutions for their portfolio companies. Directors frequently lead the following types of engagements:
 
 

* Gain a comprehensive understanding of a target’s manufacturing and distribution operations-- organization design, production capacity, efficiency, quality, planning, warehousing and team capability
* Evaluate the maintainability and operability of production facilities
* Review current and historical data to understand efficiency & capacity, including equipment conditions, maintenance logs, spare parts and detailed production numbers
* Provide shop floor insights by talking with employees and customers and reviewing all available data
* Identify potential cost improvement opportunities through lean improvements, outsourcing or consolidation of facilities
* Develop transformation plans to drive proposed changes and identify key risks and mitigation strategies
* Implement and oversee the quality of deliverables and effectively manage the team and day-to-day relationships to ensure exceptional performance.

**Qualifications**

* 10-15 plus years of combined professional industry and consulting experience, with a minimum of 4 years specializing in manufacturing and/or distribution functions
* Previous advisory experience from a top-tier strategy firm, leading specialist, niche advisory firm, or Big-4 consultancy REQUIRED
* Travel-- This role requires significant client-site presence, with travel up to 80% of the time — generally Monday through Thursday or Friday, including overnight stays. Candidates should be comfortable with a consulting travel lifestyle.
* Experience working for or with private equity sponsors and portfolio companies. Deep functional expertise in one of more of the following areas:
* Supply Chain Operations
* Manufacturing Operations, SI&OP
* Footprint optimization, plant consolidation and product line transfer
* Manufacturing strategy, CapEx planning, Manufacturing 4.0/IIoT
* Lean, Six Sigma, TOC and Value Engineering
* Demonstrated track record working with C-suite executives as well as private equity deal and operating partners
* Excellent fact-gathering and analytical skills, including business process mapping and quantitative analysis
* Specific experience designing and leading the execution of internally-focused and externally-focused change/communications strategy.
* Excellent fact-gathering and analytical skills, including business process mapping and quantitative analysis
* Previous strategy and change management experience.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
 
 
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
 
 
The salary range is $150,000--$225,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.
 
 
Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.
 
 
Full-time Positions and Part-time Positions Over 30 hours
 
 
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined from time to time as well as a 401(k)-retirement plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive a discretionary contribution to their 401(k) from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world.
 
 
**What We Offer**
Salary:
 
 
$168,000.00 - $231,000.00
 
 
Location:
 
 
Santa Clara,CA
 
 
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
 
 
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
 
 
**What You'll Do**
Be a part of internal consulting team with high visibility to Applied Global Services executive leadership. Lead strategic projects to streamline business processes, improve supply chain and operations, reduce costs, and improve business performance through advanced analytics. Have responsibility for complete project life cycle starting with analysis of the as-is process, identification and quantification of the opportunities, development of improvement streams, securing buy-in from stakeholders, and driving implementation.
 
 
High impact role that requires relentless change management motivation rewarded with material impact to business unit performance.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Structure and break down complex business problems, develop hypothesis, drive analysis and deliver data-driven recommendations
* Lead thoughtful and rigorous analysis across large data sets and synthesize insights and opportunities
* Develop and present high-quality recommendation and deliverables for executive level consumption and contribute to associated strategy and execution discussions
* Work collaboratively across a cross-functional set of stakeholders to gather the right information, pressure test your hypothesis, co-create deliverables, accelerate execution and unlock value
* Optimize operations and business process to improve performance, reduce cycle time, and shrink costs

**Qualifications**

* Industrial Engineering or equivalent Bachelor degree. MBA preferred
* 10+ years relevant work experience
* Semiconductor experience preferred
* Management consulting experience preferred
* Broad understanding and experience including logistics, financial reporting, operations, and service business management.
* Strong analytical skills – able to extract real insight from multiple data sources
* Excellent oral and written communication, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills
* Able to work effectively in a matrix environment and influence others
* Detail oriented, able to connect the dots and communicate complex ideas effectively
* Knowledge of Lean / Six Sigma

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
Full time
 
 
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
 
 
**Travel:**
Yes, 10% of the Time
 
 
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes
 
 
The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.
 
 
For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.
 
 
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
 
 
In addition, Applied endeavors to make our careers site accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us via e-mail at Accommodations\_Program@amat.com, or by calling our HR Direct Help Line at 877-612-7547, option 1, and following the prompts to speak to an HR Advisor. This contact is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

identity_held_roles.title: Quality Improvement Director
identity_held_roles.description:
***POSITION PURPOSE:***

The Director of Quality Improvement operates under the leadership and direction of the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) and Chief Operating Officer (COO). The CMO maintains direct clinical oversight of clinical quality improvement activities and regulatory quality programs. The Director of Quality Improvement provides organization-wide leadership for EVCHC's quality improvement program. The Director establishes the quality strategy in partnership with executive, clinical, operational and compliance leaders; converts organizational goals and regulatory requirements into measurable work plans; and leads improvement efforts that strengthen patient outcomes, safety, access, equity and care experience. The Director is accountable for reliable quality data, required clinical quality reporting, continuous improvement methods, Patient Centered Medical Home recognition, and the performance of the Quality Improvement Department.

 

***MAJOR POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS:***

**Quality Strategy and Governance**

* Lead the development, implementation and annual evaluation of EVCHC's organization-wide Quality Improvement and Quality Assurance Plan in alignment with the strategic plan, clinical standards and applicable Health Center Program requirements.

* Establish annual quality priorities, measures, targets, owners and timelines with executive and clinical leadership. Monitor progress and recommend corrective action when performance does not meet established goals.

* Lead or support the Quality Improvement Committee and related workgroups. Prepare agendas, dashboards, meeting materials, decisions and follow-up reports for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, as requested.

* Advise executive leaders on emerging quality risks, performance trends, resource needs and opportunities to improve care delivery across sites and service lines.

* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, patient safety and learning throughout the organization.

**Department Leadership**

* Direct the work of the Quality Improvement Department, including recruitment, onboarding, supervision, coaching, performance evaluation, workload assignment and staff development.

* Develop departmental goals, staffing plans, procedures and budgets that support timely completion of quality priorities and reporting obligations.

* Set clear expectations for the accuracy, timeliness and usability of analyses, audits, reports and improvement support provided by the department.

* Build effective working relationships with clinical care teams, Operations, Information Technology, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, Behavioral Health, Dental and other departments involved in quality outcomes.

**Quality Measurement and Reporting**

* Oversee the collection, validation, analysis and submission of clinical quality measures and required reports, including Uniform Data System measures, population health platforms transition and readiness, HEDIS and payer measures, grant measures and internal quality indicators.

* Develop and maintain executive, provider, site and service-line dashboards that show current performance, trends, disparities, targets and improvement actions.

* Track provider and care-team performance, identify variation and care gaps, and provide leaders with actionable information while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and data-use standards.

* Establish data-validation controls and documentation so that quality reports can be reconciled to source systems and used as an organization-wide source of truth. Partnering with Director of Data and IT operations for oversight on data governance committee.

* Present quality findings in clear written and verbal reports to the Board, executive leadership, managers, providers, staff, health plans and external reviewers, as appropriate.

**Performance Improvement**

* Lead Plan Do Study Act cycles, root-cause analyses and other structured improvement methods from problem definition through implementation, evaluation and sustainment.

* Partner with clinical and operational leaders to improve preventive care, chronic disease outcomes, access, continuity, patient experience, care coordination, documentation and other priority measures.

* Translate data findings into practical workflow changes, training, decision support, audit tools and accountability processes that can be sustained across sites.

* Evaluate improvement results, identify lessons learned and spread effective practices to other care teams, programs or locations when appropriate **Regulatory Readiness and Patient Safety**

* Lead the quality components of Patient Centered Medical Home recognition and renewal, including evidence collection, workflow assessment, documentation, staff education and sustainment of recognized practices alongside Director of compliance.

* Partner with Compliance Director, Risk Management, clinical leadership and Operations on quality-related readiness for HRSA operational site visits, FTCA deeming and risk-management activities, health plan audits, accreditation reviews and other external assessments.

* Support corrective action plans with the Director of Compliance arising from audits, quality reviews, safety events or regulatory findings. Define measures, monitor completion and verify that corrective actions are effective and sustained.

* Analyze trends in patient safety events, grievances and quality-of-care concerns with the appropriate leaders while protecting confidentiality and following reporting requirements.

* Maintain organized records of quality plans, committee actions, reports, audits, improvement projects and supporting evidence required for oversight and external review.

**Clinical Analytics and Health Information Technology**

* Direct the clinical analytics program and define reporting requirements that support clinical decision-making, population health management and performance improvement.

* Partner with Information Technology and system vendors to improve data extraction, interfaces, registries, care guidelines, clinical decision support, templates and reporting tools used for quality measurement.

* Lead data-governance practices for quality information, including measure definitions, ownership, validation, access, change control and resolution of reporting discrepancies.

* Assess the quality and workflow impact of new digital tools and automation used in clinical or quality processes and recommend safeguards, testing and performance monitoring before broad implementation.

* Recommend redesign of workflows affected by the electronic health record, patient portal, population health platforms and other clinical information systems.

**Organizational Responsibilities**

* Participate in executive, management, clinical and staff meetings related to quality priorities and organizational performance.

* Maintain current knowledge of FQHC quality requirements, clinical quality measures, health plan expectations and recognized improvement practices.

* Protect patient, employee and organizational information and comply with HIPAA, confidentiality, cybersecurity and records-management requirements.

* Perform other job-related duties as assigned within the scope of the position.

***POSITION REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:***

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in public health, health care administration, nursing, health sciences, informatics or a related field is required. A master's degree is preferred.

* At least five years of progressive experience in health care quality improvement, population health, clinical analytics or health care program management is required, including at least three years of supervisory or department leadership experience.

* Experience in a Federally Qualified Health Center, community health center or other safety-net setting is strongly preferred.

* Experience leading cross-functional improvement projects and preparing quality reports for executives, governing boards, health plans or regulatory agencies is required.

* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality, Lean or Six Sigma certification, or comparable quality-improvement training is preferred.

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Working knowledge of continuous quality improvement methods, patient safety practices, clinical quality measurement, health equity and population health management.

* Knowledge of HRSA Health Center Program expectations, Uniform Data System reporting, HEDIS measures, Patient Centered Medical Home standards and payer quality programs is strongly preferred.

* Advanced ability to collect, validate, analyze and present health care data and to translate findings into operational decisions and improvement plans.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience using electronic health records, population health platforms, data visualization tools or clinical reporting applications. Experience with NextGen or comparable systems is preferred.

* Strong leadership, project management, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build accountability across departments .

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet reporting deadlines, exercise sound judgment and communicate sensitive performance information professionally.

* Demonstrated commitment to serving medically underserved communities and reducing disparities in access, care and health outcomes.

identity_held_roles.description:
As the Regional Director of Food Safety & Quality Assurance, you will be responsible for overseeing and ensuring the highest standards of food safety and quality across our operations in the United States and/or Canada. You will lead a team of professionals dedicated to maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies while driving continuous improvement initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and locations.

**Duties and Responsibilities****:**

* Ensure individual plant teams are executing expected actions to meet corporate objectives
* Manages assigned plant FS-Q managers, and interacts with operations, R&D, and other relevant teams to implement the company’s strategic plan that encompasses all aspects of food safety and quality.
* Coaches plant FS-Q managers to ensure they perform according with strategic and the tactical/milestones necessary to achieve operational goals.
* Manages key customer (other than McDonald’s) QA relationships in conjunction with sales personnel.
* Work in partnership with direct manager to be in compliance with the regional McDonald’s FSQA expectations.
* Support and coach Plant FS-Q Managers for administering the department’s budget to ensure proper allocation of resources
* Assess and manages plant resources to ensure the QA and Food Safety KPI goals are achieved for the manufacturing plants under its purview.
* Ensures the food safety and quality of product and services by assessing compliance with product testing, performing internal assessments and audits of the FS-Q system and product lines, placing defective products on hold and taking corrective action
* Insures that all regulatory requirements are met including weights/measures, food safety, product claims, declarations, etc.
* Collaborates to standardize when required, QA policies/procedures to improve efficiency and reduce cost.
* Identifies and communicates FS- QA technologies to improve quality and reduce costs.
* Coaches and develops QA Managers to perform at a constantly exceptional level of performance, including but not limited to the sanitation program, compliance with the GFSI approved scheme audits; and when required acts as the plant’s SQF back-up Practitioner.
* Performs all other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Job Requirements:**

**Education/Certifications** **and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum of ten (10) years of management experience including Quality Management Systems and/or Manufacturing experience.
* Prefer experience in a bakery/dry mixing (dry blending, frozen dough and baked goods) production environment.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Proficient use of computer, Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote), and other related applications or software.
* Demonstrated leadership experience and a sense of urgency and the drive to make continuous improvements
* Ability to operate at single and multi-site levels from management to “hands on” to accomplish tasks. Must be a “working manager.”
* Demonstrated ability to make and act on decisions while balancing speed, food safety, quality and risk.
* Strong background in sanitation principles and practices, GFSI approved schemes (SQF, BRC), HACCP, GMPs, Safety and SPC.
* Ability to think clearly and in a decisive manner while remaining calm under in pressure situations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in a matrix environment and build strong relationships by being transparent, reliable, and accountable. Strong interpersonal skills backed-up by strong technical knowledge are critical to success in this role.
* Must have good writing skills and be able to communicate effectively with people at all levels of the company.

**Supervisory Responsibilities****:**

* Manage multiple direct reports including but not limited to: Sr. Quality Assurance Manager, Quality Assurance Manager, Analyst.
* Work requires supervising and monitoring work performance of direct reports including making final decisions on hiring and disciplinary actions, evaluating program/work objectives and effectiveness, and realigning work and staffing assignments, as needed.
* Develop functional responsibilities of individuals that report to this position and ensure that best-in class output is created.

**Working Conditions and Physical Effort:**

* Typical work in office environment but will spend periods of time in manufacturing plants which will have exposure to unusual elements, such as dirt, dust, fumes, odors, darkness and/or poor lighting, noise and vibration. Seasonal exposure to weather elements to include, but not limited to, extreme temperatures, wetness and humidity.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Substantial travel required (up to 50%) mostly in the North America.

**Expectations:**

* Will demonstrate, promote, and exemplify the Company’s Core Values.

At C.H. Guenther, we value transparency in compensation. By providing the salary range for this role, we aim to promote fairness and help candidates make informed choices about their career. The salary range for this role is:

$142,500.00 - $228,000.00 USD

Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, as well as geographic location.

**C.H. Guenther & Son will never offer or pay a wage or salary that is not compliant with applicable local, state, or federal pay laws, including minimum salary thresholds.**

We also offer a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, retirement savings options, flexible spending accounts, employee assistance programs, educational assistance, parental leave, paid time off, and company-paid holidays.

For additional information about our company, go to www.chg.com.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:**

At Cart.com, we're **defining the future of commerce.**

Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cart.com Milestones**

* Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
* Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
* Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
* Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
* Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
* Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

**Our values:** Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

* **Be brand obsessed:** Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
* **Think beyond the box:** “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.

* **Don’t give up:** We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
* **Speak up:** We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
* **Work together:** We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
* **Remember to be human:** We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

**AI is part of how we work. It's not doing the hiring.** 
 
We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet *you*, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

**Remote:**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates in AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MO, MS, NC, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. The salary range for this role is $175,000-200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for bonus, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off. Applications accepted through 1-31-2027. We comply with all applicable pay transparency laws in the states where we operate.

**The Role:**

The Director, Quality and Compliance leads the quality function for Cart.com’s federal pharmaceutical distribution business across four sites. This leader will standardize and strengthen an established quality program, develop site quality leaders, ensure consistent application of procedures, and serve as the primary quality point of contact for client reporting, audits and product-quality events.

This is approximately a 70% strategic leadership and 30% hands-on role. The Director will not build the program from the ground up, but will assess the current-state program, make targeted improvements, and ensure teams consistently execute against client, regulatory and network requirements. The role is remote with approximately 30% travel.

The role offers the opportunity to influence the quality standard for a growing federal business and help prepare the organization to support additional federal programs over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and develop site quality leaders across Maryland, Goodyear, Temecula and Memphis, establishing clear accountability, delegation and follow-through.
* Standardize quality procedures and expectations across the network while refining the existing quality management system and closing identified gaps.
* Ensure sites remain prepared for client and regulatory audits; support audit planning, host or coordinate inspections, and oversee timely responses and corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary quality point of contact for pharmaceutical product excursions and related client reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete and timely.
* Oversee quality processes supporting receiving, quarantine, release, disposition, returns, destruction, recalls, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, training, complaints and document control.
* Guide quality decisions for controlled-temperature pharmaceutical products, including refrigerated, frozen and ultra-cold storage and distribution.
* Partner with site Operations leaders and Cart.com’s Compliance team to implement operational changes required to meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Use quality metrics, audit findings, client feedback and site observations to identify risk, prioritize improvements and report progress to senior leadership.
* Travel to sites for audit preparation, team development, quality reviews and issue resolution.

**Who You Are:**

 

* You are a strategic, hands-on quality leader who can set direction while stepping into audits, excursions and site-readiness work when needed.
* You lead through others, delegate clearly, establish checkpoints and hold site quality leaders accountable for follow-through.
* You put the client’s requirements first, ask the right questions and respond with accurate, timely information.
* You communicate with credibility and composure across clients, regulators, Operations, Compliance and senior leadership.
* You are highly organized and disciplined, ensuring commitments, documentation and escalations do not get lost.
* You build strong cross-functional partnerships and can influence operational changes without creating a separate quality silo.
* You adapt to changing federal-client requirements while maintaining consistent quality standards and sound judgment.
* You develop people, address performance gaps directly and create a culture of ownership across a distributed team.

**What You’ve Done:**

 

* 7+ years of progressive pharmaceutical quality experience, including work in a current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) facility and meaningful pharmaceutical distribution, logistics or 3PL quality exposure.
* 5+ years of people-leadership experience with demonstrated success delegating, developing leaders and holding teams accountable.
* Worked in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale, logistics or third-party logistics (3PL). Manufacturing experience alone is not sufficient without meaningful distribution-quality exposure.
* Applied cGMP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), controlled-document and standard operating procedure requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Prepared for or led audits involving the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or comparable regulators, including managing responses and follow-up actions.
* Supported pharmaceutical product release, disposition, holds, recalls or temperature-excursion decisions in a regulated distribution setting.
* Written, revised or implemented quality procedures and documentation, then ensured consistent execution across teams or sites.
* Led a distributed or multi-site team and built accountability through site leaders rather than personally owning every task.
* Managed a significant client, product-quality or regulatory issue requiring coordination across Quality, Operations and Compliance.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biology, chemistry or a related field, or bring an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

**Nice to Haves:**

 

* Background supporting federal health programs or agencies such as HHS, DLA, ASPR, BARDA, DoD or VA.
* Experience with pharmaceutical 3PLs, wholesalers, state licensing or NABP accreditation.
* Hands-on experience with vaccines or other cold-chain and ultra-cold pharmaceutical products.
* Knowledge of Drug Supply Chain Security Act requirements and suspect or illegitimate product processes.
* Relevant certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Pharmaceutical GMP Professional or Lead Auditor.
* Master’s degree in a life-sciences or related discipline.
Direct leadership of quality teams 

 
 

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

 

* Remote work environment with regular computer and video-conference use.
* Ability to travel by air or ground up to 30% and work onsite in warehouse, pharmaceutical distribution and temperature-controlled environments.
* Ability to move through operating areas and wear required personal protective equipment when visiting sites.
* Flexibility to support audits, client needs or quality events outside standard business hours when required.

Eligibility Requirement: This position is open only to U.S. citizens due to applicable federal requirements. By applying, you confirm that you are a U.S. citizen and can provide acceptable documentation verifying your status if selected. 
 
If you are not a U.S. citizen, please do not apply for this role.

Cart.com is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

identity_held_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **About Shield AI:**

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.

### **Job Description:**

We’re looking for a hands-on manufacturing leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production.

You will lead prototype build execution and the manufacturing setup of our new Seattle-area facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll build the production team, establish the factory’s operating system and deliver the readiness needed to scale aircraft production safely, reliably and efficiently.

This role carries accountability across the full journey: turning lessons from development builds into a repeatable production system, then leading that operation against safety, quality, delivery and cost commitments. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management to make that happen.

**What you'll do:**

* **Lead prototype builds and new product introduction**

 + Own the day-to-day execution of X-BAT prototype and development aircraft builds, including assembly, integration, rework and build support for testing.
 + Partner with Program Management to establish achievable build schedules, resource plans and milestones, making constraints and trade-offs visible early.
 + Work with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering through build-test-learn cycles, ensuring build issues are captured, resolved and reflected in future designs and production processes.
 + Plan and execute pre-series builds to prove tooling, work instructions, material flow, process controls and workforce readiness before production ramp.
 + Maintain configuration discipline and aircraft traceability throughout development builds in partnership with Engineering and Quality.

 **Establish the Seattle production operation**

 + Lead manufacturing setup and operational readiness for X-Forge 3, working with Facilities and Manufacturing Engineering on factory layout, equipment installation, commissioning and production flow.
 + Recruit, develop and lead the production organization, building capable frontline leadership and a skilled aircraft assembly team.
 + Own production staffing, training and capacity plans, aligning investment and workforce growth with program demand.
 + Drive launch readiness across people, tooling, materials, processes and quality, with clear owners and closure plans for gaps.
 + Lead the transition from prototype operations into Seattle production, ensuring build knowledge and lessons learned transfer with the work.

 **Deliver and scale aircraft production**

 + Own production execution against safety, quality, delivery and cost targets as X-BAT moves through initial production and into sustained rate.
 + Establish daily operating routines, visual management and escalation processes that surface problems early and drive timely resolution.
 + Improve throughput, labor productivity, first-pass quality and schedule adherence through practical Lean methods and structured problem-solving.
 + Partner with Supply Chain and Planning to align material availability, supplier readiness and outsourced manufacturing with the production plan.
 + Work with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality to eliminate recurring build issues and embed permanent corrective actions.
 + Deploy digital manufacturing tools and appropriate automation to improve execution, traceability and scalability.
 + Give leadership a clear view of production performance, launch readiness, risks and the decisions needed to maintain progress.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in aerospace or comparable advanced manufacturing, including at least 5 years leading production teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading prototype or new product introduction builds and carrying a product into sustained production.
* Proven ability to build and scale manufacturing operations, including workforce development, capacity planning and production systems.
* Experience leading complex assembly and integration operations with demanding quality, configuration and traceability requirements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing readiness, tooling validation, material coordination and production launch.
* Track record of improving safety, quality, delivery and cost through Lean manufacturing and structured problem-solving.
* Ability to lead across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management, resolving competing priorities and driving clear accountability.
* A hands-on leadership style, with the ability to move between long-term factory planning and detailed problem-solving on the floor.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through initial and rate production.
* Experience establishing a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites.
* Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration and production test.
* Familiarity with aerospace quality systems, including AS9100, and digital manufacturing and traceability tools.
* Experience managing production interfaces with outsourced manufacturing partners and complex supplier networks.
* Advanced degree or relevant training in manufacturing leadership, program management or production launch.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Position Overview:**

As the Regional Senior Manager of Post Production/IQR, you will have the unique opportunity to partner closely with several different teams at multiple sites (including IC leadership, reconditioning, and support teams) to drive the strategy behind the development and deployment of Post Production & Quality programs, as well as manage continued performance of internal and external vendors. We are looking for a resourceful self-starter who will set the tone for the successful and fast-paced growth of our Inspection Centers. existing_roles.description:
**Executive Director / VP of Quality**

I’m partnering exclusively with a growing Pharmaceutical Company looking to bring on a Vice President of Quality to lead its entire site Quality organisation, reporting directly to the CEO.

This is a senior, high-impact leadership opportunity for an established Quality executive to shape the site's Quality strategy, strengthen regulatory compliance and build a scalable Quality organisation as the business enters its next phase of growth and investment.

The successful individual will have oversight of both Quality Assurance and Quality Control, with significant influence across manufacturing operations, regulatory affairs, product development and wider business strategy. This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the Quality function, work closely with executive leadership and help drive the business forward while maintaining the highest standards of product quality and patient safety.

**Key areas of responsibility:**

* Set the overall Quality vision, objectives and priorities for the site, leading both QA and QC and ensuring the function supports business growth, operational performance and regulatory compliance.
* Act as the senior Quality representative to the FDA, leading inspections, maintaining inspection readiness, managing regulatory responses and overseeing sustainable remediation where required.
* Own the effectiveness and continuous improvement of the site QMS, ensuring systems remain robust, risk-based and aligned with evolving regulatory expectations.
* Provide executive oversight of batch release, deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change control, complaints, supplier quality, document control and data integrity, maintaining appropriate independent Quality decision-making.
* Oversee analytical and microbiological testing, OOS investigations, stability programmes, laboratory systems, environmental monitoring and associated compliance requirements.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, R&D and Engineering to provide Quality oversight across product development, technology transfer, validation, commercial manufacturing and post-market activities.
* Establish meaningful Quality metrics, lead management reviews and use trend analysis, root-cause investigations and risk-based decision-making to address systemic issues and improve site performance.
* Build, lead and develop a high-performing Quality organisation, establishing the appropriate structure, technical capabilities, succession planning and resources to support the site's future needs.
* Work directly with the CEO and wider leadership team, translating complex regulatory requirements and Quality risks into practical business decisions while protecting compliance and patient safety.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive experience within pharmaceutical manufacturing, with substantial Quality leadership experience in sterile pharmaceutical products.
* Proven executive-level leadership across multidisciplinary Quality organisations, ideally with responsibility for both QA and QC.
* A strong track record of leading FDA inspections, managing regulatory interactions and driving successful inspection readiness and remediation programmes.
* In-depth knowledge of US pharmaceutical cGMP requirements, particularly 21 CFR Parts 210 and 211, with familiarity with relevant medical device regulations.
* Broad expertise across QMS, CAPA, validation and qualification, laboratory operations, supplier quality, complaints, risk management and data integrity.
* Experience supporting products throughout the lifecycle, from development and regulatory submissions through commercial manufacturing, release and post-market activities.
* Demonstrated success building Quality teams, developing future leaders and embedding a culture of accountability, compliance and continuous improvement.
* The ability to operate as a strategic business partner to executive leadership while maintaining the independence and authority required of the Quality function.
* A degree in a relevant scientific or technical discipline is required.

Apply today to learn more or reach out directly with your CV to rbanton@barringtonjames.com

existing_roles.description:
For more than three decades, Design West Technologies Inc. has been a trusted Department of War (DoW) partner, delivering mission-critical engineering and rugged manufacturing solutions supporting our nation's warfighters. Building on this defense heritage, DWT is embracing a growth-oriented, start-up culture aligned with evolving DoW opportunities. Based in Tustin, CA, DWT seeks an experienced Vice President of Manufacturing & Operations to lead manufacturing, production, supply chain, facilities, and operational functions. The ideal candidate brings proven aerospace, defense, or complex manufacturing leadership experience, combining strategic vision with hands-on execution to drive growth, organizational transformation, operational excellence, and accountability.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As VP of Manufacturing & Operations, you will provide strategic leadership while maintaining hands-on engagement across daily manufacturing execution, production performance, and operational priorities. You will develop and scale DWT's manufacturing capabilities, integrating people, processes, technology, and resources to drive operational excellence and sustainable growth. You will have executive accountability for manufacturing performance, P&L, capacity, supply chain, quality, safety, and customer delivery while ensuring operational capabilities support current and future business objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Manufacturing & Operations Excellence**

* Lead manufacturing functions, including production, planning, engineering, facilities, maintenance, and warehouse operations.
* Scale manufacturing capabilities, capacity, and infrastructure to support new program launches, increased customer demand, and long-term business growth.
* Drive operational excellence through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and 5S, improving throughput, productivity, automation, equipment utilization, and capacity while establishing KPIs, corrective actions, and scalable processes.

**Supply Chain Management**

* Lead Supply Chain, Procurement, and Production Planning to ensure alignment with business objectives and customer commitments.
* Optimize procurement, supplier performance, material availability, lead times, and inventory while controlling excess and obsolete materials.
* Align production schedules with customer demand, program requirements, and manufacturing capacity while strengthening supply chain resilience through proactive risk mitigation

**Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Partner with Quality and Engineering leadership to ensure manufacturing processes meet customer, regulatory, and quality requirements while promoting safety and accountability.
* Ensure compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001, ITAR, OSHA, and government-contracting requirements while driving audit readiness, corrective actions, defect reduction, and continuous improvement.

**Financial & Business Strategy**

* Own manufacturing P&L performance, including operating budgets, financial forecasts, labor costs, cost controls, capital expenditures, margins, and profitability, ensuring financial accountability and alignment with business objectives.
* Partner with the President and Finance leadership on operating plans, financial forecasts, capital investments, and performance metrics.
* Drive margin improvement through operational efficiency, automation, resource optimization, and process redesign while supporting strategic growth and business expansion.

**Cross-Functional & Organizational Leadership**

* Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align operational priorities, resources, and manufacturing objectives with business strategy.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Program Management to support production readiness, program execution, customer commitments, and new business opportunities.
* Build high-performing teams through clear accountability, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and leadership development while fostering collaboration, trust, and continuous improvement.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* 12–15+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years in senior leadership overseeing multiple functions.
* Proven experience managing complex manufacturing operations, P&L, budgets, capital investments, production planning, capacity, quality, delivery, and supply chain.
* Demonstrated success in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, operational strategy, business growth, organizational transformation, and cross-functional leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in aerospace, defense, electronics, precision, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments, preferably involving PCBA, microelectronics, ruggedized electronics, cable and harness assemblies, or complex electromechanical products.
* Experience scaling operations, integrating acquisitions, or leading organizational transformation. MBA, Master's degree, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification preferred.

**Are you ready to join our team?**
At DWT, we value teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement as we build for the future.

This person will provide leadership and hands-on support to ensure the seamless execution of GMP QA and QC functions, including product quality complaint investigation, root-cause investigations, and the reporting of critical GMP issues to executive management.  This person will also be responsible for leading, providing direction, resources, and guidance to ensure that all GMP quality processes are executed with the highest standards of compliance with FDA, EMA, and other international regulatory requirements, corporate objectives, and industry best practices. This role also involves ensuring that the GMP and GDP quality functions are closely aligned with the organization’s broader strategic goals, guaranteeing that quality initiatives support the company’s mission, vision, and operational objectives.

**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader to assist the head of quality to further develop the quality culture at Mirum to be compliant, collaborative and phase appropriate.
* Develop and execute a global GMP quality strategy to align with corporate goals and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the GMP quality strategic leader within the Quality group to lead the GMP QA and QC functional teams in fostering professional development and guiding staff in all aspects of GMP/GDP competence in meeting domestic and international regulatory requirements and guidelines (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, ICH, etc.).

* Lead the GMP inspection readiness for the Company including GMP Quality improvement and maintenance.
* Host/Manage GMP PAI/PLI inspections at Mirum and support Mirum PAI/PLI related CMO inspections.
* Drive corporate values, vision, goals, and objectives through collaboration with senior leaders building cross-functional networks to influence operational capabilities.
* Serve as a GMP Quality advisor to cross-functional stakeholders within Mirum global organizations and subsidiaries.
* Promote collaboration across internal and external functional teams and stakeholders to identify, design and implement opportunities for improvement across all areas of GMP and GDP quality responsibilities.
* Establish, maintain, and ensure effectiveness of GMP and GDP quality programs and documentation to assure GxP compliance in the domestic and international regulatory environment.
* Oversee, support and perform all aspects of GMP QA and QC activities and functions for drug manufacturing to ensure product quality and supply chain integrity.
* Oversee and support all aspects of clinical and commercial product release which includes direct to market, partner and distributor.
* Serve as the Material Review Board (MRB) chair-person designee.
* Develop and execute a global recall strategy that integrates domestic and international recalls.
* Serve as the Recall Coordinator in the recall committee and support the recall/mock recall process.
* Collaborate with Commercial Organization on launch strategies, NPP/EAP/CUP programs and provide input as a Quality SME.
* Review and approval of GMP, GDP, Partner and Distributor Quality/Technical Agreements.
* Oversee the review and approval of APQR generation in a timely fashion.
* Assess the outcome of GMP audits at CMOs, CTLs, Partners, etc. for a holistic view and to partner with the Technical Operations team in driving improvements.
* Provide strategic and managerial leadership related to company objectives & initiatives and changing regulatory requirements to build, manage, and mentor high-performance QA and QC teams in a global environment.
* Oversee product launch, manufacturing, and distribution quality processes.
* Lead a culture of quality excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* Ensure global GMP Quality Team meets stakeholder needs, focusing on efficiency, quality, budget management, and corporate growth.
* Serve as Quality Head designee for other GXP areas beyond GMP and GDP as required.
* Requires 15% domestic and international travel, at minimum.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education /Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, chemistry, biology, or other science related field (Advanced degree preferred).
* 15+ years of progressive Quality Assurance experience in pharmaceutical and/or Biotech industries, with at least 10+ years in quality leadership role and/or people management including direct & indirect reports.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of cGMP manufacturing and Quality Management in compliance with FDA (CBER and/or CDER) and EMA requirements for global-regulated products.
* Demonstrates extensive knowledge of the development and commercialization of medical device in compliance with FDA 21CFR820, ISO13485 and EMA MDR regulations
* Comprehensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO, ICH, and global regulatory requirements.

* Must be able to work cross functionally as a strong collaborator with ability to partner with internal and external stakeholders across multiple global regions.
* Experience with managing Product Quality Complaints and Pharmacovigilance Quality is a plus
* Experience in rare disease and/or biologics, a plus.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**
