The Director of Value-Add Manufacturing oversees all value-added manufacturing operations, ensuring safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives are consistently achieved. This role provides strategic leadership for manufacturing activities including machining, fabrication, assembly, kitting, packaging, finishing, and custom processing operations. The position is responsible for driving operational excellence through process improvement, workforce development, cross-functional collaboration, and execution of manufacturing strategies that support company growth and customer satisfaction.  
  
**Essential Duties/Responsibilities**

* Strategic Leadership: Develop manufacturing strategies, capacity plans, growth initiatives, performance goals, and operational roadmaps aligned with company objectives.
* Operational Management: Direct machining, fabrication, assembly, kitting, packaging, finishing, production scheduling, labor planning, equipment utilization, and workflow optimization.
* Safety & Compliance: Lead safety programs, OSHA compliance, environmental compliance, facility audits, risk reduction, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Quality Assurance: Drive quality systems, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, defect reduction, scrap reduction, and customer satisfaction.
* Continuous Improvement: Lead Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, process optimization, waste elimination, productivity improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Financial Management: Manage operating budgets, capital expenditures, cost reduction programs, ROI analysis, and profitability improvement initiatives.
* Team Leadership: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing managers, supervisors, and manufacturing personnel while supporting succession planning.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Sales, Procurement, Distribution, and Customer Service to align manufacturing capabilities with business requirements.
* Key Performance Metrics: Safety, On-Time Delivery, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), Throughput, Labor Productivity, First Pass Yield, Scrap Reduction, Inventory Turns, Cost Performance, Customer Satisfaction, and EBITDA improvement.

**Qualifications**  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related discipline required. MBA preferred. Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, APICS/ASCM, or related certifications preferred.

**Experience/Skills/Abilities Required**

* 10-15 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years leading managers and supervisors.
* Experience managing machining, fabrication, assembly, and value-added manufacturing operations.
* Strong Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement experience.
* Experience with ERP systems, production planning, inventory management, and KPI reporting.
* Strong financial acumen including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and capital planning.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to build effective relationships across all levels of the organization.

Noise levels may be high at times. Position requires regular presence in office and manufacturing environments. Standing, walking, sitting, reaching, stooping, bending, pushing, pulling, and occasional lifting up to 50 pounds may be required. Appropriate PPE must be worn when required.

**Senior Director, Manufacturing Operations**

*Own the supply chain and CMC project engine behind Nurix's clinical programs and commercial readiness. In this multifaceted role, you will select and manage CMOs, keep clinical supply flowing to trial sites around the world, and drive cross-functional CMC plans from early development toward commercialization, in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities.*

  

**Position Description**

The position is a multifaceted role supporting several areas within the Technical Operations group, including supply chain management, CMC project management, and clinical labeling and distribution. The ideal candidate will be highly motivated and self-directed, with experience and interest in working in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities and opportunities.

  

**The Opportunity**

* Lead the effort to identify, select, and manage Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) for the development and cGMP manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and DS in support of ongoing clinical programs and commercial products (with finance and commercial teams)
* Manage global supply chains and logistics in support of demand for clinical studies and commercial products
* Working in conjunction with technical teams, provide vendor management support in all logistics and operations to ensure on-time delivery of materials
* Coordinate the design and execution of cross-functional CMC project plans and budgeting for early clinical development through commercial readiness
* Maintain frequent communication with cross-functional CMC project team members and key internal stakeholders so that all parties are aware of current project status, issues, contingencies, milestones, and budgets
* Proactively identify the CMC critical path, risks, and impediments to successful development, and drive the identification and development of solutions to mitigate these risks
* Serve as primary clinical supply chain contact, working collaboratively with internal and external partners
* Manage clinical supply planning and forecasting for study protocols and develop packaging/labeling and global distribution strategies
* Monitor IXRS portal processes, including high and low enrolling site settings, drug acknowledgement, depot and site supply levels, and IMP status of released lots or expired drug
* Coordinate the preparation and/or review of CMC sections of INDs, CTAs, NDAs, MAAs, and other regulatory submissions to ensure timely distribution of clinical trial materials
* Coordinate the process validation programs to support commercialization
* Initiate and manage high-value intercontinental, cross-border, and domestic shipments
* Coordinate the preparation, review, editing, and approval of cGMP batch records and CMC regulatory and Quality documents
* Coordinate the preparation of technical reports, publications, and oral presentations

  

**What You'll Bring**

* BS with 15+ years' experience; degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology CMC/cGMP environment
* Excellent project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally to develop and execute project plans
* Experience managing US and international CRO/CMOs for the manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and cGMP DS and DP for programs in development
* Experience with clinical supply chain, including forecasting supply needs
* Experience with cGMP manufacturing and IND, CTA, and NDA filings; thorough knowledge of relevant FDA and EMEA regulations
* Experience in supply chain management, and experience establishing pharmaceutical supply chain systems and networks
* Able to identify and resolve critical issues
* Sufficient technical background and experience to work closely with other technical functional areas
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and exceptional interpersonal and management skills to collaborate with others on assigned projects (including both internal teams and external collaborators)
* Bonus: Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline
* Bonus: Experience managing US and international CMOs for commercial programs

  

**Salary Range:** $270,300 - $295,700

*The posted range applies to roles based in the San Francisco Bay Area and reflects local market conditions. Where an offer lands within that range depends on the candidate's relevant experience, technical expertise, and how their background aligns with the role's requirements.*

  

**Location:** Onsite – Brisbane, CA

  

**Fit with Nurix Culture and Values**

* Strong team orientation; highly collaborative
* Solutions and results-oriented focus
* Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

  

**About Nurix Therapeutics**

*Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix's dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine's next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.*

existing_roles.description:
Meta is seeking a Director of Compute Manufacturing and Strategic Sourcing to lead the strategy, execution, and organizational development of our compute hardware manufacturing and supply chain functions. This role sits at the intersection of large-scale data center infrastructure and advanced manufacturing operations, driving the end-to-end readiness of compute systems — including servers, accelerators, and custom silicon-based hardware — from design through high-volume production. You will shape sourcing strategy for critical compute components, build deep partnerships with contract manufacturers and component suppliers, and ensure Meta's infrastructure hardware scales reliably to meet the demands of AI, machine learning, and global platform workloads.  
  
  

### **Director, Compute Manufacturing & Strategic Sourcing Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the manufacturing and strategic sourcing roadmap for Meta's compute and network hardware portfolio, including servers, accelerators, and custom silicon-integrated systems
* Lead supplier selection, qualification, and development for compute components and contract manufacturing partners, ensuring capacity, quality, and cost targets are met at scale
* Serve as an executive point of contact and relationship owner for key ODM & Supplier partners
* Drive design for manufacturability initiatives in partnership with hardware engineering teams to ensure compute platforms are optimized for high-volume production from early design stages
* Establish and govern manufacturing readiness processes across new product introduction phases, from prototype builds through mass production ramp up
* Develop and manage strategic sourcing frameworks for critical compute supply chains, including commodity management, dual-sourcing strategies, and long-term supply agreements
* Lead cross-functional programs spanning hardware engineering, supply chain, quality, and operations to align manufacturing execution with infrastructure deployment timelines
* Define and track key manufacturing and sourcing metrics, including yield, cost per unit, supplier on-time delivery, and supply risk exposure
* Build and scale a globally distributed team of sourcing managers, and program leads, providing technical direction and career development
* Partner with silicon and hardware architecture teams to influence component and platform decisions based on supply availability, manufacturability, and total cost of ownership
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the computer supply base, applying lean manufacturing principles and data-driven analysis to improve efficiency and resilience

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management within the compute hardware, data center infrastructure, or consumer electronics industry
* 8+ years of people management experience leading multi-disciplinary teams including engineering, sourcing, and program management functions
* Experience managing end-to-end new product introduction for complex compute hardware systems such as servers, accelerators, storage platforms, or custom silicon-integrated products
* Experience developing and executing strategic sourcing programs for compute components including processors, memory, power delivery systems, or printed circuit board assemblies
* Demonstrated track record of building and scaling supplier partnerships and contract manufacturing relationships for high-volume hardware production

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with custom silicon or ASIC-integrated compute platform manufacturing, including packaging technologies such as advanced SiP or chiplet-based architectures
* Experience applying lean manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies to drive yield improvement and cost reduction across a global supply base
* Familiarity with data center hardware qualification processes, reliability testing methodologies, and infrastructure deployment operations
* Background in AI or machine learning infrastructure hardware, including GPU or custom accelerator supply chains

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  
  
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

existing_roles.title: Program Director, Advanced Manufacturing Technology
existing_roles.description:
DeVry University strives to close our society’s opportunity gap and address emerging talent needs by preparing learners to thrive in careers shaped by continuous technological change. Through innovative programs, relevant partnerships, and exceptional care, we empower students to meaningfully improve their lives, communities, and workplaces.
  
  
Our colleague experience is an area of obsessive focus. At DeVry University, we care about you. Because, only through you can we deliver our unique Care Formula to our learners and partners.
  
  
Opportunity
  
The Program Director, Advanced Manufacturing Technology, will lead the development and launch of employer-informed technical education programs in advanced manufacturing. Working across Product and Academics, this role translates industry requirements into differentiated academic programs, identifies delivery and investment needs, and coordinates academic and product readiness for launch.
  
The position provides discipline-level leadership and accountability for the Advanced Manufacturing Technology program from initial development through sustainable academic operations. During program build and launch, the role will operate within Product in close partnership with Academics. Once the program is established, the position may transition to Academics and assume ongoing leadership of a faculty team, instructional quality, academic operations, and program performance, consistent with institutional academic governance and approval requirements.
  
Responsibilities
  
Employer Engagement and Program Strategy
  

* Establish and maintain a structured process for engaging employers and industry stakeholders to identify required competencies, knowledge, skills, abilities, and employment outcomes.
* Develop relationships with employers and industry partners that could support program co-design, applied learning opportunities, industry-recognized credentials, or pathways to employment.
* Use employer feedback, labor-market demand, competitive intelligence, and recognized industry competency frameworks to inform program direction and differentiation.
* Collaborate with Product, Academics, and other stakeholders to develop and maintain a discipline-specific program roadmap and recommendations.

Program and Curriculum Development
  

* Partner with academic and curriculum teams to translate employer requirements into program outcomes, curriculum architecture, course sequencing, and applied learning experiences.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate DeVry’s programs through emerging technologies, simulation, industry partnerships, innovative hands-on learning models, and integration of digital technologies.
* Ensure proposed programs reflect relevant industry standards, appropriate academic requirements, and measurable student learning and employment outcomes.
* Coordinate input from faculty, academic leaders, and industry partners to maintain program relevance and quality.

Investment and Delivery Planning
  

* Develop recommendations and funding requirements for labs, equipment, tools, technology, facilities, instructional resources, and external delivery partnerships.
* Evaluate delivery options that expand learner access, support hands-on skill development, improve the student experience, and create efficient, scalable operations.
* Partner with Finance and operational teams to evaluate program costs, investments, and implementation requirements.

Program Operations, Resource Stewardship, and Performance
  

* Provide accountable discipline-level leadership for operational readiness and sustained delivery, including instructional scheduling coordination, lab and equipment utilization, safety-related instructional requirements, and issue resolution with relevant operational partners.
* Develop and monitor program-level operating plans, resource needs, and budget recommendations; partner with Finance and academic leadership to manage approved resources, evaluate cost-to-deliver, and identify opportunities for quality, access, and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrate the ability to lead faculty or technical instructional teams, manage academic delivery, and drive measurable program quality and student outcomes.
* Apply experience with program-level resource planning, budget stewardship, operational improvement, and coordination of facilities or lab-based instruction.
* Own discipline-specific performance improvement recommendations and execution within delegated authority, escalating material investment, regulatory, or strategic decisions to appropriate institutional leaders.
* Lead the transition from product launch to academic operations, including documented handoffs, faculty management readiness, operating procedures, performance measures, and continuity of employer relationships.

Launch and Cross-Functional Execution
  

* Lead the discipline-specific academic and product workstreams of the go-to-market project, coordinating with Academics, Product, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Enrollment, Finance, and other teams.
* Monitor program design, approval, readiness, and launch milestones; identify dependencies, risks, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
* Support launch readiness and early program review, using employer and learner feedback to recommend improvements to quality, relevance, and outcomes.

Discipline-Specific Responsibilities
  

* Apply knowledge of advanced manufacturing technologies, industrial operations, automation, and related technician competencies to program design and employer engagement.
* Evaluate relevant manufacturing competency frameworks, applied laboratory requirements, and industry-recognized credentials when developing program recommendations.

Academic Leadership and Faculty Management
  

* Following program establishment and transition to Academics, lead and manage assigned advanced manufacturing faculty, including hiring input, onboarding, performance evaluation, coaching, development, workload planning, and accountability for instructional effectiveness.

Qualifications
  

* Demonstrated experience in advanced manufacturing, industrial technology, automation, or a closely related technical field.
* Experience developing, launching, or substantially improving technical, career and technical education, or workforce-aligned academic programs.

**SUMMARY:** Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**:

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS:**

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**:

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES**:

The individual must posses the following:

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS**:

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

* **Operating standards** - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* **Personal growth** - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations** - through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

**Carolina Container Company is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.**

existing_roles.description:
CAMS is looking for a Plant Manager at the Kings Mountain Energy Center in Kings Mountain, NC. The incumbent will have 19 direct and indirect employees. The Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, compliant, and financially responsible operation and maintenance of the Kings Mountain Energy Center.

Kings Mountain Energy Center is a 475MW natural gas-fired combined-cycle power plant. The facility features an advanced 276MW Mitsubishi M501GAC gas turbine, a Vogt Power heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), a 225MW Toshiba steam turbine generator, and a Thermal Engineering International surface condenser.

The position provides overall leadership for plant operations, maintenance, engineering support, environmental and regulatory compliance, administration, workforce development, budgeting, outage execution, and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager serves as the primary site representative to CAMS leadership, facility ownership and asset management, and is accountable for developing a high-performing organization that maximizes plant availability, reliability, efficiency, and long-term asset value. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, sound technical and business judgment, and the ability to manage a complex combined-cycle generating facility in a competitive power-market environment.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the safe, reliable, environmentally compliant, and cost-effective operation and maintenance of the facility.
* Establish and maintain a strong safety culture in which employees and contractors actively identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and demonstrate personal ownership of safety performance.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local environmental permits, laws, regulations, NERC requirements, OSHA requirements, company policies, and facility procedures.
* Lead and develop the plant management team and workforce, including recruiting, coaching, performance management, succession planning, qualification programs, and workforce development.
* Maintain effective working relationships with facility ownership, Asset Management, CAMS leadership, regulatory agencies, the system operator, utilities, OEMs, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, O&M budgets, capital plans, forecasts, and long-term maintenance strategies consistent with owner objectives and contractual requirements.
* Monitor plant financial performance and control expenditures while ensuring that short-term budget objectives do not create unacceptable safety, environmental, reliability, or long-term asset risk.
* Direct plant operations to achieve availability, reliability, heat-rate, start-reliability, capacity, and other performance objectives while meeting dispatch and commercial obligations.
* Provide leadership for maintenance strategies, preventive and predictive maintenance, corrective-maintenance backlog management, equipment reliability, root-cause analysis, and elimination of recurring failures.
* Direct planning and execution of combustion turbine, steam turbine, HRSG, generator, electrical, and balance-of-plant outages and major maintenance activities, including scope, budget, schedule, contractor performance, quality, and risk management.
* Develop and maintain multi-year outage, major-maintenance, and capital improvement plans based on equipment condition, OEM recommendations, operating profile, commercial requirements, and risk.
* Identify significant plant risks and provide CAMS leadership and ownership with timely information, alternatives, consequences, and clear recommendations for decision-making.
* Ensure appropriate critical-spares strategy, inventory controls, long-lead component planning, and equipment-obsolescence management.
* Oversee plant engineering and technical support activities, including equipment modifications, controls and logic changes, performance monitoring, capital projects, and technical problem solving.
* Ensure plant procedures, drawings, technical documentation, training materials, emergency plans, and operating records are accurate and maintained.
* Oversee administration of applicable plant contracts and agreements and ensure operational compliance with owner requirements, O&M obligations, OEM/LTSA requirements, fuel and utility agreements, and other commercial commitments.
* Maintain effective communication with Asset Management and ownership, including prompt escalation of significant safety, environmental, operational, equipment, financial, contractual, or regulatory events.
* Lead emergency response and business-continuity activities and ensure the facility is prepared for severe weather, grid emergencies, fuel interruptions, cyber events, and major equipment failures.
* Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement, and open communication across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Compliance, and Administration.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve plant performance, reduce operating risk, optimize costs, and increase long-term asset value.
* Support CAMS fleet initiatives, peer reviews, lessons learned, workforce-development efforts, and cross-facility technical support as requested.

Other duties as assigned.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in power generation operations and maintenance, including significant leadership experience in a power plant environment.
* Prior Plant Manager, Operations Manager, Maintenance Manager, or comparable senior power-generation leadership experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of combined-cycle power plant operations, maintenance, reliability, and major equipment systems. Experience with combustion turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, generators, electrical systems, and balance-of-plant equipment is preferred.
* Experience with Mitsubishi M501GAC combustion turbines is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing major outages, managing contractors and OEMs, controlling outage scope and cost, and resolving emergent technical issues.
* Working knowledge of environmental, health and safety, and electric-generation regulatory requirements applicable to power plant operations.
* Demonstrated experience developing and managing O&M budgets, forecasts, capital projects, and long-term maintenance plans.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary workforce.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, planning, and organizational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with employees, executives, owners, regulators, contractors, and technical personnel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred. Significant relevant power-generation leadership experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems, plant historians, performance-monitoring systems, and other power-plant business systems.
* Ability to respond to plant emergencies and significant operating events outside normal business hours as required.

Other Desirable Skills

* Demonstrates visible leadership and a strong personal commitment to safety and environmental compliance.
* Balances technical, operational, financial, and commercial considerations when making decisions.
* Communicates significant risks and problems early and avoids surprises for ownership and senior leadership.
* Demonstrates strong customer service skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with facility ownership and Asset Management.
* Effectively prioritizes competing demands in a fast-changing operating environment.
* Develop people and create clear succession paths for key positions.
* Demonstrates a high degree of integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and ownership mentality.
* Ability to represent the facility and CAMS professionally with owners, regulators, industry organizations, and external stakeholders

Applicants must possess a **valid driver's license** and maintain a clean driving record, as this position requires occasional travel for company business. Candidates should be comfortable operating a vehicle as part of their job responsibilities and must meet any applicable company and insurance requirements.

CAMS offers a variety of excellent benefits. Full-time employees are offered the following: medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD, and Life insurance plans. You can even select additional “al la carte” benefits to meet all your needs. You can also enroll in our 401k, flex spending accounts for medical and childcare needs, and participate in our employee referral and tuition reimbursement programs.

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

We believe in transparency and providing candidates with important information to make informed decisions. The salary range for this position will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, and location. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, and relevant qualifications.

This range represents the base salary and does not include other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, benefits, or equity, which may be offered in addition to the base pay. The company reserves the right to modify.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The Plant Manager will work closely with other departments and managers to ensure
  
all in-process production metrics as deliverables are being met. This team member will be focused
  
on overall safety, production deliverables and continuous improvement as we continue our growth.  
Job Duties & Responsibilities:  

* Establishing and maintaining production and shipping schedules and ensuring that quality

product is consistently delivered to customers on time and within budget for labor hours,
  
machine hours and material costs  

* Managing production operations such that equipment and employee resources are

utilized efficiently, productivity is high and product quality requirements are met and
  
exceeded  

* Ensuring that process and equipment capabilities meet or exceed company and industry

standards and requirements; implementing operations-related initiatives that result in
  
increased efficiency, improved productivity and reduced job-related costs  

* Full participation in weekly production meetings and daily work-related meetings is

expected  

* Maintaining company policies and procedures with respect to production, materials, and

equipment-related activities, ensuring that employees report labor hours, machine hours,
  
material usage and activities in accordance with company policies and procedures and
  
within the current operations management and control systems  

* Implementing operations and function-related budgeting goals and objectives;

establishing benchmarks for monthly, quarterly, and annual case production and
  
shipments, material receipts, production work-in-process completed and inventory levels
  
within the Plant Level of Operations  

* Preparing and presenting to Director of Operations, the weekly executive summary that

includes production, purchasing, shipping, receiving and inventory numbers as part of the
  
system of infernal checks and balances  

* Recruiting, selecting, training, motivating and evaluating all operations employees in

accordance with company human relations policies and procedures  

* Helping to build and manage within a team-based production environment and developing

and maintaining good working relationships between production, materials, and
  
equipment maintenance  

* Interfacing between the employees in the department and the Director of Operations, the

Executive Vice-President and President of the Company and supporting company policies,
  
goals, objectives, and initiatives  

* Ensuring that all product produced meets quality requirements in accordance with

company policy, procedures and requirements and in accordance with industry standards  

* Keeping the Management abreast of successes, progress and potential problems and

offering appropriate solutions for those problems  

* Simultaneously handling, prioritizing and resolving problems effectively
* Ensuring that shipment deadlines and budget and profitability objectives (i.e. gross margin

and operating profit) are met and exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis as established
  
by Director of Operations  

* Ensuring achievement of production metrics and shipment objectives, including labor

hours per case, machine time per case, quality and cost per case; ensure that labor and
  
machine efficiency is within company guidelines; ensuring that periodic maintenance,
  
repair, rework hours and waste are within company guidelines  

* Ascertaining that purchasing, production support, shipping and receiving performance

metrics and objectives and inventory units and balance objectives are achieved or
  
exceeded on a quarterly and annual basis while ensuring on-time delivery of quality
  
product to customers at budgeted cost per case  

* Ensuring quality products are produced and quality relationships are established and

maintained between production, materials and equipment maintenance personnel, with
  
engineering and sales, customers, subcontractors and others in the area and in the
  
industry  

* Ensuring customer complaints are fewer and of less seriousness than company targets and

objectives  

* Ensuring that reporting and supporting documentation is completed on time and in

accordance with company procedures  

* Achieving Company goals to produce quality product on time and within budget hours are

supported in theory and followed in practice

Job Qualifications:
  

* 5+ year’s relevant industrial and manufacturing experience
* Associates degree in industrial, mechanical, or electrical engineering or equivalent

experience. Manufacturing engineering and operations management an added plus  

* Relevant and current technical knowledge concerning products, materials and equipment
* Knowledge, skills and ability to understand and manage food processing activities and

production lines to provide expertise and technical support to all plant employees, to
  
make equipment, production and materials related decisions  

* Ability to maintain production planning and scheduling, shop loading, expediting and

dispatching, purchasing, shipping and receiving and inventory control functions using
  
manufacturing systems in place  

* Ability to lead and motivate teams to produce quality product, on schedule and within

budget and participate in and facilitate operations-related team meetings  

* Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to successfully lead and develop a

team  

* Excellent team leadership skills and an ability to set goals, accomplish objectives, coach

and counsel while adding to the organizational climate and culture  

* Personal characteristics reflective of a fast paced industry: high energy, self-motivated,

positive attitude, service oriented, flexible, ethical, loyal and with high degree of integrity  

* Business maturity, team orientation and proven ability to positively influence change and

ensure business discipline through periods of growth while simultaneously protecting the
  
company’s operating principles and underlying entrepreneurial culture  

* Demonstrated good judgment in prioritizing, expediting, investigating and resolving

problems and issues and fosters harmonious relations with other company employees
  
while meeting and exceeding customer requirements  

* Respect for the confidentiality of company, customer, and employee information

Competencies:  

* Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process

improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self-available to staff;
  
Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages
  
growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus
  
in others; Improves processes, products, and services.; Continually works to improve
  
supervisory skills.  

* Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks

correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values; Benefits organization
  
through outside activities; Supports affirmative action and respects diversity.  

* Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and

analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem
  
solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.  

* Quality Management - Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Demonstrates

accuracy and thoroughness.  

* Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Determines appropriate

action beyond guidelines; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Uses equipment and
  
materials properly.  

* Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve organizational goals; Understands

organization's strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies
  
external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.  

* Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and

development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares
  
expertise with others.  
PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work is performed indoors in a manufacturing  
setting with regular exposure to cold, heat, noise, and moving machines and equipment. Must be
  
able to lift to 50 lbs, push and pull up to 40 lbs, lift, stand and carry consistently, have proper hearing,
  
vision and speech capabilities. Can wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) (Hearing protection,
  
safety glasses, goggles, or shields).  
The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of
  
this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or physical
  
requirements. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign
  
duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Reasonable accommodations may be made to
  
enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The role manages engineering and operations expenditure and execution in support of company objectives, and reports to the VP of Engineering.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Set direction for process engineering and manufacturing operations, aligning objectives and priorities with company objectives cascaded by VP of Engineering, in partnership with senior management and JSR stakeholders.

* Align engineering and manufacturing to support long-term growth, capacity expansion, and product roadmap needs.
* Lead capital planning and manufacturing capacity expansion in partnership with Facilities, Equipment Engineering, and Maintenance, defining manufacturing requirements and coordinating execution of approved investments.
* Manage operating expenditure (OPEX) and capital expenditure (CAPEX) for engineering and operations, including forecasts, resource allocation, cost control, and performance reporting within approved budgets and delegated authority. * Work with customer teams to balance production priorities against plant capacity, maintenance activities, equipment installs, and workforce readiness.

existing_roles.description:
**Job Summary**  
The Director, Advanced Shipbuilding & Manufacturing Excellence is Gulf Copper's industrial design authority and the leader of its continuous improvement program. The Director owns the production-system concept for each Gulf Copper site in Galveston, Port Arthur, and Corpus Christi, Texas: how work flows through the yard, how material moves, what equipment and tooling are used, and how the facility is laid out to support it. On the front end, the Director defines the production-system, equipment, and layout requirements that the architect/engineering firm and construction manager design to, and leads the selection of production equipment and tooling. On an ongoing basis, the Director leads the company's effort to continuously improve shipbuilding, ship repair, and module fabrication methods, tooling, work content, and productivity across all sites, and investigates and introduces proven advanced manufacturing technologies including automation, robotics, digital shipbuilding, and artificial intelligence (AI). The role supports Gulf Copper's growth into construction of U.S. Navy (USN) and U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) vessels, government and commercial ship repair, and distributed fabrication of ship and submarine modules.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

This position is responsible for the following: Other duties may be assigned.

**Production-System Design Authority (Front End)**

* Own the production-system concept for each site, including process flow, material flow, shop and work-station arrangement, build strategy, and facility layout, and hold design authority over these elements within the facility modernization master plan.
* Define and approve the production-system, throughput, equipment, and layout requirements that the architect/engineering firm and construction manager design to, and review their deliverables for conformance to those requirements.
* Lead the specification, evaluation, and selection of production equipment and tooling, including heavy lift and cranes, panel and block assembly lines, cutting and welding systems, blast and paint facilities, material handling, and ship transfer and launch systems, including trade studies, vendor evaluation, and total-cost-of-ownership analysis.
* Define the role and target capacity of each facility (newbuild, repair, module fabrication, outfitting, and support) and the production-system requirements needed to achieve them, as input to capital sequencing decisions.
* Translate target vessel classes and customer requirements into facility and process requirements, including ship size, displacement, launch and transfer method, assembly sequence, test and trials, and delivery.
* Work with finance, business development, and the Grants and Workforce Development managers to develop business cases and cost models for production-system and equipment investments.

**Continuous Improvement & Industrial Engineering**

* Lead Gulf Copper's continuous improvement program across all sites, establishing the methodology, governance, cadence, and reporting for improvement of shipbuilding, ship repair, and module fabrication processes.
* Establish and maintain productivity baselines and targets (such as man-hours per ton, cycle time, first-pass yield, rework, and schedule adherence) by site, product line, and process, and report progress against them.
* Lead value-stream mapping, work measurement, line balancing, and takt-based planning for fabrication, assembly, outfitting, and repair processes.
* Develop, document, and sustain standard work, production standards, procedures, and work instructions that reflect current best methods, tooling, and facilities.
* Lead cross-functional improvement events and projects with yard operations, engineering, planning, quality, and supply chain, and track resulting savings against investment.
* Operate a lessons-learned loop that feeds production experience back into layout, equipment, tooling, and build-strategy decisions.
* Set methods, standards, and tooling for the yards; General Managers retain ownership of daily production execution.

**Advanced Technology: Automation, Robotics, Digital Shipbuilding & AI**

* Investigate, evaluate, and benchmark new shipbuilding technologies and methods through industry research, domestic and international shipyard visits, vendor engagement, and partnerships with government and academic organizations.
* Develop business cases, pilot programs, and implementation plans for new technologies, and lead implementation of proven techniques such as robotic and automated welding, cutting, and panel and module production lines.
* Evaluate and pilot AI, data analytics, and digital shipbuilding tools for production planning, scheduling, quality, and productivity improvement, and scale those that demonstrate value.
* Work with engineering, IT, and operations to integrate new technologies with design, production control, and quality systems.
* Partner with the Workforce Development Manager to train and upskill the workforce to operate and maintain new methods and technologies.

**Module Fabrication & Distributed Manufacturing**

* Define the production-system and facility requirements for complex module fabrication, including large steel, piping, outfitting, and system modules for surface ships and submarines.
* Establish standard processes for module design interfaces, tolerances, dimensional control, quality assurance, transportation, and integration across Gulf Copper sites and outside partners.
* Define the production approach and facility requirements for a distributed manufacturing model in which modules are built across Gulf Copper's Texas facilities and with partners, then transported and integrated at the final assembly site.

**Leadership, Collaboration & Reporting**

* Lead the industrial engineering and continuous improvement staff and matrixed engineering, planning, and project personnel assigned to advanced shipbuilding initiatives.
* Coordinate with yard General Managers, engineering, estimating, supply chain, quality, and safety to implement new methods, tooling, and equipment and to prepare the yards for new shipbuilding and repair work.
* Provide facility, capacity, production-approach, and productivity input to business development, capture, and proposal teams for USN, USCG, and commercial opportunities, and serve as technical subject-matter expert on production capability in customer and partner discussions.
* Prepare reports and presentations for executive leadership on production-system design status, equipment selection, continuous improvement results, technology initiatives, and facility readiness.
* Establish metrics and systems for tracking production-system milestones, equipment procurement, productivity, and capacity.

**Safety & Quality**

* Ensure new facilities, equipment, tooling, and methods are designed for safety and comply with applicable environmental, safety, and permitting requirements.
* Design processes and quality systems to meet NAVSEA, USCG, and classification society standards applicable to shipbuilding and ship repair, working with the Quality organization.
* Promote a strong safety culture in the introduction of new methods and technologies.

**Key Measures of Success:**

* Production-system concept, layout requirements, and equipment list approved for each site by the dates set in the facility modernization master plan.
* Productivity baselines established for each site and product line within the first year, with annual improvement targets set and met thereafter.
* Documented continuous improvement savings tracked against capital and program investment.
* Pilot-to-adoption rate and realized benefit of new technologies introduced.
* Standard work and production standards in place and maintained for modernized processes.

**Required Education & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial/Manufacturing Engineering, Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Management, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in shipbuilding or heavy industrial manufacturing, including at least 7 years in shipbuilding, ship repair, or marine module fabrication.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, or industrial engineering programs in a production environment with measurable productivity results.
* Demonstrated experience defining production-system, equipment, or facility layout requirements for shipyard or heavy industrial facility modernization or expansion.
* Strong knowledge of modern shipbuilding production methods, including modular and zone construction, panel and block assembly, outfitting, and ship assembly and launch.
* Experience evaluating and implementing automation, robotics, or other advanced manufacturing technologies in a production environment.
* Knowledge of NAVSEA, USCG, and classification society standards applicable to shipbuilding and ship repair.
* Strong project management, budgeting, and scheduling skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; experience with project scheduling and shipbuilding design and production software preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent continuous improvement certification.
* Experience with first-of-class production-system design for a greenfield or major brownfield shipyard stand-up, including panel line or block assembly line design.
* Experience constructing large, complex USN or USCG vessels such as icebreakers, combatants, or auxiliaries.
* Experience with distributed manufacturing of ship or submarine modules, including submarine industrial base programs.
* Experience benchmarking production methods at domestic and international shipyards.
* Experience with AI, digital shipbuilding, digital twin, or data-driven production planning tools.
* Experience with construction management or general contractor delivery models for large industrial facility projects.
* Prior senior leadership experience in shipyard operations, engineering, or production.

**Working Conditions:**

* Office equipment, including telephone, scanner, computer printer, etc.

**Special Skills:**

### **Description**

At Pacific Seafood, we do more than just provide the world with the healthiest proteins on the planet. We are a family-owned, excellence-driven organization committed to being the brand of choice in the marketplace and the employer of choice in the community. We believe in servant leadership, investing in our team members’ personal and professional growth, and rewarding performance. We live by the core values of our Diamond Philosophy: Teamwork, Productivity, Quality, and Excellence—which means consistently doing your best and *always* striving to do better.
  
  
**Summary:**

We are seeking a dynamic, solutions-oriented **Director of Technology Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize IT operations for our enterprise. Serving as a strategic partner to leadership and business unit heads across geographies, this role is accountable for the reliability, agility, and continuous evolution of our enterprise technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, hands-on leader who blends deep technical fluency with strong financial stewardship and operational maturity. Rather than introducing rigid bureaucracy, this leader takes a pragmatic, evolutionary approach—fine-tuning existing workflows, aligning IT service delivery with measurable business outcomes, and fostering an empowering, "Best in Class" culture across Service Desk, Project Management Office (PMO), Infrastructure, and Enterprise Applications.

Because our team members are our greatest asset and strength, this role directly assesses the VP’s direct reports and the next level of leaders, identifies strengths and gaps, and ensures each leader has a practical development plan. The Director also evaluates reporting relationships, spans of control, role clarity, and succession depth, and uses a working knowledge of income statements and balance sheets to connect people decisions to business results.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Enterprise IT Service Delivery & Service Desk Operations**

* **Support Leadership:** Direct the strategy and daily execution of end-user support, including the IT Service Desk, Desktop Support, Field Services, Depot/Procurement, and VIP/Executive Support across multiple time zones.
* **SLA & Throughput Excellence:** Establish, monitor, and enforce aggressive Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure consistent, predictable service throughput—even during critical end-of-month, end-of-quarter, or high-volume operational periods.
* **End-to-End Lifecycle Management:** Oversee the complete IT lifecycle of internal and customer-facing systems, including enterprise workstations, telephony, infrastructure, and specialized operational/manufacturing hardware.
* **Operational Readiness & Business Continuity:** Lead contingency planning, risk surfacing, and operational readiness initiatives to protect business continuity and minimize disruptions during organizational transitions or major system cutovers.

**2. ITSM, ITIL Frameworks & IT Governance**

* **ITSM & ITIL Maturity:** Own, design, and continuously optimize core ITIL processes—including Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Escalation, and Knowledge Management—within enterprise platforms.
* **IT Intake & Demand Management:** Architect and govern a centralized IT Intake process to evaluate, prioritize, and route incoming business requests, ensuring resource allocation aligns with strategic corporate objectives and operational capacity.
* **Enterprise Governance & Compliance:** Establish pragmatic IT governance models, internal controls, and compliance frameworks that safeguard enterprise data and infrastructure without impeding business agility.
* **Knowledge & Self-Service Enablement:** Drive continuous improvement in knowledge base creation, documentation standards, and automated self-service tools to empower end-users and accelerate first-contact resolution.

**3. Project Management Office (PMO) & Digital Transformation**

* **PMO Leadership & Tollgate Governance:** Develop, deploy, and oversee formalized project management methodologies and tools. Serve as the executive tollgate for technology initiatives to ensure requirements are rigorously defined, scoped, and aligned with strategic goals.
* **Enterprise System Implementations:** Lead cross-functional execution for major digital transformation initiatives, including ERP migrations, CRM rollouts, and M&A technology integrations.
* **AI & Automation Readiness:** Champion the pragmatic adoption of emerging technologies and AI-driven workflows across IT operations to automate routine tasks, enhance reporting accuracy, and elevate enterprise productivity.

**4. Continuous Improvement & Lean Operations**

* **Lean Six Sigma Execution:** Embed Lean and Continuous Improvement methodologies into daily IT operations to eliminate waste, reduce turnaround times, and streamline cross-departmental workflows.
* **Root Cause & Corrective Action:** Partner closely with all IT Operations teams on deep failure-mode analysis and root-cause corrective actions to permanently resolve recurring technical issues and business impacts.
* **Asset & Inventory Optimization:** Reframe IT hardware, spare parts, and demo/recon pools as actively managed operational assets—optimizing space utilization, procurement costing, redistribution, and lifecycle disposition.

**5. Customer Satisfaction & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* **Customer-Centric Culture:** Champion an unwavering focus on internal and external customer satisfaction, transforming IT from a transactional support function into a proactive, trusted business enabler.
* **Executive & Departmental Alignment:** Foster transparent, collaborative partnerships with Finance, Manufacturing, Distribution, Quality, Engineering, and Sales leadership to ensure technology roadmaps directly support revenue and operational goals.
* **Voice of the Customer:** Implement regular satisfaction tracking, feedback loops, and executive business reviews to measure stakeholder sentiment and drive targeted service enhancements.

**6. Financial Stewardship & Resource Optimization**

* **Multi-Million-Dollar P&L Management:** Develop, justify, and manage a $15M–$30M+ IT operations budget, maintaining strict fiscal discipline across OPEX, CAPEX, vendor contracts, and software licensing.
* **Data-Driven Economics:** Apply rigorous cost-benefit and repair-versus-replace analyses to hardware maintenance, vendor agreements, and service models, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs while improving service quality.
* **Vendor & Outsourced Partner Management:** Negotiate and manage contracts with third-party vendors, hardware suppliers, and managed service providers to ensure accountability and maximum return on investment.

**7. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership**

* **Inspirational People Leadership:** Lead, mentor, and coach a diverse, geographically dispersed organization of managers, engineers, analysts, and technicians.
* **Cross-Training & Team Resilience:** Eliminate single-point dependencies by building structured cross-training programs, clear career pathways, and flexible skill coverage across teams.
* **High-Accountability & Morale:** Cultivate a high-morale, low-turnover environment rooted in psychological safety, diversity, equity, and inclusion, while holding staff to clear performance standards through active coaching and accountability.

  

### **What you bring to Pacific Seafood**

**Required:**

* **Executive or Senior Leadership Track Record:** 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in IT Operations, Service Delivery, or Technical Operations, including 5+ years at the Director or Senior level within a complex, multi-site, or enterprise environment.
* **Proven Operational Impact:** Demonstrated history of scaling support teams, managing multi-million-dollar budgets, and delivering measurable reductions in operational costs and ticket turnaround times.
* **Enterprise Transformation:** Hands-on experience leading large-scale ERP/CRM transitions, ITIL/ITSM framework implementations, and post-M&A systems integration.
* **Cross-Industry Fluency:** Strong operational understanding of corporate IT alongside manufacturing, distribution, engineering, or field-service environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor of Science in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related technical discipline. Preferred; advanced degrees, e.g., Master of Business Administration (MBA)

**Certifications, not required, but highly desired:**

* ITIL Certification

* Project Management Professional or active PMI affiliation strongly preferred.

**Physical Requirements**  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the team member:

* Must be available to work Monday -Friday during regular working hours, with occasional weekend duties.

At Pacific Seafood your base wage is only a portion of your overall compensation package. We invest in our Team Members through a comprehensive and attractive total rewards package, including but not limited to:

**Job Description Summary:**

At The Coca-Cola Company, we bring together the power of our people, our brands, technology and innovation to refresh the world and make a difference. Our manufacturing operations are critical to delivering quality products safely, efficiently and reliably, and automation plays an increasingly important role in how we build the manufacturing environment of the future.

  

The **Senior Manager, Automation and Controls** will be based at our Ontario, California facility and will lead automation and controls capabilities that support safe, reliable and efficient manufacturing operations. This role will have primary responsibility for the Ontario facility while providing limited automation and controls support to our Portland facility, requiring approximately 5% travel.

This position will lead a small team of Automation and Controls Technicians and serve as a senior technical resource for automation, controls, instrumentation and manufacturing systems. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Quality, Safety and Information Technology teams to improve equipment reliability, strengthen controls infrastructure, support capital projects and advance manufacturing technology.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in industrial automation and controls with practical manufacturing experience, strong problem-solving capabilities and effective people leadership. They bring a continuous-improvement mindset and can translate operational challenges into sustainable automation solutions while developing the technical capabilities of their team.

  

**Key Responsibilities and Position-Related Functions**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop a small team of Automation and Controls Technicians, establishing clear priorities, technical standards, development plans and expectations for safe and effective execution.
* Provide technical leadership for the Ontario manufacturing facility across industrial automation, programmable logic controllers (Rockwell PLC Platform), human-machine interfaces, supervisory control systems, instrumentation, industrial networks, motion control and related manufacturing technologies.
* Ignition Software Platform and Database Development experience.
* Provide limited automation and controls support for the Portland facility, including technical troubleshooting, project consultation and alignment on controls standards, with approximately 5% travel.
* Partner with Operations, Maintenance and Engineering teams to identify chronic equipment issues, determine root causes and implement controls and automation solutions that improve reliability, throughput and operating performance.
* Lead troubleshooting of complex controls and automation issues, using structured problem-solving, equipment data and technical expertise to reduce downtime and prevent recurrence.
* Establish and maintain controls standards, system documentation, software backups, change-management practices and lifecycle strategies for automation assets.
* Support capital projects from concept through commissioning by developing technical requirements, evaluating automation solutions, reviewing control system designs and ensuring successful installation, testing, start-up and handover.
* Partner with internal teams, original equipment manufacturers, system integrators and other technical suppliers to ensure automation solutions meet operational requirements and established Coca-Cola standards.
* Develop strategies for managing aging or obsolete controls hardware and software, prioritizing replacements based on operational risk, equipment criticality and business needs.
* Strengthen preventive and predictive maintenance practices for automation and controls systems to improve equipment availability and reduce unplanned failures.
* Use manufacturing and controls data to identify performance trends, recurring losses and improvement opportunities, translating data into actionable recommendations.
* Advance digital manufacturing capabilities by evaluating appropriate applications of connected systems, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence-enabled tools to improve troubleshooting, reliability and decision-making.
* Collaborate with Information Technology and appropriate cybersecurity partners to help protect industrial control environments, maintain appropriate system access and support secure industrial network architecture.
* Ensure automation work supports applicable safety, quality, environmental and regulatory requirements, including safe equipment design and control of hazardous energy.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify systems, improve equipment performance, reduce waste and energy consumption, and increase the long-term reliability and maintainability of manufacturing assets.
Build technical capability across the organization through coaching, documentation, standardized troubleshooting practices and knowledge sharing with technicians, maintenance teams and other manufacturing partners.

* Demonstrated experience leading, supervising or developing automation, controls or technical professionals in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of programmable logic controller programming, human-machine interfaces, industrial controls, instrumentation, variable-frequency drives, servo or motion systems and industrial communication networks.
* Experience troubleshooting complex automated equipment and applying structured root-cause analysis to recurring equipment and controls failures.
* Experience supporting manufacturing capital projects, including controls specifications, design review, system integration, factory or site acceptance testing, commissioning and start-up.
* Working knowledge of industrial control system cybersecurity principles, network segmentation, access management, backup and recovery practices, and disciplined automation change management.
* Strong data literacy with the ability to use manufacturing information, equipment data and digital tools to identify trends, diagnose performance issues and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Demonstrated digital fluency and an understanding of how advanced analytics and artificial intelligence tools can responsibly support manufacturing reliability, troubleshooting, predictive maintenance and operational decision-making.

As a **Senior Manager, Demand Side Management Quality Assurance & Engineering**, your work will help power our planet, reduce carbon emissions and create cleaner air for everyone. Are you ready to take on the challenge to help us build the future?
